says: He restates that the starting point of the slow-planet ladder is here and again that Uranus takes 84 years round the Sun, seven in each sign.

hindi: तो आपके जन्म के समय आपका यूरेनस जहां था सात साल के लिए समझ लो वहां की पावर तो पकड़ के बैठा ही है।
says: Wherever your Uranus stood at birth, treat it as holding the power of that sign for seven years, so every native carries that sign's Uranus power as a base.
cells_derived_method: Natal Uranus sign gives a generational flavour: everyone born within the same seven-year stay shares the sign; the house placement then personalises it. Examples: Uranus in Taurus and in Gemini differ in themes of resources vs communication.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 2nd in Taurus holds sign power over money and values, shaking or electrifying income and family resources.
Derived: Uranus in the 3rd in Gemini holds power over communication and siblings, bringing sudden ideas and unusual skills.
Derived: Uranus in the 9th in Sagittarius ties the seven-year power to belief, travel and teachers.

ambiguity: Uranus's actual sign-stay can differ a little from seven years; this is his approximation.

hindi: अब उसमें 5 साल बचे हैं, तीन बचे हैं जो बचे हैं। फिर अगली राशि यानी आपके पूरे जन्म काल में हो सकता है एक चक्र की कहानी ही बैठेगी क्योंकि ये इतने लंबे
says: Of the seven years in that sign some may remain at birth (five, three or whatever is left), then it moves to the next sign; so a lifetime may hold only about one full cycle of Uranus.
cells_derived_method: Remaining years of Uranus's stay at birth tell how much of the natal sign's power is left before the next sign takes over; then the next sign's themes begin.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 6th in Aries with only two years left at birth shifts early to Taurus themes, so enemy-fight energy gives way to resources themes in childhood.
Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Leo with six years left at birth keeps gains-and-network power for most of the first seven years.

ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk.

hindi: टाइम लेता है घूमने में सूर्य के इर्द-गिर्द ये बड़े दूरगामी इफेक्ट देता है।
says: Because Uranus takes so long to circle the Sun, its effects are far-reaching and long-term rather than quick.
classical_check: Slow planets giving long-range effects is a general classical idea (Saturn).

hindi: अब लोग कहते हैं इसके फास्ट इफेक्ट्स कैसे आएंगे? ये तो बहुत लंबेलंबे टाइम चलता है। यह कॉरेस्पोंडेंस यानी कंजक्शन के अंदर असर डालता है।
says: Answering how fast effects can come from so slow a planet: Uranus acts through correspondence, meaning conjunction, i.e. when fast planets touch its place.
cells_derived_method: Fast planets (Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus) activating the natal Uranus sign or house trigger its results in the short term.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: When transit Moon or Sun passes the sign of natal Uranus in the 5th in Aquarius, short-term creative or romantic jolts appear.
Derived: Transit Sun crossing Gemini where natal Uranus sits in the 12th gives a month of restlessness, sleep or expense disruption.

ambiguity: Whether 'correspondence' means conjunction in sign, house, or degree is not stated.
classical_check: Fast-planet triggering of slow-planet placements agrees with the general transit method.

hindi: चंद्रमा हर ढाई दिन में एक राशि बदलता है। 12 राशियों में चंद्रमा जब घूमता है तो जब आपकी कुंडली में बैठे हुए यूरेनस वाले घर में आता है उन ढाई दिन में वैसी फीलिंग आती है कि हाय क्या करें?
says: The Moon changes sign every 2.5 days; when it enters the house holding your natal Uranus, for those 2.5 days you feel a jolt of how-to-cope anxiety.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's 2.5-day stay in the Uranus house touches that house's topic: 2nd for money worries, 4th for home unease, 7th for partner jolts, 10th for work jolts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon crossing the 2nd in Libra where Uranus sits gives 2.5 days of sudden money or speech disturbance.
Derived: Moon crossing Uranus in the 10th in Cancer gives 2.5 days of unsettling work news.

ambiguity: Moon actually takes 2.25 to 2.5 days per sign; he rounds.
classical_check: Moon transit over natal planets as short triggers is classical (gochara).

hindi: जब एक महीने के लिए सूर्य उस राशि में आता है तो उस एक महीने के लिए वैसी फीलिंग आती है जैसा यू बैठा है।
says: When the Sun enters the sign of natal Uranus for its one month, the person feels that month the way Uranus is seated, the same flavour for a longer duration.
cells_derived_method: Transit Sun in the natal Uranus sign gives a one-month window with that house's themes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Transit Sun in Aries with natal Uranus in the 9th shows a month of sudden travel plans or belief shifts.
Derived: Transit Sun in Virgo with natal Uranus in the 6th shows a month of health-routine or work disruption.

classical_check: Sun transit as monthly trigger agrees with classical gochara.

hindi: और ग्रह सारे काम कर रहे हैं। लेकिन समझना है हमें कि यार परसों तक बिज़नेस सही चल रहा था। यह कल से गड़बड़ क्या हुई है?
says: All the planets are working at once, but to understand a sudden problem (business fine until the day before, wrong since yesterday) he points to fast triggers touching a slow planet's place.
ambiguity: No planet is named in this sentence; Moon is the implied trigger from the context.

hindi: कुछ भी कर लो 72 घंटे लेकर चलते हैं हम जिसे हम ढाई दिन कवरेज कहते हैं कि छनू का टाइम ढाई दिन का है। तीन दिन का भाई 72 घंटे डॉक्टर भी कहता है 72 घंटे देखूंगा।
says: Use a 72-hour window, which he calls the 2.5 day coverage: the Moon's stay in a sign is 2.5 to 3 days; he adds that doctors too say they will watch for 72 hours.
ambiguity: 'छनू' is unclear caption (probably the Moon's day).
classical_check: Moon sign-stay of about 2.25 days; 72 hours is a rounding.

hindi: तो चंदा मामा बड़े से बड़े ग्रह को जब जब छूता है तो शॉर्ट शॉट छोटे छोटे छोटे-छोटे इफेक्ट्स दे देता है।
says: Whenever the Moon touches even the biggest planet it hands out short, small effects, so the Moon is the short-term trigger of long-term planets.
cells_derived_method: Moon over natal Saturn, Uranus, Rahu gives brief spikes of each planet's theme in the house concerned.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon over a natal planet in the 3rd in Scorpio gives brief spikes of courage, travel or communication friction.
Derived: Moon over a natal planet in the 8th in Pisces gives brief spikes of secrecy, fear or sudden change.

classical_check: Moon as fast trigger agrees with classical view.

hindi: तो आपकी कुंडली में अगर आपने लॉन्ग टर्म के लिए अपना इंद्र सेट कर दिया जो सात साल तो एक एक राशि की पार्टी देगा ही। तो आप ये मान के चलो कि
says: If you have set your Indra (Uranus) properly for the long term, it will certainly deliver a seven-year party in each sign it passes; the sentence continues in the next chunk.
cells_derived_method: Properly set Uranus gives good results for each seven-year sign-stay; the life area is that of the house it transits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Well-set Uranus in the 1st in Gemini gives a seven-year spell of reinvention and confident self-expression.
Derived: Well-set Uranus in the 4th in Pisces gives a seven-year spell of home change that works in the native's favour.

ambiguity: 'Set' is unexplained here; method is deferred.

hindi: कितने लंबे टाइम की पार्टी है। मजा है। आप संघर्ष करोगे। लफड़े होंगे। ऐश खत्म नहीं होगी।
says: Concluding the thought: it is a very long party, there is enjoyment alongside struggle and troubles, but the pleasure will not run out.

hindi: स्वर्ग ऐश हो सकता है अय्याशी। अगर बिगड़ा हुआ है तो अय्याशी है। नहीं तो ऐश तो अय्याशी भी खत्म नहीं करने देगा।
says: The heaven Uranus gives can be comfort or debauchery: debauchery if the planet is afflicted, comfort otherwise; either way it will not let the enjoyment end.
cells_derived_method: Uranus afflicted by Rahu or Mars, or in 5th/7th/12th, tends to excess; well-placed gives refined enjoyment.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 5th in Taurus, if afflicted, shows excess in pleasure and romance; if supported it shows refined enjoyment.
Derived: Uranus in the 12th in Libra afflicted points to hidden indulgences; supported it gives bed-comfort and foreign pleasures.

classical_check: Silent; analogous to Venus-Rahu indulgence yogas.

hindi: और सबसे बड़ी बात क्या होगी? उस अय्याशी को अगर आपने जागृत अवस्था में किया। जागृत अवस्था के बारे में बताते हैं।
says: The biggest point is whether the indulgence is done in a conscious, awakened state; he promises to explain what awakened state means.
ambiguity: 'Awakened state' is defined later, if at all.

hindi: अगर जागृत अवस्था में किया है तो उस अय्याशी के अंतर्गत आपका राहु और केतु दोनों जेब में है।
says: If indulgence is done consciously, in an awakened state, then both Rahu and Ketu stay in your pocket; awareness keeps the two shadow planets from taking over.
ambiguity: This is a spiritual or behavioural claim, not a chart rule.

hindi: इसकी ऐसे मैं माफी चाहूंगा शब्द है प्रमोशन करने के लिए नहीं बोल रहा। लेकिन सिगरेट जो होती है धुआं वो सारी केतु है जो दारू पी रहे हैं हम शनि और राहु है।
says: After apologising and saying he does not promote it, he assigns cigarette smoke to Ketu and liquor to Saturn and Rahu. This is a significations claim, not advice to use either.
cells_derived_method: Ketu or Saturn-Rahu in 5th/8th/12th houses would show addiction tendencies for smoke or drink respectively.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn-Rahu in the 8th in Scorpio shows heavy drinking tendency and hidden habit patterns.
Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Pisces shows smoke-like escapism and withdrawal habits.

classical_check: Rahu and Saturn for intoxicants agrees with classical karakatva (Rahu for alcohol and narcotics); smoke to Ketu is his addition.

hindi: वो आपको डिस्ट्रॉय ही नहीं कर सकता। अब ये मान के चलें के हमने हमने तो मतलब जिसने भी खूब सारी शराब पी ली।
says: He says that in the awakened state these substances cannot destroy you; then moves on to the case of someone who drank a great deal. This is a behavioural claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Risky claim; no medical basis can be inferred and none is endorsed.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts treat intoxicants as Rahu/Saturn harm, so this differs.

gist: He describes the morning-after headache that heavy drinkers get, many people's head feels like it is splitting.
He starts a story about Gurdjieff, a great saint in Russia, who first had a newly arrived disciple drink liquor, and asks the audience to think about that.

hindi: शनि ठोक दिया बॉडी के अंदर। राहु ठोक दिया। खूब सारी दारू चली गई।
says: Continuing the drinking example: after heavy liquor, Saturn and Rahu have been slammed into the body, meaning intoxicant intake loads the body with their qualities. Recorded as his significations claim, not as advice to drink.
classical_check: Alcohol under Rahu and Saturn is consistent with classical karakatva.

hindi: क्या वो अभी भी होश में है? क्या सूर्य अभी भी पावरफुल है? आपका सूर्य नष्ट नहीं होता दारू पीने से।
says: He asks whether the person is still conscious and the Sun still powerful, and claims the Sun is not destroyed by drinking: the self stays intact even when Saturn and Rahu are loaded in.
cells_derived_method: A strong Sun (own sign Leo, exalted in Aries, kendra or 9th/10th placement) is the chart basis for this resilience; a Sun in Libra or in the 6/8/12 houses would give less.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 1st gives strong self-awareness that stays clear under intoxicant influence by his logic.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 8th gives a weak self-core, so the protective effect he describes would be absent.

ambiguity: This is a behavioural claim, not a medical statement; no safety claim is endorsed.

hindi: यानी राहु ने सूर्य पर ग्रहण नहीं लगाया। शनि ने अंधकार से सूर्य को नष्ट नहीं किया। आपका सूर्य चैतन्य है।
says: In this state Rahu has not eclipsed the Sun and Saturn has not darkened it; the Sun, meaning consciousness, remains alive and awake.
cells_derived_method: Rahu or Saturn conjunct or aspecting the Sun in a chart would be the eclipsed condition he is contrasting with; Sun free of both is the aware condition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 10th in Aries free of Rahu and Saturn keeps clear public identity under stress.
Derived: Rahu conjunct Sun in the 1st in Leo is the eclipse case, where identity is clouded.

classical_check: Sun-Rahu eclipse yoga and Sun-Saturn conflict are classical afflictions; agrees.

hindi: यह साक्षी भाव करने लायक शिष्य है। यानी उसको पूरा रियलाइजेशन है के आधी बाटली पी के भी गाड़ी चलाता है। मजे में घर पहुंचता है।
says: He calls such a person a disciple capable of witness consciousness (sakshi bhav) and describes him driving home safely after half a bottle. This records his claim only; drunk driving is dangerous and nothing here is endorsed.
ambiguity: Unsafe behaviour example; flagged and not to be used as guidance.

gist: He notes how astonishing it is, people say how did he not crash after so much drink, why did he not die, who brought him home.

hindi: क्योंकि सूर्य की शक्ति लेता है इंद्र। अरुण। अरुण देव सूर्य का ही सारथी है तो वही मध्यम रोशनी के साथ चलता है।
says: His answer: Indra draws on the Sun's power; Uranus is identified with Aruna, the Sun's charioteer, who moves with a medium or dawn-like light and so carries the person through.
cells_derived_method: Uranus conjunct or aspecting the Sun gives this protected-by-charioteer pattern; Uranus in the same sign as the Sun in 1st, 9th or 10th makes it visible in identity and career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Uranus in the 9th in Sagittarius gives guarded, luck-like protection in travel and belief matters.
Derived: Sun with Uranus in the 10th in Capricorn gives career survival through odd escapes.

ambiguity: Aruna as the Sun's charioteer is Puranic; matching Aruna to Uranus is his own link.
classical_check: Aruna as Surya's charioteer is in the Puranas; the Uranus link is not classical.

hindi: यदि आपके अंदर साक्षी भाव है ऐश और अय्याशी करते हुए आपका बाल भी बांका नहीं होगा।
says: If you hold witness awareness while enjoying luxury or indulgence, not a hair of yours will be harmed; awareness acts as protection. Claim recorded, not endorsed.

hindi: आपने खूब सारी दारू पी ली वैसे शराब जो है वो शनि हो गई। लोग अक्सर शनि और राहु मिक्स करते हैं।
says: Liquor is assigned to Saturn; he observes that people often mix up Saturn and Rahu in this assignment, so he marks a distinction between the two intoxicants that follows.
ambiguity: Earlier he put liquor under Saturn and Rahu together; here liquor is Saturn and beer is later called pure Rahu.
classical_check: Classical: Rahu for liquor and narcotics, Saturn for dark/fermented things; partial agreement.

hindi: अगर कुंडली ठीक नहीं हो कुंडली में ग्रह अलव ना करें तो कभी बियर और विस्की मिक्स ना करें। अगर आप
says: If the chart is weak and its planets do not allow it, never mix beer and whisky; a tradition-style do-not given on a Saturn/Rahu basis. Not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'Planets do not allow' is not defined; unclear which planets or placements.

hindi: बियर जो पूर्ण राहु है उसको विस्की से मिक्स करेंगे। साथ में पानी डालेंगे तो चंद्रमा नष्ट होगा।
says: Beer is pure Rahu; mixing it with whisky and adding water destroys the Moon (the mind and body fluids). It is a signification claim built on his planet-to-drink mapping.
cells_derived_method: Moon in 4th or 1st with Rahu or Saturn influence would be where mind-damage shows most.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th is resilient, so this damage is weaker.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 1st with Rahu influence would show the Moon being destroyed readily.

hindi: बहुत सारी दारू पीने से बॉडी से साल्ट का लॉस होता है। साल्ट क्या है आपका?
says: Heavy drinking causes salt loss from the body, and he asks what salt is in astrological terms, setting up the claim that salt is the Sun. A physiological remark, not astrological.

gist: He asks where the lecture is going, says these are still important points because Indra is the topic, and remarks that it is allowed today.

hindi: ये नमक बॉडी से जब निकल जाता है यानी मिनरल्स एंड साल्ट्स तो हमारा सिर पे जहां जेली की तरह पूरा पानी ही पानी है ब्रेन। चंद्रमा ही चंद्रमा है।
says: When minerals and salts leave the body, the head holds a jelly-like brain full of water, which is all Moon. He maps brain to Moon and salt to the Sun that binds it.
classical_check: Moon for the mind and fluids is classical; the brain-as-jelly image is his; salt for Sun is not classical (salt is usually Venus/Moon-linked).

hindi: उसको बांधने वाला सूर्य कम हो जाता है बॉडी से। जैसे ही सूर्य बॉडी से कम हो जाता है, हमारे सिर में दर्द होता है। इसे कहते हैं हैंगओवर।
says: The Sun is the binder of the watery Moon-brain; when salt (Sun) falls in the body the binding weakens and the head aches, which he calls a hangover. An astro-physiological claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: A medical explanation offered through planets; not to be used as diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent; Sun for head and Moon for fluids is partly classical.

gist: He says the next morning we ask what to do and take a Disprin or some other tablet to improve blood supply; a medicine remark with no astrology.

hindi: जब ऐसी स्थिति बनती है शराब पीने वाला शराब पिएगा। आप कहेंगे नहीं नहीं गंदी बात शराब ना पिए। भैया आपका अगर इंद्र बैठा हुआ खराब राशि में तो ये अय्याशी करा के छोड़ेगा।
says: A drinker will drink regardless of being told not to; if your Indra (Uranus) sits in a bad sign, it will push you into indulgence and not let go. He does not say which signs are bad for Uranus.
cells_derived_method: In his scheme Uranus owns Scorpio (and Aquarius is Saturn or Pluto), so a hostile or debilitation-type sign for Uranus would be one opposed to its nature; the house shows where excess runs: 5th pleasure, 12th bed and expenses, 7th partners.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in a harsh sign in the 5th in Taurus leads to pleasure-seeking excess in romance and entertainment.
Derived: Uranus in a harsh sign in the 12th in Cancer leads to hidden indulgence and expense.

ambiguity: 'Bad sign' for Uranus is not defined here.

hindi: और याद रखो जब तक इसको खुश रखोगे किडनी लीवर फेल ना होगा। ऐसे केसेस हैं
says: As long as Indra (Uranus) is kept happy, he says kidney and liver will not fail; he follows with cases to illustrate. A health claim recorded as his statement; not medical advice or a prediction of any person's health.
ambiguity: No basis given; medical outcome claim should not be relied on.
classical_check: Silent; liver is Jupiter and kidney Venus/Saturn classically, so this differs.

gist: He relays an anecdote that doctors tell families of very heavy smokers to give one more cigarette because otherwise they will die anyway.

hindi: जो बहुत बुरे हालात में नशा करने वाले लोग हैं उनके लिए तो यह सजा बन जाती है... उन्होंने साक्षी भाव नहीं रखा
says: For people deep in addiction, a small supply is given so the body can recover; he says they ruined the body because they did not keep witness awareness while indulging. A health anecdote, flagged and not advice.
ambiguity: A medical claim about addiction management is recorded as spoken and is not endorsed.

hindi: अगर आप पी रहे हैं स्मोक कर रहे हैं ड्रिंक कर रहे हैं जुआ खेल रहे हैं तो वो जुआरी हैं आप जो जुए के अंदर जुआ खेलते हुए भी सूर्य के कारण से इंद्र अयाशी करते हुए भी आप जीतेंगे
says: Even while drinking, smoking and gambling, a person whose Sun holds witness awareness will win at gambling because Sun backs Indra's indulgence. This records his claim about luck and is not gambling or investment advice.
cells_derived_method: Sun strong with Uranus, or Sun and Uranus in 5th (speculation) or 11th (gains), is the chart pattern for such luck.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 5th with Uranus support gives winning luck in games of chance, on his logic.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 11th gives gains from risk-taking when Uranus supports.

classical_check: Silent; 5th-house speculation luck with strong Sun is classical in general.

hindi: ऐसा क्यों होता है यार एक मामा जीतते रहते हैं हमेशा पत्ते खेल खेलते टाइम बाकी बंदे हार जाते हैं। यह मामा जी ने अपना सूर्य साक्षी भवन रखा है।
says: Using the example of an uncle who keeps winning at cards while others lose, he explains that the uncle has kept his Sun in witness mode, so the Sun's calm awareness is the winning factor.
ambiguity: Anecdote used as evidence; not a measured claim.

hindi: हम क्रोध करते हैं। सड़ते हैं। जुपिटर खराब हो गया। बृहस्पति का नाश पीट दिया कुंडली में हमने।
says: When we get angry and fume, we ruin Jupiter in the chart; anger is presented as the act that spoils Jupiter, with Jupiter as the wisdom planet.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's house is the area damaged by anger: in 2nd family speech, in 5th children and advice, in 9th teachers and fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 2nd in Pisces is damaged by angry speech, harming family harmony and wealth.
Derived: Jupiter in the 9th in Sagittarius is damaged by anger at teachers or dharma, thinning fortune.

ambiguity: A behavioural effect on Jupiter is not a classical mechanism.
classical_check: Silent; classically anger is Mars, and Jupiter's weakness is by planetary affliction, not by behaviour.

hindi: भय भय भौक रहे हैं। ग्लास तोड़ दिया। चीजें तोड़ दी। घर के बर्तन भांडे सब तोड़फोड़ कर दिए। इंद्र का सत्यानाश कर दिया। क्योंकि सूर्य बह गया सूर्य।
says: Angry outbursts and smashing glasses and household things wreck Indra (Uranus) because the Sun, meaning composure and awareness, has been drained away.

hindi: अरे साक्षी भाव है। पता है तुम्हें गुस्सा आ रहा है। क्यों कर रहे हो? नहीं करोगे। इसलिए ज्ञान कृष्ण कॉन्शियसनेस
says: With witness awareness you notice anger rising and ask why you are doing it, and then you will not do it; he links this with knowledge and Krishna consciousness as the training for it.
ambiguity: Sentence ends at the chunk break.

hindi: क्या करती है? गुस्सा मैं मेरी मर्जी से करूंगा। भाई तुम्हारी मर्जी से नहीं करूंगा। नहीं शिशुपाल मैं तुम्हें 100 मौके दूंगा। सुदर्शन तभी आएगा जब तुम 100वीं गाली बकोगे।
says: Krishna consciousness gives control: I will be angry by my own will, not yours. He cites Krishna giving Shishupala 100 chances, the Sudarshan chakra coming only at the 100th insult, as a model of controlled anger.
ambiguity: Mythic illustration; not a chart rule.
classical_check: The Shishupala story (100 insults forgiven) is in the Mahabharata and Bhagavata; agrees as a story.

hindi: क्या इतनी शक्ति है हमारे अंदर? इतना कंट्रोलोल्ड यदि आपने सूर्य को किया है। आपका इंद्र हमेशा बेस्ट फल देगा। हमेशा बेस्ट फल देगा।
says: If you have controlled the Sun to that degree, your Indra (Uranus) will always give the best results; he stresses it twice. The Sun's control is the condition for Uranus giving its best.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in any house gives its best when the Sun is strong and unafflicted; the house decides the area: 4th home, 7th partnerships, 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 4th in Aries with a controlled Sun gives stable home change that works out well.
Derived: Uranus in the 7th in Leo with a controlled Sun gives an unconventional but successful partnership.
Derived: Uranus in the 10th in Scorpio with a controlled Sun gives career breakthroughs and recognition.

ambiguity: 'Controlled Sun' is behavioural, not a chart condition, here.

hindi: और बेस्ट फल के लिए तो तड़प रहे सारे। यार धांसू शरीर हो धांसू पत्नी पति धांसू बच्चे धांसू सा बंगला हो मकान गाड़ी पैसा और क्या चाहिए
says: The best fruit that everyone craves is a great body, great spouse, great children, a fine bungalow or house, vehicle and money; this list defines what Indra's best result means in daily terms.
cells_derived_method: The list maps to house topics: body 1st, spouse 7th, children 5th, home and vehicle 4th, money 2nd/11th. Uranus's house tells which item arrives first.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 1st in Taurus brings body and appearance gains first.
Derived: Uranus in the 4th in Leo brings house, land or vehicle gains first.
Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Capricorn brings money gains through networks first.

ambiguity: Cells are listed from the topics; he does not name houses explicitly.
classical_check: Houses for body, spouse, children, home, wealth follow classical bhava topics.

gist: He tells of beggars going to temples, a rich man stepping out of a big car and going to ask God for things, then saying he asked nothing; a humorous aside about everyone asking.
He says we ask for big things and God keeps giving to all, but he walks with the person who becomes his companion, and we are not fit because we always cry for our heaven.

hindi: अगर ऐसा इंद्र है
says: A sentence start: if Indra is such, with the condition completed in the next chunk (afraid and misled).
ambiguity: Fragment; meaning completed at 34:07.

hindi: जो डरा हुआ है बहका हुआ है तो आपके राहु और केतु आपको नोच खाएंगे।
says: If your Indra is frightened and misled, then Rahu and Ketu will tear you apart; a weak or confused Uranus leaves the native at the mercy of both nodes.
cells_derived_method: Uranus afflicted or in a dusthana lets Rahu and Ketu dominate; their houses then show the area torn: Rahu 1st/7th axis relationships, Ketu 10th/4th axis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 6th in Gemini afflicted lets the nodes tear at health and enemies matters.
Derived: Uranus in the 8th in Libra afflicted leaves sudden crises to the nodes' control.

hindi: अगर इंद्र ऐसा है जो महान शक्तिशाली है तो आपने अपने यूरेनस के दम के ऊपर आपका लिवर किडनीज़ पूर्ण रूप से बचा लेना है। आपका हैंगओवर नहीं होगा।
says: If Indra is great and powerful, on the strength of Uranus you will fully protect your liver and kidneys and have no hangover. A health claim as stated by him, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Medical outcome claim; not endorsed.

gist: A garbled passage on removing a hangover and telling about the body, then 'nobody is asking'; the caption does not give a clear sentence.

hindi: आपकी बॉडी के अंदर जो साल्ट लॉस हुआ है उसके बाद इमीडिएटली जब आप फ्री फंड हो जाओ सोने के से ठीक पहले थोड़ा सा नमक पानी के साथ ले लीजिए।
says: After salt loss, just before sleeping take a little salt with water; his home remedy to restore the Sun-salt. A health tip given as tradition, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Quantity is only 'a little'.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical Sun remedy.

hindi: ये आपकी बॉडी को वापस जोड़ेगा। इसी नमक का फायदा होता है। यह आपकी बॉडी के अंदर आपके हार्ट की हीलिंग करता है।
says: Salt will reconnect the body and heal the heart, he says; this is his claim about salt's benefit and the Sun-heart link. Recorded as claimed, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: A medical benefit claim.
classical_check: Sun for the heart is classical; salt as a remedy is not.

hindi: एक नमक है धरती पर सेल्टिक साल्ट। नमक कौन है? सूर्य। नमक सूर्य है। यही साक्षी भाव है।
says: He singles out Celtic salt and states that salt is the Sun, which is the same as witness awareness; Sun, salt and awareness are one principle.
classical_check: Salt is usually under Moon or Venus in classical lists; Sun for salt differs.

hindi: पूरे समुद्र को भी साफ रखता है। समुद्र में हलचल कौन मचाता है?
says: Salt (Sun) keeps the whole sea clean, and then he asks who stirs up the sea, leading to Indra's lightning.

hindi: बिजली आकर कड़क के गिरती है समुद्र के अंदर। फाड़ देती है उसे और समुद्र में तूफान आने शुरू
says: Lightning falls into the sea and tears it, and storms begin; Indra's lightning (Uranus) is what stirs up the sea (Moon/Neptune waters, i.e. emotions).
cells_derived_method: Uranus conjunct or aspecting the Moon or Neptune stirs emotional storms; in the 4th or 12th it stirs the inner life and sleep.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus with Moon in the 4th in Cancer shakes emotional peace and home life suddenly.
Derived: Uranus aspecting the 12th in Pisces stirs dreams, sleep and hidden emotions.

ambiguity: Sentence ends at the chunk break.

hindi: हो जाते हैं। पर इंद्र ठंडा ही वहां जाके होता है। क्योंकि इतनी बड़ी बिजली हजारों वोल्ट की करंट कहां जाके शांत होगा? पानी में जाता है।
says: After the storm, Indra cools down only by going into the water, since a lightning discharge settles there; Uranus's fiery charge finds calm in the Moon's waters.
cells_derived_method: Uranus calms through water-sign placement or Moon contact; in Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces Uranus is settled; in the 4th house, the home-water, it finds peace.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 4th, a water sign in the home house, gives calm and sudden but settled change at home.
Derived: Uranus in Pisces in the 1st is soothed by water-sign sensitivity and gives intuitive originality.

ambiguity: Whether this means Uranus is better in water signs is implied, not stated.

gist: He notes that people say to leave the swimming pool when lightning strikes, because the current goes down into water to calm itself; a safety-style analogy for the previous point.
He says this Celtic salt is unique, comes from a river in Europe where it is extracted; a factual aside about the salt's source that the caption makes unclear.

hindi: इसके अंतर्गत ऐसी स्थिति है इसे खुला रखोगे ना इसका नमक सूखता ही नहीं। वो गीला ही रहता है। यानी इसमें चंद्रमा है।
says: Celtic salt left open never dries and stays moist, which shows the Moon is in it; so this salt carries both Sun (salt) and Moon (moisture).

hindi: कुछ कृपा ही है। इसमें चंद्रमा साथ रहता है। वाष्पित नहीं होता और सूरज इसको गायब नहीं कर पाता। ये गीला ही रहता है हमेशा।
says: By grace the Moon stays with the Sun in this salt, so the Sun cannot evaporate it; Sun and Moon coexist in balance without one cancelling the other.
cells_derived_method: Sun-Moon conjunction (amavasya) in a chart is the analogue; the shared house shows where balance holds, in the 4th with home peace, in the 10th with public life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries with Moon close in the 10th keeps career and public mind in uneasy balance.
Derived: Sun with Moon in the 1st in Cancer gives identity and mind joined in one sign.

ambiguity: Analogy, not a stated chart rule.
classical_check: Sun-Moon conjunction is classically weak for the Moon (combustion in close degrees); he describes the opposite balance, so differs.

hindi: या आपके हार्ट के अंदर अगर ब्लॉकेज है तो ब्लॉकेज भी खोलता है। आपके हार्ट में ब्लॉकेज क्यों है?
says: This salt even opens heart blockage, he says, then asks why a heart has blockage at all. A cardiac claim recorded as spoken, not medical advice.
ambiguity: A medical claim; not endorsed.

hindi: जिंदगी बेकार है, खराब हो गई। सूर्य का नाश अच्छा नाश है क्यों सूर्य का? सिर्फ सिर्फ सिर्फ इंद्र की वजह से
says: His reason for heart trouble: feeling that life is useless or spoiled, which is the Sun being destroyed, and he attributes this solely to Indra (Uranus) problems. Caption is partly garbled.
cells_derived_method: Uranus afflicting the Sun or in the 4th (heart) or 5th (heart and mind) with the Sun would be the chart pattern, with the house showing which area feels hopeless.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 4th in Libra with a debilitated Sun in Libra puts emotional life under stress and a hopeless feeling.
Derived: Uranus in the 5th in Leo with the Sun in its own sign points to heart-level disappointment in creative or romantic life.

ambiguity: Medical link between heart disease and mood is a claim, not diagnosis; caption garbled in the middle.
classical_check: Sun for the heart is classical; the Uranus cause is his addition.

hindi: क्योंकि सबको हो रहा है यार पार्टी नहीं हो रही यार मजा ही नहीं है जिंदगी में साला रोमांस नहीं है जिंग नहीं है मस्ती नहीं है नोट नहीं है
says: Everyone is suffering from the same complaint: no party, no fun, no romance, no zing, no money. He treats the unfulfilled craving for Indra's heaven as the root of the Sun's collapse.

gist: He says three people asked yesterday and two today, all complaining; our crying is only for heaven.

hindi: जिसने तो इसके ऊपर काबू कर लिया वो तो बन गया देवगुरु बृहस्पति और जिसने नहीं
says: Whoever has mastered this craving for Indra's heaven becomes like Devaguru Brihaspati (Jupiter), while the one who has not stays caught; the sentence continues past the chunk end.
ambiguity: Contrasting half is cut at the end of the batch.
classical_check: Brihaspati as the teacher of the gods and Jupiter as wisdom agrees.

hindi: किया वो अपने सूर्य का भी नाश कर रहा है कभी भी जीवन में अपने जीवन को मत कोसो कभी मत बोलो नर्क है
says: A person who keeps crying for heaven is also destroying his own Sun; so never curse your life and never say it is hell. This is a do-not given as a tradition-style rule that Sun is damaged by self-pity.
ambiguity: Sentence starts mid-thought from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent; classically the Sun is weakened by planetary affliction, not by speech, so this is behavioural.

hindi: कभी मत रो पिटो के हाय भाई ये बच्चे वैसे क्यों नहीं हुए तैसे क्यों नहीं हुए नो कंपैरिजन आप इंद्र वीक कर रहे हो
says: Do not wail that your children did not turn out like others; no comparison, because comparing weakens your Indra (Uranus). A behavioural don't tied to the planet.
cells_derived_method: Children matters sit in the 5th house; Uranus in or aspecting the 5th makes this comparison habit sharper.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 5th in Gemini makes comparing a child's results with others a daily weakening habit.
Derived: Uranus in the 10th in Capricorn would weaken through comparing career status with peers.

ambiguity: 5th is implied by the children example only.

hindi: जो है मेरा स्वर्ग है संत क्या कहता है मेरे पास सब है आई हैव एनफ बहुत है इंद्र जेब में ले घूमता है लक्ष्मी माता पीछे पीछे आती है
says: The stance of a saint, saying I have all, I have enough, is the heaven; the person with it keeps Indra in the pocket and Lakshmi follows behind. Contentment is thus the mechanism for strengthening Uranus and drawing wealth.
ambiguity: Lakshmi is not tied to Venus here.
classical_check: Silent; contentment as a wealth principle is moral, not a classical rule.

gist: He says why Lakshmi follows behind will be discussed now, and begins to list items to take.

hindi: सेल्टिक साल्ट ये लेंगे और इसके अलावा कैनन पेपर होता है वो लाल मिर्च होती है खास किस्म की थोड़े से लहसुन के साथ वो भी केतु है
says: Besides Celtic salt, cayenne pepper, a special red chilli, taken with a little garlic, is also Ketu in his mapping. It extends the Ketu significations to cayenne and garlic.
ambiguity: Cayenne, a special chilli, is named by caption 'कैनन पेपर'.
classical_check: Classical lists give garlic and onion to Rahu or Ketu (tamasic); chilli to Mars. Partial.

hindi: अगर हम ऑलिव ऑयल लेकर के वर्जिन ऑलिव ऑयल तीनों को मिक्स करके रोज पीना चाहिए। आपके हार्ट की ब्लॉकेजेस खुल जाती हैं।
says: His home recipe: mix salt, cayenne with garlic and virgin olive oil and drink it daily, which he says opens heart blockages. A health remedy recorded as his tradition claim; not medical advice and not endorsed.
ambiguity: Quantities and safety not given; unclear which three items are the mix (salt, cayenne-garlic, oil).

hindi: सेल्टिक साल्ट लेंगे यह आपके हार्ट की ब्लॉकेजेस खोलता है। ये आपका हैंग ओवर उड़ाता है। ये आपके ब्रेन को पूर्ण नरिशमेंट देता है। आपके शरीर के अंदर सूर्य को मजबूती से स्थापित करता है।
says: Celtic salt, he says, opens heart blockages, removes a hangover, fully nourishes the brain and firmly establishes the Sun in the body. The last point is his astro-body claim, the rest are health claims, not advice.
ambiguity: Mostly repeats earlier health claims; the new element is Sun established in the body.

hindi: और इसके ही दम पर आपके राहु और केतु आपकी बॉडी को डिस्ट्रॉय नहीं कर सकते। आपकी बॉडी डिस्ट्रॉय नहीं होगी।
says: With the Sun established by salt, Rahu and Ketu cannot destroy the body; a strong Sun is the shield against the two nodes.
cells_derived_method: Sun strong in kendra or own/exalted sign shields; Rahu-Ketu on the 1st-7th or 6th-12th axis with a weak Sun would be the vulnerable case.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign in the 1st gives a strong body shield against nodal damage.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 6th with Rahu or Ketu shows low resistance and health vulnerability.

ambiguity: Claim ties a food item to a planetary shield; no chart condition is stated.
classical_check: Sun as vitality is classical; Sun resisting nodes via salt is his own idea.

hindi: मींस स्वर्ग है भाई। सबसे पहला दुख काया रोगी है। सबसे बड़ा सुख निरोगी काया।
says: He calls a healthy body itself heaven and quotes the proverb that the first sorrow is a diseased body and the greatest happiness a healthy one.
cells_derived_method: The 1st house is body and health; strong 1st house and lord indicate the proverbial healthy-body happiness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 1st with a strong Mars gives a robust body, in line with the proverb.
Derived: Pisces in the 1st with an afflicted Jupiter shows sensitive health, where the proverb warns.

ambiguity: No house is named; body is read as the 1st.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Ayurveda saying and the 1st-house body significator.

hindi: तो आपके शरीर के सुख को अगर आप ले पा रहे हैं तो गाड़ी सही चल रही है तो आप भी सही चल रहे हो। ड्राइवर फिट है।
says: If you can enjoy the body's comforts, the vehicle (body) is running right and so are you, the driver, who is fit.
ambiguity: Body-as-vehicle metaphor.

hindi: इस ड्राइवर को फिट रखने के लिए आप भोग और विलास की इच्छा सारे जीवन करेंगे। आप पूरे जन्म चाहेंगे मुंह के अंदर गोलगप्पे का टेस्ट पता चले।
says: To keep the driver fit, one will wish for pleasure and luxury all life, such as wanting to taste a golgappa; the desire for sensory enjoyment is presented as the body's maintenance impulse.
ambiguity: The planet is named in the next sentence, not here.
classical_check: Sensory enjoyment is classically Venus; assigning to Indra differs.

hindi: आप हमेशा चाहेंगे सुंदर कपड़े पहने अच्छे लगे। आप चाहेंगे सब लोगों से प्रेम से मिले। सब आपको प्रेम करें। यह सब इंद्र है।
says: Wanting beautiful clothes, looking good, meeting people with love and being loved by all: he says all of this is Indra, making Uranus the significator of pleasure, appearance and being liked.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in the 1st shows appearance and attractiveness, in the 7th being loved by others, in the 11th wide popularity, in the 2nd good clothes and taste.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 1st in Libra gives an attractive, stylish appearance that draws affection.
Derived: Uranus in the 7th in Aries brings loving but unconventional partners and public admiration.
Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Gemini gives a wide social circle that likes you.

classical_check: Classically these are Venus significations; Indra here differs.

hindi: अगर ऐसा होता है जीवन में प्यार नहीं मिल रहा, शांति नहीं मिल रही, बड़ा नया कपड़ा नहीं मिल रहा, गिफ्ट ही नहीं आती, यार स्वर्ग नाम की चीज़ नहीं है। आपका इंद्र बिगड़ा हुआ है
says: If you get no love, no peace, no new clothes and no gifts, there is no heaven in life, and his diagnosis is that your Indra (Uranus) is spoiled.
cells_derived_method: Uranus afflicted by Saturn, Rahu or in 6th/8th/12th would be the chart picture; the house shows which pleasure is missing: 7th love, 4th peace, 2nd clothes and gifts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 7th in Capricorn afflicted by Saturn gives missing love and cold partnerships.
Derived: Uranus in the 4th in Aries afflicted shows missing peace at home.
Derived: Uranus in the 12th in Taurus afflicted shows lost comforts and unrecognised effort.

hindi: इंद्र की स्थिति सुधारने के लिए आपको सूर्य की शक्ति को सेट करना पड़ेगा। इसके दम पर ही आपको स्वर्ग मिलेगा।
says: To repair a spoiled Indra you must set the Sun's power right; heaven comes through that. The Sun is named as the remedy lever for Uranus.
ambiguity: How to set the Sun is not given here (earlier he mentioned salt and witness awareness).

hindi: स्वर्ग मिलता है लक्ष्मी से। लक्ष्मी माता यह कहा जाता है इंद्र देवता अमरावती के महल में
says: Heaven comes from Lakshmi; it is said Indra lives in the palace of Amaravati, and the sentence continues to place Lakshmi relative to him.
ambiguity: Sentence ends at the chunk break.
classical_check: Indra in Amaravati is Puranic; consistent.

gist: He says heaven is a creation of imagination: rivers flowing, money everywhere, and so on; a description of the popular idea of svarga.
He jokes about Lakshmi sitting apart with so much wealth, people begging to the point of death while Vishnu carries on his programmes with Lakshmi pressing his feet.

hindi: अब यह कमाल की बात हो गई। जो लक्ष्मी माता है, यह इंद्र को क्यों मिलती है? यह जो हमारा नाभि का पोर्टल है, जहां हम लक्ष्मी मैया की बात कर रहे हैं। यह है नाभि।
says: He asks why Lakshmi goes to Indra and answers by pointing to the navel portal, which is the place of Lakshmi in the body and also Indra's seat; navel links Lakshmi and Indra.
ambiguity: The answer is developed through sign and nakshatra mapping in the next sentences.
classical_check: Silent; navel as Lakshmi's seat is a yoga/tantra idea, not a chart rule.

hindi: यह है इंद्र आठ नंबर राशि है यहां वृश्चिक।
says: Indra (Uranus) corresponds to the eighth sign, Scorpio, which is the navel region in his map; Uranus gets Scorpio as its sign.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in Scorpio is at home; in other signs its effect is shaped by the sign's lord. The house shows where Scorpio's depth, secrecy and sudden change appear.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 1st in Scorpio gives an intense, magnetic persona at home in its sign.
Derived: Uranus in the 8th in Scorpio gives deep occult interest and sudden transformations.
Derived: Uranus in the 10th in Scorpio gives power-oriented, research-type careers.

ambiguity: Sign number 8 equals Scorpio per the series numbering.
classical_check: Classically Scorpio is Mars's sign and its body part is the genitals and lower abdomen, not the navel; differs.

hindi: यह यह राशि के बिल्कुल साथ में एक नंबर है और यह मंगल ग्रह हनुमान कॉन्शियसनेस इसकी राशि है। जो एक नंबर राशि है मेष राशि बोलते हैं।
says: Scorpio is paired directly with sign number one, Aries; both are Mars signs, and Mars is Hanuman consciousness. So Indra's Scorpio is tied to Mars's Aries.
cells_derived_method: Aries and Scorpio share the lord Mars, so Uranus in Scorpio and a Mars in Aries are linked; the 8th-from-1st relation shows depth versus direct action.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 1st gives direct, bold action, and Uranus in Scorpio lends it sudden depth.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 8th gives risky, sudden energy aligned to Uranus-in-Scorpio themes.

ambiguity: 'साथ में' means both belong to Mars, not adjacent signs, since Aries and Scorpio are not neighbours.
classical_check: Aries and Scorpio as Mars's two signs is classical; agrees.

hindi: ये स्टार्ट होती है अश्विनी भरणी कृतिका। भरणी नक्षत्र जो है उसकी योनि जो है गज है।
says: Aries is made of the nakshatras Ashwini, Bharani and Krittika (the first quarter), and Bharani's yoni (animal symbol) is the elephant.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries holds Ashwini, Bharani and one pada of Krittika; Bharani's yoni is the elephant.

hindi: गज राहु हाथी और जो पिछली राशि हम लेते हैं जो इसके पहले 12 नंबर राशि है ये केतु के पास है।
says: The elephant is Rahu; the sign before Aries, number twelve (Pisces), belongs to Ketu in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in Pisces would be at home in his scheme; other planets in Pisces are read with Ketu as co-owner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Pisces would be in its own sign, giving strong withdrawal, moksha tendencies and hidden expense.
Derived: Ketu in the 5th in Pisces would give deep intuition but detachment from children and speculation.

ambiguity: Pisces ownership by Ketu is his scheme, not the classical one.
classical_check: Classically Pisces is Jupiter's sign; Ketu co-lordship is a non-standard view.

hindi: लेकिन जिस प्रकार मंगल के दम पर इंद्र चलता है। उस प्रकार बृहस्पति के दम पर केतु चलता है।
says: Just as Indra runs on Mars's strength, Ketu runs on Jupiter's strength; Mars backs Uranus and Jupiter backs Ketu.
cells_derived_method: A strong Mars supports Uranus's results and a strong Jupiter supports Ketu's; Jupiter weak leaves Ketu unsupported.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 4th strengthens a Uranus there, helping sudden home gains.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th strongly supports a Ketu there, making detachment productive.

classical_check: Silent for Uranus and Ketu in this form.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति ग्रह यह रेवती नक्षत्र होता है। केतु को दे रखे है। इसने 12 नंबर राशि अपनी। केतु इसका स्वामी है।
says: Jupiter has given Ketu his twelfth sign (Pisces) with the Revati nakshatra, so Ketu is its lord in this scheme.
ambiguity: Calling Ketu the lord of Revati differs from the standard nakshatra lord.
classical_check: Differs: Revati's lord is Mercury, and Pisces is Jupiter's sign; Ketu rules Ashwini, Magha and Mula.

hindi: एक प्रकार से बृहस्पति का पूर्ण कंट्रोल है। केतु के यहां पर रेवती नक्षत्र है। लास्ट नक्षत्र होता है रेवती। इसकी योनि भी गज है।
says: Jupiter has full control over Ketu through Pisces; Revati, the last nakshatra, is there and its yoni is also the elephant.
classical_check: Revati is the 27th nakshatra with elephant yoni; agrees on those facts.

hindi: यह गज दो ही लोगों के पास है। बाकी पूरे के पूरे नक्षत्र के कहानी के अंदर कहीं नहीं है। एक लक्ष्मी माता के पास है। और दूसरा इंद्र के पास है।
says: The elephant yoni appears only in two nakshatras (Bharani and Revati) and nowhere else; he gives one to Lakshmi (Revati/Pisces) and the other to Indra (Bharani/Aries), which is why both are linked to the elephant.
ambiguity: Which of the two goes to Lakshmi and which to Indra is inferred from his preceding sentences.
classical_check: Agrees that only Bharani and Revati have the elephant yoni; the Lakshmi and Indra assignment is his.

hindi: ये यानी जो हाथी है यह बहुत बड़ा प्रतीक है। और ये सारे सफेद हाथी हैं। गृह हाथी नहीं है।
says: The elephant is a very large symbol, and these are all white elephants; the following phrase is unclear and may mean not domestic elephants but divine ones.
ambiguity: 'गृह हाथी' is probably garbled; could be domestic elephant or planetary elephant.
classical_check: White elephant (Airavata) is Indra's mount; agrees on the imagery.

hindi: यानी केतु को तो साइड करके रखा हुआ है वज्र के द्वारा। ऐसी की तैसी भाई बादल नहीं आएगा बीच में। आपकी आंखों के आगे अंधेरा नहीं है।
says: Ketu has been pushed aside by the vajra, so no cloud will come in the way and there is no darkness before your eyes; strong Indra clears Ketu's obstruction.

hindi: यदि आपका गुरु सेट है तो केतु कुछ ना करेगा। केतु कहेगा ठीक है हुजूर आला हुकुम करो आप क्या करना है?
says: If your Jupiter is well set Ketu does nothing harmful; Ketu becomes obedient and says what is your command.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter strong by own sign, exaltation in Cancer or kendra placement, or aspecting Ketu, makes Ketu docile; the house of Ketu shows the area made obedient.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 5th with Ketu around makes Ketu's detachment constructive for study and children.
Derived: Jupiter weak in the 12th in Scorpio leaves Ketu unmanaged and escapism rises.

classical_check: Jupiter's aspect softening Ketu fits the general benefic-aspect idea.

hindi: मैं तो पूछूं इसीलिए गाय की सेवा करते हैं। शुक्र केतु केतु सेट होता है।
says: This is why people serve cows: the cow is tied to Venus and Ketu, and serving it sets Ketu right. A tradition remedy for Ketu through cow service.
ambiguity: The caption 'शुक्र केतु' is slightly unclear; he links cow service to both planets.
classical_check: Cow service is a classical Ketu remedy; the Venus link agrees with cow and Lakshmi symbolism.

hindi: ये सारे के सारे सुख की स्थितियां कैसे बनती हैं? ये तब बनती हैं जब आपको बुद्धि का सहारा मिलता है। बुद्धिमान कौन है? हाथी।
says: All these comfort conditions arise when intelligence supports you, and the intelligent one is the elephant; Rahu, the elephant, is the intelligence behind material comfort.
classical_check: Elephant as wisdom (Ganesha) is traditional; assigning to Rahu is his own link.

hindi: लक्ष्मी के आसपास हाथी खड़े करने का क्या मतलब है? अदरवाइज एरावत हाथी दे रखा है। इंद्र दौड़ रहा है। उसके ऊपर कहानियां बना रखी हैं।
says: Lakshmi is shown flanked by elephants and Indra has the white elephant Airavata, which signals that both wealth and heavenly power rest on the elephant, i.e. intelligence and Rahu. The stories are built on this symbolism.
classical_check: Gaja-Lakshmi iconography and Airavata are traditional; consistent.

hindi: क्योंकि आपका राहु सेट है और राहु ने चंद्रमा को काबू नहीं किया। आपका मन खुश है। नहीं तो मन खसे उठता रहता है।
says: If Rahu is set and does not overpower the Moon, the mind stays happy; otherwise the mind keeps getting irritated.
cells_derived_method: Rahu conjunct or aspecting the Moon is the overpowering case; the house shows where the irritation lives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with the Moon in the 4th in Cancer gives a restless mind and disturbed home peace.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 1st with Rahu away keeps the mind happy and steady.

ambiguity: 'खसे' is a loose caption; read as irritation.
classical_check: Moon-Rahu affliction (grahan yoga) is classical; agrees.

hindi: जिनका चंद्र केतु साथ होता है उनके भी मन पे बादल छाए होते हैं। बोल ही नहीं पाते। पूरा एक्सप्रेशन ही नहीं होता। कॉन्फिडेंस की टोटल कमी होती है।
says: People with Moon and Ketu together have clouds over the mind, cannot speak out, lack full expression and are low on confidence.
cells_derived_method: Moon-Ketu conjunction in the 1st gives inner blankness about self, in the 2nd it impairs speech, in the 5th it clouds expression and study.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign with Ketu in the 2nd in Cancer gives a tongue-tied, inward manner and hesitant speech.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio with Ketu in the 5th shows foggy thinking and low self-belief.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus with Ketu in the 10th shows capable but unexpressed public presence.

classical_check: Moon-Ketu conjunction giving confusion and low confidence is consistent with classical readings.

hindi: आपके इंद्र की पावर की वजह से आपको हाथी की सवारी मिलेगी। हाथी की सवारी वाले कौन लोग हैं? धरती पर बहुत लोग हैं। बड़ी-बड़ी गाड़ियों में घूमते हैं। फोर व्हीलर गाड़ी होती है। यह हाथी होता है।
says: Because of Indra's power you get an elephant ride, which today means those who travel in big four-wheeler cars; the four-wheeler is the elephant.
cells_derived_method: A strong Uranus with Rahu well placed gives large vehicles; the 4th house shows vehicle gains, so Uranus or Rahu strong in the 4th points to cars.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 4th in Aquarius shows large, modern vehicles.
Derived: Rahu in the 11th in Taurus gives gains that convert into luxury cars.

classical_check: Vehicles are Venus and the 4th house classically; elephant-car equation is his.

hindi: टू व्हीलर स्कूटर होता है। जो बाइक होती है। ये घोड़ा होता है। यदि चंद्रमा अच्छा हो जाए तो आपको घोड़ा मिलता है। साइकिल से शुरुआत होती है इसके अंदर।
says: A two-wheeler such as a scooter or bike is the horse, which comes if the Moon is good, and the progression begins with a bicycle; the Moon gives the smaller horse-level vehicle.
cells_derived_method: Moon strong in the 4th, or its sign Cancer, gives two-wheelers; Moon weak gives only a cycle-level start.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th gives good two-wheeler access.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th keeps vehicles at the cycle level for a time.

classical_check: Silent; Moon rules horse symbol loosely in some Jyotish texts.

hindi: और उसके बाद अगर आपका हाथी का ग्रह बहुत अच्छा है। राहु बहुत अच्छा है। और इंद्र की शक्ति है तो बहुत पावरफुल बढ़िया धांसू गाड़ी नहीं गाड़ियां मिलती हैं।
says: If the elephant planet Rahu is very good and Indra's power is present, you get not just one powerful car but many cars; Rahu and Uranus together multiply vehicles.
cells_derived_method: Rahu well placed, for instance in the 3rd, 6th or 11th, with a strong Uranus gives many vehicles; 4th house factors decide the count.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 11th in Gemini with strong Uranus gives multiple vehicles as part of gains.
Derived: Rahu in the 4th in Taurus with Uranus support gives luxury cars and home comfort.

classical_check: Rahu in 3/6/11 giving gains is classical; vehicles by Rahu is partial.

hindi: तो अगर आपको लग्जरीज चाहिए लाइफ में गाड़ियां ही गाड़ियां चाहिए। गहना, सोना, चांदी, गुच्ची, अरमानी, वसाचे तो ये सारे के सारे इंद्र के पास है। एवरीथिंग
says: If you want luxuries, cars, jewellery, gold, silver and designer brands, all of these are with Indra; Uranus is given the luxury and brand goods domain.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in the 2nd or 11th shows luxury accumulation; in the 7th it shows fashion trade; in the 4th vehicles.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 2nd in Libra shows luxury, jewellery and fashion goods in the possession.
Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Leo shows gains through luxury and prestige goods.

classical_check: Classically gold is Jupiter, silver Venus/Moon, luxury Venus; differs.

hindi: और अगर ये आपको भोग में लेने हैं, विलासिता में लेने है, मस्ती में लेने हैं तो इंद्र का अच्छा होना बहुत जरूरी है।
says: If you want to experience enjoyment, luxury and fun, a good Indra is essential; Uranus's quality decides how much of this you can actually enjoy.
classical_check: Silent for Uranus; Venus is the classical significator.

hindi: क्योंकि यह आपको सांसारिक स्वर्ग जो कि कल्पना का है चिजी्जी वाला उसकी ऊंचाइयों पर ले जाता है। क्योंकि ये अनश्वर नहीं है। मृत्यु होती है।
says: Indra takes you to the heights of the worldly, imagined heaven, but Indra is not immortal, since the post of Indra has death; the heaven he gives is therefore temporary.
ambiguity: The caption in the middle is garbled; the claim is read from the surrounding sentences.
classical_check: Indra as a mortal post-holder is Puranic; agrees.

hindi: इसलिए यह भगवान नहीं है। यह अवतार नहीं है। यह देवों का देवता सुपर ह्यूमन है।
says: So Indra is not God and not an avatar; he is a superhuman king of the gods, which places Uranus below the divine level of Vishnu or Shiva.
classical_check: Consistent with Puranic status of Indra as a deva, not an ishvara.

hindi: यानी कि इसकी आप पूजा करते हैं तो भी ठीक नहीं करते तो भी कोई बात नहीं है। यह आपके लिए इष्ट योग्य देवता नहीं है। लेकिन आप यदि
says: Worshipping Indra is optional: fine if you do, no matter if you do not, as he is not fit to be your chosen deity (ishta). The sentence breaks at the end with a contrast about doing remedies.
ambiguity: Final fragment 'लेकिन आप यदि' continues beyond this batch.
classical_check: Classically Indra is worshipped for rain and power but not as an ishta; agrees.

hindi: कर्म ही ऐसा कर रहे हैं कि यार मजा आ रहा है, बढ़िया चल रहा है भाई तो समझो आपने इंद्र एक्टिवेट किया हुआ है कुंडली के अंदर।
says: If your actions are such that life is enjoyable and running well, he says you have activated Indra (Uranus) in your chart; good flow of life is the sign of an active Uranus.
cells_derived_method: Which area runs well depends on where Uranus sits: in the 11th gains, in the 5th fun and creativity, in the 7th partnerships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Aquarius, an active Uranus, shows social and income flow running smoothly.
Derived: Uranus in the 5th in Libra active shows creative and romantic life being enjoyable.

ambiguity: Activation is behavioural, not a dasha or transit trigger.

hindi: इंद्र की बहुत बड़ी कमी है। वह सजा बहुत जल्दी देता है।
says: Indra's big flaw is that he punishes very quickly; Uranus gives fast, sudden penalties for wrong conduct.
classical_check: Silent for Uranus; Saturn is classically the slow punisher, so this is a contrast.

hindi: उसकी बहुत बड़ी खासियत है। वह गिफ्टें बहुत ज्यादा देता है।
says: Indra's great strength is that he gives gifts in large quantity; Uranus is a big giver of rewards.

hindi: उसकी बहुत सबसे सुंदर बात यह है कि वो कहता है खाओ, खिलाओ, उड़ाओ, मस्ती मारो।
says: The most beautiful trait of Indra is his motto: eat, feed others, spend freely and enjoy; Uranus favours generous, festive living.

gist: He asks the listener to appreciate the quality, and notes some religions apply these feast-and-celebrate teachings: feed and drink well and enjoy everything.

hindi: कितना पैसा आता है, कितना सामान आ रहा है। कैसे आ रहा है? क्योंकि वो कह रहा है पार्टी पूरी करेंगे। कमी कोई नहीं छोड़ेंगे।
says: Money and goods flow in to the person who follows Indra's way because he says the party will be done fully with nothing left lacking; open, full hosting is what draws wealth.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in the 2nd or 11th makes this flow of money and goods most visible.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 2nd in Sagittarius shows wealth arriving through generosity and hosting.
Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Scorpio shows gains arriving through social and party-type networks.

hindi: यह दान की बात नहीं हो रही है। दान नहीं है। इंद्र में कोई दान दानवीर तो कर्ण था। इंद्र उंद्र का कोई लेन देन नहीं।
says: This is not charity; the great giver was Karna, whereas Indra has no give-and-take transaction. Indra's way is shared enjoyment, not donation or exchange.
classical_check: Karna as the great donor is from the Mahabharata; agrees. Silent on Uranus.

hindi: वो कहता है पार्टी खाओगे बढ़ाओगे तुम भी खाओ तुम भी पियो। तुम भी मजे करो। ऐसे व्यक्ति का इंद्र बढ़ता है।
says: Indra says that when you enjoy the party you should let others eat, drink and enjoy too; a person who shares the party in this way has his Indra grow, which is a remedy-style rule.

hindi: और इंद्र बढ़ने से क्या होता है? आपके जीवन में साजो समान चिज्जियां बहुत ज्यादा बढ़ती हैं और वो चिज्जियां बढ़ने के कारण आपके शरीर का स्वर्ग पूर्ण रूप से प्रोटेक्टेड रहता है।
says: When Indra grows, possessions and goods multiply in life, and because of those goods the body's heaven stays fully protected; material comfort is tied to bodily well-being in his scheme.
ambiguity: How goods protect the body is not explained.

hindi: हमारे शरीर में दो ही जगह है।
says: A lead-in fragment saying the body has only two places, with the places named in the next chunk (portals).
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk break.

hindi: पोर्टल सूर्य और चंद्रमा का एक पोर्टल ये है दूसरा पोर्टल हमारा नाभि का है जो सबसे इंपॉर्टेंट है नाभि और तीसरा पोर्टल हमारा है प्रजनन केंद्र
says: He gives three body portals: one for the Sun and Moon (the head area, he points to it), the second the navel, the most important, and the third the reproductive centre. Earlier lines about the area are garbled.
ambiguity: Opening caption 'यहां पर ये एरिया ... ये भी मिल गई' is garbled; the head location is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; yogic centres are a different framework from Kalapurusha.

hindi: ये तीन पोर्टल्स हैं जहां राशि नंबर एक है यहां एक नंबर राशि है। आठ नंबर राशि है। चार नंबर राशि है। पांच नौ और 12 यह राशियां हैं
says: The portals correspond to signs numbered 1, 8, 4, 5, 9 and 12, that is Aries, Scorpio, Cancer, Leo, Sagittarius and Pisces; these are the fire and water signs that he marks as the manifestation points.
cells_derived_method: A planet in these six signs sits at a portal of manifestation and its results come through more readily. The other six signs (Taurus, Gemini, Virgo, Libra, Capricorn, Aquarius) are not portal signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 10th in Aries, a portal sign, manifests career results readily.
Derived: a planet in the 4th in Scorpio, a portal sign, manifests home and mind matters strongly.
Derived: a planet in the 7th in Gemini is not at a portal sign, so manifestation is less direct on his scheme.

ambiguity: The numbers 1, 8, 4, 5, 9, 12 are read in his sign numbering (Aries = 1); he later says 'दो चार छह' in a way that does not match.
classical_check: Silent; grouping of fire and water signs matches classical triplicities.

hindi: जहां पर आदि अंत और मध्य तीन नाड़ियां मिलती हैं। यानी आपकी जीवन के अंदर चिजी्जी बनाने की मैनिफेस्टेशन के पोर्टल्स।
says: At these signs the three nadis (adi, madhya, antya) meet, so they are the manifestation portals for bringing things into life.
ambiguity: Adi-madhya-antya are also the nadi types in nakshatra matching; the link to these signs is his own.
classical_check: Three nadis (adi, madhya, antya) exist in Ashtakoota matching; the sign mapping is not classical.

hindi: हम कौन से केंद्र पर शरीर में है? वहां से जब विश करते हैं तो आपको
says: From whichever body centre you are wishing, the cosmos responds from that centre; the sentence continues into the next chunk with the cosmos giving what is asked.
ambiguity: Sentence ends at the chunk break.

hindi: कॉस्मोस देता है। हम कॉस्मोस से क्या मांगते हैं?
says: The cosmos gives what is wished from the centre one is using; he sets up the question of what we actually ask the cosmos for.

gist: He remarks that some fools even ask for death, wishing it on themselves or the neighbour, and says we ask in very different ways.

hindi: तो हमारा जो मंगतापन है वो तीन मुख्य पोर्टल है। यहां पर मध्यम मध्य नाड़ी हो गई हमारी सुषुम्ना एक हो गई आदि एक अंत्य।
says: Our asking happens through three main portals, with the middle nadi being the sushumna and the other two being the adi and antya sides.
ambiguity: Caption partly garbled.
classical_check: Sushumna as the central channel is yogic; ties to nakshatra nadis are his own.

hindi: इदा पिंगला और बीच में सुषुम्ना। ये तीनों नाड़ियों के इन पोर्टल्स को टच करते हैं।
says: Ida and Pingala with Sushumna in the middle; all three channels touch these portals.
ambiguity: Planet links (Ida as Moon, Pingala as Sun) are not stated here.
classical_check: Ida, Pingala and Sushumna as the three main nadis agrees with yoga texts.

hindi: ये तीन ये छह राशियां हैं। दो चार छह जहां पर ये तीनों नाड़ियों का पोर्टल अंतरिक्ष से कनेक्ट होता है।
says: These are the six signs at which the three nadi portals connect to space; the numbers he says here, two four six, do not match his earlier list of 1, 8, 4, 5, 9, 12.
ambiguity: Caption numbers 'दो चार छह' conflict with the earlier list; either garbled caption or a different grouping. Cells are not asserted.

hindi: ये हमारा स्वाधिष्ठान केंद्र है ये नाभि। नाभि के पास ही इंद्र है।
says: He names the navel as the Svadhisthana centre and places Indra right at the navel; Uranus sits at the navel portal in his body map.
ambiguity: In yoga Svadhisthana lies below the navel and the navel centre is Manipura.
classical_check: Differs from yoga: Manipura is the navel chakra; Svadhisthana is the lower, water chakra.

hindi: आपको स्वर्ग लोक की जितनी चीजें मांगनी है नाभि पे ध्यान करके मांगी जाती हैं।
says: All the heavenly, worldly things you want to ask for should be asked while meditating on the navel; a meditation-remedy with the navel as Indra's centre.

hindi: ज्ञान की चीजें मांगोगे यहां से मांगोगे। संतान चीजें आगे कुछ बनाएं। अगली संतति के लिए दें। डीएनए रिलेटेड वो सारी उसके नीचे वाटर चक्र पे
says: Wishes for knowledge are asked from the upper centre he points to; wishes for children, creating something forward, the next generation and DNA matters are asked from the water chakra below the navel.
ambiguity: The location for knowledge ('here') is gestural and not stated in words.
classical_check: Svadhisthana as the water chakra tied to procreation agrees with yoga.

gist: He says we often do not know from where we are vibrating because we live unconsciously, and the world lives intoxicated without drinking.
He clarifies that he does not mean that drinking is a sin, only that he is talking about drinking.

hindi: ऐसे बहुत से लोग हैं जो शराब पी के भी होश में हैं। और ऐसे लोग हैं जिन्होंने शराब पी ही नहीं और बेहोश हैं।
says: Many people stay aware after drinking and many who never drank are unconscious in life; awareness is a matter of inner state, not of whether one drinks.
ambiguity: Not an endorsement of drinking.

hindi: अगर आपको रियलाइजेशन ही नहीं है, आप क्या सोच रहे हैं? आप कर क्या रहे हैं? कहां जा रहे हैं? तो आपका गुरु भी आपको कुछ टीच नहीं कर सकता। क्योंकि सारे टाइम आप इंद्र में फंसे हुए हैं।
says: If you have no awareness of what you think, do or where you are going, even your guru cannot teach you because you are always stuck in Indra, in sensory heaven.
ambiguity: 'Guru' may mean the human teacher or Jupiter.

gist: He pictures someone sitting in a Shiva temple while planning a film, popcorn and fun afterwards, the mind running elsewhere.

hindi: यह सब इंद्र भ्रष्ट कर देता है आपको।
says: All this distraction is Indra spoiling the native; the pull of sensory desire derails attention.

hindi: अब इंद्र होना भी आवश्यक है कि आपके पास चीजें भी हो लेकिन उस रूप रंग रस में आप पागल ना हो जाए।
says: Indra is still necessary so that you have possessions, but one must not go mad in the form, colour and taste of it; a balance rule.

hindi: चार युग बीतने के पश्चात 432000 वर्ष का एक युग होता है। चतुर युग बीतने के बाद जब 71 बार वह बीत जाते हैं। चार युग * 71 टाइम्स 71 इसे एक मनवंतर कहते हैं।
says: After the four yugas, with his figure of 432,000 years per yuga, a cycle repeats 71 times and that makes one manvantara.
ambiguity: 432,000 is the length of the Kali yuga; the four-yuga set (chaturyuga) is 4,320,000 years.
classical_check: A manvantara is about 71 chaturyugas, so the 71 agrees; his 432,000 per set is off by a factor of ten.

hindi: हर मनवंतर का एक इंद्र है। फिर इंद्र
says: Each manvantara has its own Indra, and the Indra is then replaced; the sentence completes in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees with Puranic accounts that each manvantara has an Indra.

hindi: बदल दिया जाता है। इतनी लंबी आयु है इंद्र की। यानी जो कॉस्मिक आयु के सिस्टम में देख के चल तो इंद्र बहुत ज्यादा लंबी आयु वाला देवता है
says: The Indra is changed after each manvantara; so by cosmic age scales Indra is a very long-lived deity.
classical_check: Consistent with the Puranic view of Indra as a post held for a manvantara.

hindi: और यह मालिक कहा जाता है एक मनवंतर का। ऐसे मनवंतर चलते चले जाते हैं लगातार और ब्रह्मा की जो 311 ट्रिलियन इयर्स की ऐज है उसके अंदर कई बार ये बदलते हैं।
says: Indra is called the master of one manvantara; manvantaras run on continuously and within Brahma's age of about 311 trillion years the Indra changes many times.
classical_check: Brahma's life of about 311.04 trillion years is the standard Puranic figure; agrees.

hindi: इसे प्रजापति भी कहा जाता है। यानी लगभग लगभग ब्रह्मा जैसा ब्रह्मा के बच्चे मान के चलो।
says: Indra is also called a Prajapati, so treat him as nearly like Brahma, as a child of Brahma.
classical_check: Prajapati as a title is given to creator-sages; Indra is not classically a Prajapati, so this differs.

hindi: ये पोर्टल्स हैं जहां से आप मांगते हैं। तो आपने इंद्र के लिए जो मांगा अब आपकी कुंडली में इंद्र जैसा बैठा हुआ है यूरेनस अगर खराब राशि का बैठा है और आप उससे बढ़िया मांग रहे हैं तो नहीं देगा।
says: These portals are where you ask from, but if your Uranus sits in a bad sign in the chart, then asking Indra for something excellent will not be granted; the sign condition of Uranus limits what it can give.
cells_derived_method: A well-placed Uranus (home in Scorpio, friendly signs, kendra) grants large requests; a Uranus in a hostile sign grants only modest ones. The house shows the area of the request.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus at home in Scorpio in the 10th can grant big career requests.
Derived: Uranus in a hostile sign in the 2nd in Taurus will not deliver a large wealth request.

ambiguity: Which signs are bad for Uranus is not stated.

hindi: फिर हम रोते पिटते मैनिफेस्टेशन क्यों नहीं हो रही है? हमारी बॉडी विटामिन डी की गोली खाई तो ठीक ठीक हो गया। फिर छोड़ दी तो फिर कम हो गया। यानी बॉडी विटामिन डी नहीं बना रही। यानी आपके बॉडी का ये पोर्टल खराब है।
says: Asking why manifestation fails, he gives the vitamin D example: if the level drops after stopping the pill the body is not producing it, which shows the body's portal is faulty. A health-linked sign, recorded as claimed, not diagnosis.
ambiguity: Vitamin D from sunlight is also his Sun link, but he does not say so here.

hindi: तो पहला संकेत ये होगा आपकी नाभि में गड़बड़ है। अगर आपका सांस
says: The first sign that the navel portal is disturbed is given in the following lines, starting with breath trouble.
ambiguity: Sentence breaks at the chunk boundary.

hindi: जल्दी फूलने लगा है। अगर आपका पेट खराब रहता है। आपका हाजमा ठीक नहीं है। भैया पहले वो ठीक करो।
says: Signs of a disturbed navel are breathlessness, a bad stomach and weak digestion, and he says fix that first before anything else. A body-sign claim, not diagnosis or medical advice.
classical_check: Silent; digestion is classically Sun (agni) and Mars.

hindi: कुछ मांग बैठोगे उन दिनों में हमने तो परमात्मा से मांग लेना है। उल्टा ही फेंक के मारेगा वो। आप कहोगे हमारी पुकार क्यों नहीं सुन रहा वो भाई?
says: If you ask the divine for something while your body portal is in that state, it will throw the request back at you, and then you wonder why your call is not heard.

hindi: इसीलिए लंबी-लंबी तपस्या कर रहे हैं। जो ज्ञानी व्यक्ति है वो जानता है पहले ठीक क्या? पहले बॉडी का पोर्टल ठीक करो।
says: That is why people do long penance without result; a wise person knows the first thing to fix is the body's portal.
classical_check: Silent; echoes the Sanskrit saying that the body is the first means of dharma.

hindi: आपकी नाभि ठीक होनी चाहिए। ना भी डरी हुई नहीं होनी चाहिए ना भी राहु केतु को सेट करके चलनी चाहिए
says: The navel must be healthy, not fearful, and must have Rahu and Ketu set; the navel centre is the base for Rahu-Ketu control as well.

hindi: यानी आप किसी इल्लुजन में नशे में नहीं है फालतू के सपने नहीं देख रहे फालतू की बकवासबाजी में नहीं किसी दूसरे के बहकावे में नहीं है
says: This means you are not in an illusion or intoxication, not chasing idle dreams or idle chatter, and not being misled by others; the conditions for Rahu and Ketu being set.
classical_check: Rahu as illusion and intoxication is classical; agrees in spirit.

hindi: अगर बहकावे में आना है तो गुरु के आओ और गुरु आपको बेवकूफ बना रहा है तो फल वो लेगा दुख दरिद्रता का आप बेवकूफ बन के लूट लोगे सोचो कोटा पूरा हो गया आगे अच्छा मिलेगा
says: If you must be misled, be misled by a guru; if he is cheating you, he bears the fruit of sorrow and poverty, while you, though fooled, should think your quota of loss is done and better will come. A karma claim.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled; meaning reconstructed from context.
classical_check: Silent; a karma-based moral claim, not a chart rule.

hindi: लेकिन इंद्र का पोर्टल नाभि का पोर्टल है जो आपको चिजी देगा आ हा बहुत सारा मजा आया जी स्वर्ग बना
says: The portal through which Indra gives you things is the navel portal, and it is the one that makes heaven happen with a lot of fun.

hindi: तो जब किसी की लाइफ के अंदर स्वर्ग नहीं बन रहा है। मींस वो डरा रहता है। उसको डर रहता ही है। वह सारे टाइम भोग ही नहीं पाता है।
says: When a person's life is not turning into heaven it means he is permanently afraid and cannot enjoy things at all; fear is the block on Indra's gifts.
cells_derived_method: Fear shows through the 4th (inner peace), 8th (fear of loss) and 12th (anxiety) placements of Uranus or Ketu, or a weak Moon.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 8th in Cancer shows fear of sudden loss that blocks enjoyment.
Derived: Uranus in the 4th in Capricorn shows a cold, anxious home atmosphere in which pleasures are not enjoyed.

hindi: लोगों के पास पैसा है, कपड़ा है, अलमारियों में पड़ा
says: Many people have money and clothes but they just lie in cupboards unused; the sentence continues in the next chunk about gifts rotting.
ambiguity: Continues at 48:07.

hindi: है। आए हुए गिफ्ट जो है वो अलमारी में पड़े सड़ जाते हैं।
says: Gifts received sit in cupboards and rot unused, showing a blocked Indra that cannot enjoy what it has.

hindi: ऐसा होता है कि बच्चे भोग के ऐश पार्टी करते हैं। माता-पिता कह रहे हैं हम तो कमा-कमा के मर गए। सबने अपना इंद्र डिस्टर्ब किया हुआ है।
says: A common pattern is children enjoying wealth in parties while the parents say they earned and exhausted themselves; everyone in this story has a disturbed Indra, meaning enjoyment is out of step across generations.
cells_derived_method: Parents' enjoyment is read from the 4th and 9th houses and children's from the 5th; Uranus afflicted in these shows the mismatch.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus afflicted in the 9th in Leo shows a father who earns hard but cannot enjoy it.
Derived: Uranus in the 5th in Aquarius shows children who spend more freely than parents approve.

hindi: इंद्र कुंडली के अंदर कहां बैठा है? यह यूरेनस की पोजीशन से बैठता है।
says: Indra's position in the chart is simply the position of Uranus; to find where Indra sits, read Uranus's house and sign.
cells_derived_method: The Uranus house shows the life area of Indra's gifts; the Uranus sign shows how it behaves.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 3rd in Aries puts Indra's gifts in effort, courage and communication.
Derived: Uranus in the 9th in Pisces puts Indra's gifts in belief, travel and teachers.

hindi: आप सोच के चल इंद्र कितना ज्यादा आवश्यक है। कितना इंपॉर्टेंट है। हमारी सारी ज्ञानेंद्रियां और कर्मेंद्रियां ये इंद्र है।
says: Indra is extremely important because all our sense organs and organs of action are Indra; the senses and the body's action organs are Uranus's domain in his scheme.
classical_check: The word indriya is linked to Indra in Sanskrit, so the link is etymologically supported; classical Jyotish does not give senses to Uranus.

hindi: अब बताओ कौन व्यक्ति है जो अपनी ज्ञानेंद्रियों के बिना जी सकता है? आंख, नाक, कान, छूना, टच, स्वाद सब कुछ त्वचा ये सारी तो हमारी ज्ञानेंद्रियां इसी से तो पता चलता है हमारा। नहीं तो हमें कैसे पता?
says: No one can live without the five senses, eye, nose, ear, touch and taste, which is how we know anything; this makes Indra indispensable.
classical_check: The five jnanendriyas are standard; their assignment to Uranus is his.

hindi: अगर आपके मुंह का स्वाद खराब है, आपको स्वास की तकलीफ है, कानों का लफड़े ईएनटी के पेशेंट बने बैठे हुए हो, त्वचा में कोई रोग आ रहा है। आपका इंद्र डिस्टर्बड है। त्वचा क्या
says: Trouble with taste, breathing, ears (ENT problems) or skin means your Indra is disturbed; sense-organ problems are read as signs of an afflicted Uranus. A health-sign claim, not diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Uranus afflicted in the 2nd points to mouth and taste, in the 3rd to ears, in the 4th to chest and breath, in the 1st to skin.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus afflicted in the 2nd in Virgo shows taste and mouth trouble.
Derived: Uranus afflicted in the 3rd in Libra shows ear and hearing issues.
Derived: Uranus afflicted in the 4th in Gemini shows breathing and chest trouble.

ambiguity: Sentence ends at the batch end with a fragment about skin.
classical_check: Classically these are tied to other planets and houses; Uranus link is his own.

hindi: होती है? केतु। केतु कौन है? बादल। बादल से बारिश कौन कराता है? इंद्र। बिजली कड़का के।
says: Continuing the skin discussion, he says the cause is Ketu, who is the cloud; and the one who makes the cloud rain by thundering lightning is Indra, so Uranus is the cure for the Ketu problem.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the 1st or 6th shows skin troubles; Uranus aspecting or conjoining that Ketu is the remedial pairing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 1st in Virgo shows skin sensitivity; Uranus influence would be the cloud-breaker.
Derived: Ketu in the 6th in Pisces shows chronic skin or allergy trouble that an active Uranus would relieve.

ambiguity: The opening word (the disease subject) is cut off; skin is inferred from the earlier sentence.
classical_check: Skin is classically Mercury and Saturn; Ketu-Uranus mechanism is his own.

hindi: यानी इंद्र को ठीक कर लो। त्वचा ठीक होगी। इंद्र ठीक करने के लिए क्या करना है? नाभि। नाभि के बाद किस पे जाना है? गुरु के पास।
says: Fix Indra and the skin will be fine; to fix Indra start with the navel, and after the navel go to the guru, which here is Jupiter. A health-linked claim, not diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Guru' read as Jupiter from the next sentence.

hindi: बृहस्पति ठीक करना है कुंडली के अंदर। लीवर वो डिटॉक्स करेगा तो ठीक होगी स्किन। त्वचा के सारे रोग इंद्र के पास है।
says: Jupiter must be set right in the chart because it detoxifies the liver, and that heals the skin; he states that all skin diseases belong to Indra.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter weak in the 6th or 8th, or afflicted, makes liver and skin trouble more likely; the Uranus house shows where the skin trouble centres.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 6th shows liver weakness feeding skin trouble.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st protects the liver and skin by his logic.

ambiguity: A health claim recorded as stated; not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Jupiter for the liver is classical; skin to Uranus is not.

hindi: जीभ बोलने में बदतमीज हो। गंदा ही बोलते हो। बकवास करे बिना भौके बिना चैन नहीं पड़ता। इंद्र डिस्टर्बड है।
says: A foul, rude tongue that cannot rest without ranting is a sign that Indra is disturbed; abusive speech is read as an afflicted Uranus.
cells_derived_method: Uranus afflicted in the 2nd (speech) or 3rd (expression) gives this tongue; with Mars or Rahu it becomes abusive.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus with Mars-type affliction in the 2nd in Aries shows harsh, abusive speech.
Derived: Uranus afflicted in the 3rd in Gemini shows constant ranting and gossip.

classical_check: Harsh speech is classically from Mars or Rahu in the 2nd; Uranus link is his.

gist: He mimics party talk, you eat too, I ate, enjoy brother, forget it, in the casual voice of Indra's carefree style.

hindi: वैसे हम नाभि को क्या कहते हैं? भाड़ में जाए केंद्र। हनुमान जी तटस्थ थे। हिले नहीं गलती से भी।
says: A garbled passage about the navel centre in which Hanuman is called neutral and unmoved even by mistake; it seems to contrast Mars's steadiness with Indra's restlessness but the caption is unclear.
ambiguity: The first phrase is an idiom or a caption slip; the Hanuman link is uncertain.
classical_check: Hanuman as the Mars deity is a common association; agrees.

hindi: इंद्र कौन है? या चालाक है। यह अपना स्वर्ग बचाने के लिए नौटंकी, चालाकी, रूप बदलना, छिछोरापन, घटियापन सबका असर कर सकता है।
says: Indra is cunning: to protect his heaven he can use drama, trickery, shape-changing, flirtatiousness and lowness; Uranus carries clever, shifty and shape-shifting traits.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in the 3rd or 7th makes this trickery show in communication or dealings; in the 10th it shows in career manoeuvring.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 3rd in Gemini shows quick, shape-shifting communication and clever manoeuvres.
Derived: Uranus in the 10th in Scorpio shows strategic, concealed tactics in career.

classical_check: Indra's trickery is documented in the Puranas; Uranus as trickster is modern.

gist: He laments that we forget the good things in our scriptures and remember the bad.
He says poor Indra was defamed as a man who abducted other men's wives, calls that a leela and maya, and says people forget thousands of good things about him.
He says that is not to be discussed and begins to refer to Osho's one lecture, continued in the next chunk.
