He mentions that Osho's lecture Sambhog Se Samadhi labelled sex a guru and says people make a fuss only about sex.

hindi: सेक्स को गंदा बोलने वाले सब व्यक्तियों का इंद्र खराब होता है और इंद्रियों पे इफेक्ट आता है।
says: People who call sex dirty have a spoiled Indra, and this shows up as effects on their senses; suppression of natural desire is linked to afflicted Uranus.
cells_derived_method: Uranus afflicted in the 5th, 7th or 8th (sexual and relationship houses) would show this attitude and its sensory effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus afflicted in the 7th in Capricorn shows cold, repressed attitudes to intimacy.
Derived: Uranus afflicted in the 8th in Virgo shows shame and suppression around sexuality.

ambiguity: A moral-psychological claim, not a measured one.

hindi: इंद्रियां क्या कर रही है? देख रही है इसको बढ़िया अच्छा लग रहा है। लेकिन नहीं नहीं पाप नहीं करेंगे। करेंगे क्या? खा कर दिया तुमने।
says: The senses see and like something, but the person says no, I will not sin; he says in effect you have already done it, because the senses are engaged.

hindi: तुम कर चुके हो। तुम्हारी इंद्रियां इसी पर लगी हुई है। कर्म इंद्रियां अलग कार्य कर रही है। एक्सकशन का काम हो रहा है। प्रजनन का कार्य हो रहा है।
says: The senses are fixed on the thing, so you have already acted mentally; meanwhile the organs of action carry on separate functions such as excretion and reproduction.
classical_check: The five karmendriyas include excretion and procreation; agrees.

hindi: हाथ काम कर रहे हैं। मुंह काम कर रहा है। पैर काम कर रहे हैं। पांच कर्मेंद्र पांच ज्ञानेंद्रियां ये काम कर ही रही है। 11वा मन है।
says: Hands, mouth and feet work too; the five organs of action and the five organs of knowledge are all operating, and the eleventh is the mind.
ambiguity: He does not name the Moon here, but the mind is the Moon's domain.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sankhya count of eleven indriyas including manas.

gist: He asks how the mind (munna) is set and says that is a separate story for later.

hindi: लेकिन ये इंद्रियां अगर डिफेक्टेड है ढंग से पैर नहीं चलते हाथ ढंग से नहीं चल रहा है। मींस आपने अंदर कुड़कुड़ के सड़ के सबको गालियां बक रखी है।
says: If the organs are defective, with feet and hands not working well, it means you have been inwardly seething and abusing everyone; organ defects are read as inner resentment. Not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: A causal claim about disability that is behavioural; flagged.

hindi: अपने जीवन के स्वर्ग को अगर आपने नष्ट नहीं करना है टीम की तरह काम करो। इंद्र के पास बहुत बड़ी टीम है।
says: To avoid destroying the heaven of your life, work like a team, since Indra has a very big team; Uranus succeeds through cooperation.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in the 11th (groups) or 3rd (colleagues) makes teamwork the key remedy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Libra thrives on team and network collaboration.
Derived: Uranus in the 3rd in Sagittarius works best through group effort with siblings or colleagues.

hindi: पूरी टीम ले जाता है। वो हमला करता है और खत्म कर देता है। वृतासुर नाम
says: Indra takes his whole team, attacks and finishes the enemy; he introduces the story of the asura Vritra which is told in the next chunk.
ambiguity: Sentence continues at 51:02.
classical_check: Agrees with the Vritra story in Puranas.

hindi: के असुर को इसने जिसने सारे के कहते हैं वो सांप की शक्ल का था और उसने सारे धरती का पानी सोख लिया था। तो सांप ने क्या किया? चंद्रमा को खा गया।
says: Indra killed the asura Vritra, said to be serpent-shaped, who had sucked up all the earth's water; in his telling the serpent swallowed the Moon.
ambiguity: Vritra swallowing the Moon is his addition to the myth.
classical_check: Vritra as a serpent holding back the waters is in the Rigveda; the swallowing of the Moon is not in the standard account.

hindi: राहु और केतु यह चंद्रमा यहां बैठे चंद्रमा को खराब कर देते हैं।
says: Rahu and Ketu spoil the Moon placed with or near them, so the serpent myth maps onto the Moon-node affliction in a chart.
cells_derived_method: Moon conjunct Rahu or Ketu spoils the mind in the house concerned: 4th peace, 1st self, 5th intellect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th with Rahu is spoiled in its calm even though strong.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 1st with Ketu is gravely clouded.

classical_check: Moon with Rahu or Ketu as an affliction is classical; agrees.

hindi: उसका पेट फाड़ा इंद्र ने अपने वज्र के प्रहार से और सारा पानी वापस धरती को दे दिया।
says: Indra split the serpent's belly with his vajra and released all the water back to the earth; Uranus frees what the nodes had locked up.

hindi: तो आपके जीवन के अंदर जब आंसू तक नहीं निकल रहे हैं। आप रो भी नहीं पा रहे हैं। और आपको यह लग रहा है हम करें क्या? अंदर पानी सूख चुका है। पानी खत्म हो गया।
says: When you cannot even cry and feel there is nothing to do, with the inner water dried up, he reads that as the Vritra condition in which the Moon's waters are blocked and Indra is not working.
cells_derived_method: Moon afflicted by Rahu or Ketu, or Uranus weak, shows emotional dryness; in the 4th or 12th it appears as inner emptiness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th with node affliction shows emotional drought at home.
Derived: Moon in the 12th in Aquarius with Rahu shows tearless suppression and sleeplessness.

classical_check: Moon afflicted by nodes as emotional dryness agrees in spirit.

hindi: मींस आपको डब्ल्यूबीसी की प्रॉब्लम सारी की सारी एलर्जीज़ आपकी इंद्र की वजह से हैं। जितने लोग लैक्टोस इनटोलरेंट है, पानी से संबंधित जितनी भी प्रॉब्लम्स हैं,
says: White blood cell trouble and all allergies, lactose intolerance and water-related problems are attributed to a bad Indra; allergy and immunity issues are put under Uranus. A health claim as stated, not diagnosis.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next one on food allergy tests.

hindi: अब ये यहीं पर आके बुध की राशि में आता है। इंद्र आकाश का देवता माना जाता है। ये आकाश का पोर्टल है। गर्दन जो गला है। दोनों राशियों में बढ़िया फल देता है।

hindi: बड़ी विचित्र सी बात है। देव गुरु है ये। राहु के ऊपर भी सवारी करता है। राहु का यह मित्र मित्र नहीं है। राहु हाथ जोड़ता है। आइए महाराज घर आए हैं।
says: Strangely, in this sign Indra rides Rahu and Rahu, though not his friend, folds hands and welcomes him as a guest; the caption also says deva guru, which is probably a slip for deva raja. Uranus in Rahu's Virgo is welcomed by Rahu.

hindi: तो राहु स्वागत करता है यहां और राहु जब यहां आता है तो ऐसी तैसी फेर देता है।

hindi: राहु यहां आके तंग करता है। आपके पेट में डलती है ना शराब, अय्याशी, खराबी, बर्बादी

hindi: और क्या करता है? बुद्धि भ्रष्ट कर देता है। ऊपर का पोर्टल उड़ा देता है। ये खत्म। सोच समझ भी खत्म कर देता है। 1% भी फल नहीं देता।

hindi: इंद्र शुक्र के साथ अय्याशी बना देता है। बुरी तरह दो नंबर राशि में भयंकर अय्याशी कराता है।

hindi: एक प्रकार से यहां 10 नंबर का जाता है। बहुत मस्त है। शनि के घर गया। शनि तो सेवक है। शनि कहता है राजा जी आए हैं। हां जी प्रणाम।

hindi: सूर्य से तो शत्रुता मैं कर लूंगा। इंद्र से शत्रुता नहीं करता है शनि इतना। लेकिन शत्रु तो है। क्योंकि यह सूर्य का ही रिप्रेजेंटेटिव है।

classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not use Uranus. Classical 8th house is mixed-to-bad, so this is a modern Gautam reading.

hindi: बंदा कहेगा यार मैं तो मरने से पहले सारा स्वर्ग यहीं देख लिया।
says: The native will feel he has seen all of heaven here on earth before dying; this is the lived result he attaches to Uranus in the eleventh sign sitting in the 8th house, a life of abundant pleasures and a content end.
cells_derived_method: Same logic as the previous line: the feeling of 'heaven' is felt through whichever house the Aquarius-type sign falls in. Here the house is the 8th, so it is felt through hidden gains, unusual experiences and long life themes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; hidden, unexpected or inherited comforts arrive and the person feels richly experienced by late life.

ambiguity: Cell is inferred from the context; he never names the 8th house together with the sign in this exact sentence.
classical_check: Silent on Uranus; wording is illustrative rather than a classical rule.

hindi: कितनी शानदार राशि है।
says: He calls the 11-number sign (Aquarius) a splendid sign for Indra: Uranus there is comfortable and gives enjoyment, in contrast to its harsher signs.
cells_derived_method: The sign quality (Aquarius, fixed air, ruled by Saturn or Pluto in his scheme) stays constant; the department of life where the splendour is felt depends on the house, for example 2nd house gives family wealth comforts, 10th house gives career fame.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; Uranus in Aquarius in the 2nd gives pleasant, unconventional income and family life.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus; Uranus in Aquarius in the 10th gives a career in technology, networks or public causes with status.

ambiguity: 'This sign' is only fixed as number 11 by the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; Uranus is not in classical texts, though Aquarius itself is Saturn's sign.

hindi: अगर आपका इंद्र यूरेनस इस राशि में आता है।
says: Conditional opening: if your Indra, meaning Uranus, falls in this particular sign (the 11-number sign), then the good results described next follow. It also confirms he uses Indra and Uranus as the same planet.
ambiguity: The sign is only named in the next sentence as number 11.
classical_check: Silent; Indra equals Uranus is his own naming.

hindi: आपके पूरे जीवन काल में जब भी 11 नंबर की राशि में विचरण करता हुआ आपका यूरेनस आ जाता है तो बड़ा स्वर्ग जैसी फीलिंग महसूस होती है।
says: Transit rule: whenever transiting Uranus moves through the sign numbered 11 (Aquarius) during your life, you feel a heaven-like period of pleasure and ease. Natal and transit both work through the same sign quality.
cells_derived_method: The transit gives heaven-like feeling in the life area of the house that Aquarius occupies in the natal chart: for a Gemini lagna Aquarius is the 9th (luck, travel), for a Cancer lagna it is the 8th, for a Leo lagna the 7th (partnerships).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini; Uranus transit through Aquarius feels like a lucky, expansive phase in fortune, teachers and long journeys.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo; Uranus transit through Aquarius lights up partnerships and dealings with the public.

ambiguity: Uranus takes about 84 years for the zodiac, so he may mean the 7-year stay once in a lifetime; he does not give a duration.
classical_check: Silent; classical transit (gochara) uses Saturn to Rahu only.

gist: Rhetorical question: but where is this heaven felt? Sets up the next point about the house.

hindi: अगर यही आपका 11 नंबर राशि छठे घर में पड़ गई तो शत्रुओं के साथ रो पट के स्वर्ग होगा।
says: If the same sign numbered 11 (Aquarius) falls in the 6th house, the heaven comes mixed with crying and quarrels along with enemies: pleasure exists, but inside a setting of rivals, disputes and struggle.
cells_derived_method: The 6th house adds enemies, debts, service and disputes to the Aquarius pleasure; the same sign in 7th would bring the pleasure through partners instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo; Uranus in Aquarius in the 6th, enjoyment arrives through litigation, competition or service work, with enemies always present.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra; Uranus in Aquarius in the 7th brings the same pleasure through a spouse or partner, without the enemy flavour.

ambiguity: Says 'sixth house' with the sign number 11; here sign number and house number are clearly different things.
classical_check: Silent on Uranus; the 6th house as house of enemies is classical.

hindi: जेल में स्वर्ग महसूस करोगे।
says: He pushes the same 6th-house case to an extreme: even in jail you would feel heaven. It means the native stays upbeat and enjoying life even in confinement or heavy conflict, a Uranus-in-6th-house flavour.
cells_derived_method: 6th (and 12th) house holds confinement and enemy topics; Aquarius supplies the cheerful, detached attitude.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo; the person stays cheerful when pressured by courts, rivals or hospital-like confinement.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces; Uranus in Aquarius in the 12th, losses, isolation and hospital-like retreats are tolerated with detachment.

ambiguity: Humorous exaggeration; jail is not to be read literally as a prediction.
classical_check: Silent; classical 6th/12th houses do include confinement.

hindi: ये फर्क है राशियों के और स्थान के परिवर्तन का।
says: Core principle: results change with both the sign and the house (place) a planet is in. The same planet in the same sign gives a different life experience when the house changes, and vice versa.
cells_derived_method: This is the justification for treating every (house, sign) pair as a separate cell: 144 combinations for each planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: same sign as the heaven case, but in the 6th it turns into enemies and struggle.
Derived, not said by him: in the 8th the same sign turns into hidden, sudden gains.

classical_check: Agrees with classical practice of reading bhava plus rashi together.

gist: Announces the topic: where Indra sits in the chart and what results it gives in each placement.

hindi: 12 घरों के अंदर अगर इंद्र बैठा है यानी यूरेनस आपकी कुंडली के अंदर बैठा है तो अगर आपका एक नंबर राशि का है यह राशि के हिसाब से होना चाहिए था।
says: Method statement: Indra can sit in any of the 12 houses, and the analysis should properly be arranged by sign (sign 1 Aries, sign 2 and so on). It shows he treats the sign as the primary axis and the house as the second axis.
ambiguity: Caption is run-on; the meaning is that the slide ought to be sign-wise.

gist: Slide housekeeping: we have written the houses (bhava) on the slide instead of the signs.

hindi: इंद्र एक नंबर राशि का है तो मंगल के घर का ही है।
says: Uranus in sign 1 (Aries) is sitting in Mars's own house, so it behaves under Mars's influence: Indra borrows Mars's courage and fighting strength.
cells_derived_method: Aries gives the Mars-style drive; the house tells where it is used. In the 3rd house it is courage and effort, in the 10th it is career authority.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius; Uranus in Aries in the 3rd gives bold self-effort and protective strength for siblings.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; Uranus in Aries in the 10th gives a commanding, risk-taking career position.

classical_check: Aries is Mars's sign classically; agrees. Uranus itself is not classical.

hindi: जिससे शक्तिशाली लेता है वो लाजवाब है।
says: The planet from which Indra draws his power (here Mars) is superb, so this combination of Uranus in Mars's sign is called excellent, since the sign lord strengthens the planet.
cells_derived_method: A planet is fed by the lord of the sign it sits in; the house decides what the strength is used for.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Uranus in the lagna, backed by lagna lord Mars, gives a strong dominant personality.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo; the strength flows to the 8th house matters, research, inheritance and survival of crises.

ambiguity: 'Lajawab' means incomparable, here used for the sign result.
classical_check: Agrees with the general idea that a planet in a friend's or own-lord's sign is strengthened by that lord.

gist: Transition: now understand what the superb quality of Indra means.
Rhetorical question: what kind of superb is Indra's?

hindi: इंद्र का लाजवाब है रक्षा करने वाला शक्तिशाली राजा जो अपने स्वर्ग की प्रोटेक्शन करता है।
says: Uranus in Aries is the protective, powerful king who guards his own heaven: the native defends his territory, family and position with strength.
cells_derived_method: The kingdom he protects is defined by the house: in the 4th house it is home and property, in the 2nd it is family wealth, in the 7th it is the marriage partnership.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; Uranus in Aries in the 4th gives a guarded home, land and mother, protected by force.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra; Uranus in Aries in the 7th gives a forceful protector of spouse and business partners, perhaps overbearing.

classical_check: Silent on Uranus; Aries as a protective warrior sign matches Mars symbolism.

hindi: यह हनुमान कॉन्शियसनेस नहीं है जो कहता है कि मुझे कुछ नहीं चाहिए।
says: He contrasts this with Hanuman consciousness, the renouncing attitude that says 'I want nothing': Indra is the opposite, a worldly consciousness that wants possessions and rule.
ambiguity: Uses Hanuman as a type of detached devotion, not a planet.
classical_check: Silent; this is an archetype comparison, not a classical rule.

hindi: मुझे भक्ति रखनी है और भाड़ में जाए सब दफा होए।
says: Continues the Hanuman picture: the renouncer says 'I only keep devotion and let the rest of the world go away'. This is the attitude Indra does not have.
ambiguity: Quoted speech of the imagined renouncer, not a rule.

hindi: यह कहता है मुझे तो साम्राज्य चाहिए।
says: Indra's attitude is 'I want a kingdom': Uranus in Aries gives ambition for empire, power and possessions.
cells_derived_method: The kind of empire follows the house: 10th gives public or professional empire, 2nd gives wealth empire, 11th gives network and gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini; Uranus in Aries in the 11th builds a large network and income base.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces; Uranus in Aries in the 2nd turns the ambition for empire into accumulating wealth and a family name.

classical_check: Silent on Uranus; Mars-ruled ambition is classical.

hindi: यानी कि ऐसा व्यक्ति लाजवाब भोगी होगा।
says: Such a person turns out to be a superb enjoyer of worldly pleasures (bhogi), the opposite of a renouncer.
cells_derived_method: Which pleasures follow from the house: 4th comforts and vehicles, 5th romance and entertainment, 12th bed pleasures and foreign luxury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius; Uranus in Aries in the 5th gives pleasure through romance, speculation and entertainment.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus; Uranus in Aries in the 12th gives pleasure in bed and foreign luxuries.

hindi: मस्त मलंग होगा और बहुत मस्ती के अंदर अपने जीवन को चलेगा और सबको साथ लेकर चलाएगा।
says: The native will be carefree and merry, run his life in high spirits and carry everyone around him along with him, a generous leader of a large entourage.
cells_derived_method: The people he carries along are decided by the house: 3rd siblings, 7th partner, 11th friends and 10th staff.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini; friend circles and followers are carried along cheerfully.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; subordinates and the public are led with a generous but forceful style.

gist: Filler emphasis: very superb.

hindi: दो नंबर का यदि होता है तो भड़का हुआ इंद्र है।
says: If Indra is in sign number 2 (Taurus), it is an agitated, inflamed Indra: Uranus in Venus's sign gets wound up and indulgent rather than regal.
cells_derived_method: Venus's appetites inflame Uranus; in the 5th it is romance and speculation, in the 2nd it is food, wealth and speech.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Uranus in Taurus in the 2nd gives restless appetite for money, food and speech.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio; Uranus in Taurus in the 7th gives an inflamed desire life and partnerships.

ambiguity: 'Bhadka hua' may mean provoked or inflamed; it is not a technical term.
classical_check: Silent; Taurus as Venus's sign is classical.

gist: Filler: these are the words that are used.

hindi: अलग-अलग कहने की बात क शराब भी पीता है, मीट भी खाता है।
says: The agitated Indra in sign 2 drinks alcohol and eats meat: Uranus in Taurus indulges in food and drink appetites. The first half of the caption is garbled, so the exact lead-in is lost.
cells_derived_method: Taurus (2nd house of food and speech) feeds the appetite; in the 2nd or 4th house the habit is more central to the diet and home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; drink and meat appear as part of the family diet and speech habits.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; indulgence in parties and entertainment.

ambiguity: Garbled caption start; also it is a lifestyle remark, not a moral rule.

hindi: इंद्र यानी कि भोग विलास है, ऐश अयाशी ये सब भी करता है और रक्षा भी करता है, खजाना भी बढ़ाता है।
says: Indra stands for luxury and carnal pleasure and does that, yet also protects and grows the treasury: Uranus in Taurus mixes indulgence with real wealth accumulation.
cells_derived_method: Indulgence and treasury show up in the house the planet occupies: 2nd and 11th emphasise treasury, 5th and 12th emphasise pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; Uranus in Taurus in the 11th makes gains and the treasury grow.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini; Uranus in Taurus in the 12th makes spending on luxury and bed pleasures dominate.

ambiguity: The 'also protects' clause shows he sees Indra as pleasure plus guardianship.
classical_check: Silent on Uranus; Venus karakatva of luxury is classical.

hindi: देवलोक के अंदर देवताओं को संभालता भी है।
says: In the world of the gods Indra also manages and holds together the other devas: Uranus has an administrator and leader role over a group, not only enjoyment.
ambiguity: Mythological image; no chart condition given.
classical_check: Silent; Indra as lord of devas is Puranic.

gist: Audience asks whether he is telling the houses or the signs.
His answer: this is being told sign-wise.
There is a play of signs inside this; no new rule.
Here we have Indra in the sign numbered 2; repeats the earlier point.
Filler: it is here, it is there.

hindi: वह अलग-अलग कहानी हो जाती है।
says: Each placement of Indra becomes a separate story, meaning the results differ for each house and sign, not one fixed result per planet.
cells_derived_method: Each (house, sign) cell gives its own story.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of context-dependent results.

gist: Brief unclear remark: this is of the lagna.
Transition: now understand the planets.

hindi: याद रखिए यह जो पहला घर है ना यह खुद को आइडेंटिफाई करता है।
says: Reminder that the first house is where a person identifies himself: it shows the self, how you present and recognise yourself.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the first house colours the identity: fire signs make it assertive, earth signs practical, air signs social and water signs emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; self is shown as direct, competitive and action-led.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces; self is shown as soft, imaginative and absorbing.

classical_check: Agrees; the first house is tanu, self and body in all classical texts.

hindi: सेल्फ यह धन को कुटुंब को यह भाई-बहन पराक्रम इसके पास आपकी संपत्ति है।
says: House significations run in order: 1 self; 2 wealth and family (kutumb); 3 brothers, sisters and valour; and 4 your property. The caption runs the first four houses together.
cells_derived_method: The sign on each of these houses shapes how the topic is lived, for example Taurus on the 2nd gives steady savings while Gemini on the 2nd gives money through trade and speech.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; wealth and family are stable, food and music related.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra; courage and siblings are linked to travel, teaching or religion.

ambiguity: The caption is run together so the boundary between houses is inferred; 'property' attaches to the 4th.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical bhava karakatva (dhana, sahaja, sukha).

gist: Repeats that the 4th house shows property.

hindi: यह संतान विद्या इसके पास शत्रु है।
says: The 5th house governs children and education (vidya), and the next, the 6th house, carries enemies.
cells_derived_method: Sign on the 5th shapes children and learning style; sign on the 6th shapes the type of rivals and disease or debt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; proud, creative children and an ambitious style of study.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini; enemies are secretive and persistent.

ambiguity: Caption merges 5th and 6th into one phrase.
classical_check: Agrees with classical putra and ari bhava.

hindi: यह आपका साथी है।
says: The 7th house is your companion, the life partner.
cells_derived_method: Sign on the 7th shapes the partner's temperament: Aries gives a bold spouse, Cancer a caring spouse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; balanced, refined, social partner.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; a serious, older or career-minded partner.

gist: Single word 'partnership', repeating the 7th house meaning.

hindi: यह मृत्यु है और ब्रैकेट में ससुराल भी
says: The 8th house is death, and in brackets also the in-laws' side (sasural), so he links in-laws to the 8th.
cells_derived_method: The 8th-house sign shows how endings and in-laws appear: a fixed sign shows long-lasting in-law ties, a movable sign shows changing ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra; in-laws are wealthy and settled; transformations are slow.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo; in-laws are forceful and endings or crises come suddenly.

ambiguity: In-laws are classically the 4th from the 7th, that is the 10th house, or the 8th as the spouse's family; this is the 8th-house reading.
classical_check: 8th is ayu and randhra; the in-laws link is a later tradition; differs somewhat from classical.

hindi: यह आपका भाग्य है।
says: The 9th house is your fortune or luck.
cells_derived_method: Sign on the 9th shows the style of luck: Sagittarius gives teachers and religious luck, Gemini gives luck through communication and writing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; luck through teachers, dharma and long travel.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra; luck through writing, trade and siblings.

hindi: पिता है यह मां है।
says: Father and mother are placed on houses here; the caption is unclear, but he is listing the 9th as father and a following house as mother, probably the 4th.
cells_derived_method: Sign on the 9th describes the father and the sign on the 4th describes the mother.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; mother is nurturing and home centered.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius; the father is authoritative and dignified.

ambiguity: Caption unclear whether 'mother' is the 4th or 10th; he said father with the 9th.
classical_check: Classical: 4th is mother, 9th is father in many schools (10th in others); partly agrees.

gist: Says 'father is done'; repeating the earlier mention.

hindi: यह कर्म लाभ खर्च इत्यादि इत्यादि ये यही रहेंगे।
says: The last three houses are karma (10th), gains (11th) and expenses (12th); these house meanings stay the same for every planet.
cells_derived_method: Sign on the 10th, 11th and 12th changes the style of career, gains and spending.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; structured, slow, authority-based career.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; spending on spirituality, isolation and sleep.

classical_check: Agrees with karma, labha and vyaya bhava.

hindi: यहां पर जो ग्रह बैठा है जिस जगह उस ग्रह के अनुसार फल होगा।
says: General rule: the result in a house follows the nature of the planet sitting there, so a good planet gives the good side of that house and a bad planet gives the bad side.
cells_derived_method: The same house gives opposite outcomes depending on the planet: Jupiter in the 7th house gives a protective spouse, Ketu gives separation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini; Jupiter in own sign in the 7th gives a wise, protective partner.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus; Ketu in the 7th gives detachment or a break in partnerships.

classical_check: Agrees with the general classical method.

hindi: जैसे यह एक मकान का घर है।
says: As an example, the 4th house is the house of dwellings, a house of building and property.
cells_derived_method: Sign on the 4th shapes the type of home: Cancer gives a homely house, Capricorn a plain or old house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; comfortable, well-kept family home.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio; modern or unusual home, often shared.

ambiguity: He does not say the house number aloud; the 4th is inferred from the 'property' mention.

hindi: इस मकान के घर के अंदर यह मकान का ही फैसला करके देगा।
says: The planet that sits in the property house will decide the property outcome itself, giving or denying a home according to its nature.
cells_derived_method: Planet decides, sign modifies: a benefic in the 4th gives a house, a malefic in a bad sign denies it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Jupiter exalted in the 4th gives a fine house.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio; Saturn in its own sign in the 4th gives property after effort.

classical_check: Agrees in outline; planets in the 4th decide home results.

hindi: अब यहां खराब ग्रह बैठा है बुरी राशि के अंदर तो मकान बनेगा ही नहीं।
says: If a bad planet is in the 4th house and also in a bad sign, the house will not get built at all.
cells_derived_method: Bad means a malefic or debilitated planet in an enemy or debilitation sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th, no stable house.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; Sun debilitated in Libra in the 4th, property is lost or blocked.

ambiguity: He does not define 'bad sign' in this line.
classical_check: Partly agrees; classical texts also deny house results for debilitated malefics in the 4th without cancellation.

hindi: पूरे जन्म कुछ भी कर लो।
says: Emphasis on the previous warning: whatever you do for the whole life, the house will not come when a bad planet in a bad sign holds the property house.
ambiguity: Absolute language is rhetoric, not a measured claim.
classical_check: Silent; classical results are conditional on yogas and dasha.

hindi: अगर यहां अच्छा ग्रह बैठा है तो मकान बनेगा ही।
says: If a good planet sits in the 4th house, the house is certain to be built.
cells_derived_method: Good means benefic or dignified planets: Jupiter, Venus, Moon, or an exalted or own-sign planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Jupiter exalted in the 4th, a house is certain.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius; Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th, a well-furnished home.

classical_check: Agrees in outline; absolute certainty is stronger than classical statements.

hindi: शनि इत्यादि जैसे ग्रह है तो बिन मांगे मिलेगा।
says: A planet like Saturn in the 4th house gives property without being asked for, it simply comes to the native over time.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in own or exalted sign gives it most easily, in an enemy sign it gives only after delay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; Saturn exalted in the 4th gives property unasked.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; Saturn debilitated in the 4th makes property slow and troubled.

ambiguity: 'Saturn and so on' is open-ended.
classical_check: Differs; classical texts say Saturn in the 4th troubles mother and home, though results improve late.

hindi: सूर्य जैसा मिला बैठा है तो महल मिला करके देगा।
says: A planet like the Sun, if placed in the 4th well, gives a palace; a very large house. The word 'mila' is garbled in the caption.
cells_derived_method: Sun is strongest in Aries or Leo; in Libra it is debilitated and the palace is not given.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; exalted Sun in the 4th gives a big, prestigious house.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus; Sun in own sign in the 4th gives an imposing home.

ambiguity: Garbled word 'mila'; also unclear whether he means Sun itself or a Sun-like planet.

hindi: बुध बृहस्पति के अंदर दोष हो तो वह खुद कहे। हां जी यही ठीक है।

hindi: जहां आपकी कुंडली में परमानेंट जन्म के समय स्थापित है उसके कॉरेस्पोंडेंस में आज कहां चल रहा है गोचर में उसके अनुसार कुंडली आपकी काम करके देगी।

hindi: बिल्कुल भड़का देगा।

hindi: खूब पार्टी करेगा बच्चा ये।

hindi: खूब ऐश करेगा।

hindi: तो यानी कि शादी ब्याह में पार्टियां करते हैं ना जो लोग उसका अरेंजमेंट करने वाला व्यक्तित्व बना देगा इसका ये कि हां भाई बताओ भाई क्या करना है अरेंज ये ये कर ले वहां से तू टेंट की

says: The sign-2 Uranus will do this, because Jupiter is with it: Jupiter sets it in order and keeps it from running wild.

hindi: क्योंकि बृहस्पति भी शुक्र के साथ पटती नहीं है तो कहेगा ऐश तो करूंगा करने नहीं दूंगा ढंग से तो कंट्रोलोल्ड
says: Jupiter does not get along with Venus, so in Venus's sign it says 'I will enjoy but will not let you enjoy properly': pleasure stays controlled.

hindi: हड्डियां रिप्लनिश हो रही हैं।
