hindi: अब दो नंबर के काम के लिए यह धन का है।
says: For second-number work, this belongs to the house of wealth: the 2nd house is the wealth place and the pun links shady earning to it.
ambiguity: Pun between the number 2 and the 2nd house.
classical_check: Agrees; the 2nd house is the house of wealth.

gist: Rhetorical: how is the planet sitting in the house of wealth?

hindi: इंद्र दो नंबर राशि का खराब बैठा है।
says: Indra is badly placed in the sign number 2 (Taurus), as before, an agitated Uranus in Venus's sign in the wealth place.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; an agitated Uranus in the 2nd shows irregular, risky money.

hindi: अगर एक नंबर भी ले ले तो भी प्रोटेक्टेड है।
says: Even if sign 1 is also taken, he remains protected, since Uranus under Mars is controlled and shielded.

hindi: दो नंबर की कमाई भी पचा लेगा।
says: He can digest even second-number (unaccounted) earnings; he claims such a native survives money gained by shady means. Recorded as his claim, not an endorsement or financial advice.
ambiguity: Ethically loaded; not advice.

hindi: और दो नंबर के काम में ज्यादा सफल होगा।
says: He will be more successful in second-number work, again meaning shady or informal trades.
ambiguity: Not advice.

hindi: तो जितने दो नंबर की काम कमाइयां करेगा उतनी ज्यादा इसकी लाइफ में रॉकेट है।
says: The more second-number earnings he makes, the more his life shoots like a rocket; the combination rewards the unorthodox income routes in his telling.
ambiguity: Not advice; flagged.

hindi: मौज है।
says: It is enjoyment all round; his result of ease is stated as the outcome of the above.

hindi: बेहतरीन तरीके से हिसाब किताब चलेगा।
says: The accounts will run in an excellent manner: finances in this arrangement stay well balanced and managed.

gist: Cut off: 'this has become...'

hindi: चलित यह केपी था।
says: The chalit chart he was just using is a KP-style chart: he reads the house positions from a cusp-based chart, not the plain rashi chart.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the whole chalit chart is KP or only the cusps are KP.
classical_check: Silent; KP is a modern system and chalit is classical, so the two are not identical.

gist: Rhetorical question: what is happening in the chalit chart?

hindi: चलित में सात नंबर का चंद्रमा है।
says: In the chalit chart the Moon is in the 7th, the house of partners.
ambiguity: 'Seven number' may be a house or a sign; the shift described next suggests a house.

hindi: यहां चंद्रमा यहां से यहां शिफ्ट हो गया है।
says: The Moon has shifted from one house to the next in the chalit chart compared with the rashi chart; he is pointing at the boundary effect of bhava chalit.
cells_derived_method: A planet near the sign boundary is carried to the adjacent house, so it carries the results of both signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; a Moon at the end of Virgo may be moved into the 7th house of Libra in the chalit chart.

ambiguity: He points at a screen; the source and target houses are not spoken.

gist: Rhetorical question: along with sign 1, which other sign is working?

hindi: इसकी नौ नंबर है।
says: Its other working sign is number 9 (Sagittarius), meaning the house is touched by Sagittarius along with the main sign.
cells_derived_method: Evaluate Sagittarius and the second sign together by their house shares.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini; Sagittarius supplies Jupiter's wise and dharmic colour on the 7th.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus; if Scorpio were the second sign the 7th would turn intense and secretive.

ambiguity: The first sign (sign 1) he mentions is the house it moves from or the lagna; not clear which house he means.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that a house carries two signs in chalit.

hindi: छह नंबर तो काम कर ही रही है ना यहां।
says: Sign 6 (Virgo) is working here already, so the Moon house is touched by Virgo as well as the other sign.
ambiguity: House not stated.

gist: Brief verdict: it will be all right.

hindi: रिलेशनशिप भी रखेगा, छोड़ेगा भी और पकड़ेगा भी।
says: The person will keep relationships, leave them and take them up again, a cycle of attachment and breakup.
cells_derived_method: The cycle of leaving and returning is strongest in the movable signs; fixed signs hold on and mutable signs drift.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; emotional, clinging partnerships with repeated returns.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius; light, changing relationships that restart easily.

hindi: यानी एक्स्ट्रा रिलेशनशिप रहेंगे ही रहेंगे इसके।
says: So he will certainly have extra relationships outside the main one; this chart combination is read as promising additional partners.
ambiguity: Absolute claim for one example chart.

hindi: और उसकी सपोर्ट में हमें फिर इंद्र देखना पड़ेगा।
says: To confirm this we must then look at Indra for support; Uranus must be checked to see if it backs the extra-relationship reading.

gist: Rhetorical question: how is Indra placed?

hindi: इंद्र अगर दो नंबर राशि का बैठा है तो यह कहेगा यस अलाउड।
says: If Uranus sits in sign 2 (Taurus) it will say 'yes, allowed': it permits the extra relationships and gives no resistance.
cells_derived_method: The permission lands in the house of the Taurus placement: in the 7th it is partnerships, in the 5th romance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio; Uranus in Taurus in the 7th permits a second relationship.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; romance with several partners is permitted.

hindi: दूसरा शुक्र जीवन में दो स्त्री या दो पुरुष देता है दूसरे घर का।
says: Secondly, Venus as the lord of the 2nd house gives two women or two men in life; the 2nd (family) house of Venus produces a second partner.
cells_derived_method: Venus owns the 2nd house when Aries is lagna, and Taurus in the 2nd shows second relations; for Libra on the 2nd (lagna Virgo) the same applies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Venus as 2nd lord shows second relationships and a second family line.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo; Venus as 2nd lord with the same second-partner tendency.

ambiguity: He mixes the house number with the numerical word 'two'.
classical_check: Silent; classically the 2nd and 7th jointly judge multiple marriages.

hindi: आपके जीवन में दो पुरुष या दो स्त्री होंगे।
says: You will have two men or two women in your life, repeating the Venus-2nd house claim in the second person.

hindi: दो पति या दो पत्नी भी हो सकते हैं।
says: There can even be two husbands or two wives, that is, two marriages.
ambiguity: A possibility, not a certainty.
classical_check: Agrees in outline; two marriages are linked to dual-sign and afflicted 7th placements.

hindi: डिपेंड्स लेकिन दो तो रहेंगी।
says: It depends, but two relationships will surely be there; he hedges on the form but not the number.

hindi: ऐसा ही इंद्र का काम है।
says: That is just what Indra's work is: Uranus's nature is to multiply partners in the same way.

hindi: ये दो की बजाय कहता है चार रख लो।
says: Instead of two, Indra says 'keep four': Uranus escalates the count of relationships.
ambiguity: Number is rhetorical.

hindi: तो ज्यादा रिलेशनशिप्स भी दे सकता है।
says: So it can give even more relationships than two, stated as a general tendency of strong Uranus in the partner houses.

gist: Rhetorical question introducing the remedy: in such a situation what are Indra's remedies?

hindi: इंद्र देवता के उपायों के अंदर आपका यदि इंद्र दूषित है, ग्रह नेगेटिव है तो आठ नंबर राशि को आपने देखना कहां पड़ी?
says: For Indra remedies, if your Uranus is afflicted or negative, you must check where sign 8 (Scorpio, Indra's own sign) lies in the chart; the remedy is worked through the house holding Scorpio.
cells_derived_method: The house that Scorpio occupies in the chart is the remedy centre: 1st for Scorpio lagna, 8th for Aries lagna, 5th for Cancer lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; the 8th house is the remedy centre for Uranus.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; the 5th house is the remedy centre for Uranus.

classical_check: Silent; classical remedies work through the sign lord, which here is Uranus in his scheme.

hindi: जैसे यह आठ नंबर पड़ी है।
says: For example in this chart sign 8 lies in this particular house, which he points at on the screen; the example is used to demonstrate the remedy logic.
ambiguity: House not spoken.

gist: Rhetorical question: which Indra stone should be worn for this?

hindi: नाभि पे पड़ा हुआ ग्रह है ये।
says: This planet lies on the navel in the body map: Uranus governs the region of the navel and below.
ambiguity: Contradicts his earlier statement that Indra rules the thighs; he seems to mean the lower trunk from the navel down.
classical_check: Differs; classically the navel is Virgo and the 6th house.

gist: Rhetorical question: which stone will suit it?
Rhetorical question: what happens on Indra's planet?

hindi: डायमंड की बरसात होती है।
says: Diamonds rain on Indra's planet, which he uses as the reason a diamond is Uranus's gemstone.
ambiguity: Mixes planetary science with symbolism.
classical_check: Classical Venus gem is diamond; the link to Uranus is modern.

hindi: डायमंड भी बन सकता है इसके लिए यूरेनस के लिए।
says: A diamond can also be the stone for it, for Uranus; diamond is accepted as the Uranus gem. A gemstone claim, not purchase advice.
classical_check: Differs; classical texts give Venus the diamond and none to Uranus.

gist: He says something like 'but we have kept that along with it'; the reference of 'that' is unclear.

hindi: नेप्च्यून पे भी डायमंड की बरसात होती है।
says: Diamonds also rain on Neptune, which makes diamond a Neptune stone too.

hindi: जुपिटर पे भी होती है।
says: It also happens on Jupiter, so the diamond-rain argument is stretched to Jupiter as well.
ambiguity: Planetary science used as an argument for a gem; not an astrological rule.
classical_check: Differs; Jupiter's classical gem is yellow sapphire.

hindi: अब पॉइंट सबसे बड़ा आता है कि अगर हमें डिफरेंशिएट करना है कि हमें डायमंड पहनाना है या हमें सफेद मूंगा पहनाना है।
says: The biggest point: we must decide between a diamond and a white coral for this chart; the choice of gem is to be made from the chart.
ambiguity: White coral is not a classical stone; it points to the Mars-Aries family.
classical_check: Classical coral is red, for Mars; white coral is his own usage.

hindi: तो अब सफेद मूंगे लायक ये कुंडली नहीं है क्योंकि आठ नंबर यहां पड़ा हुआ है।
says: This chart is not suited for white coral, because sign 8 lies here; the Scorpio placement rules out coral.
cells_derived_method: The decision turns on the house where Scorpio sits.
ambiguity: The reasoning from Scorpio to coral is not spelled out.

hindi: अब डायमंड लायक यह है तो डायमंड के लायक हमें दो और सात नंबर देखने पड़ेंगे क्योंकि नेप्च्यून और शुक्र का हमें हेल्प चाहिए।
says: If the chart suits a diamond, we must check signs 2 and 7 (Taurus and Libra) because we need help from Neptune and Venus, the lords of those signs.
cells_derived_method: The strength of Venus and Neptune in the chart (through the houses holding Taurus and Libra) decides if a diamond will work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Taurus on the 2nd, check Venus and its house strength.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Libra on the 7th, check Neptune and Venus there.

classical_check: Agrees that a gem needs the strength of its planet and the house lord.

hindi: इंद्र जो है नाभि से लेकर के यही नष्ट होता है।
says: Indra, from the navel downward, is where things get destroyed: the lower body region is the part ruined when Uranus is afflicted. A body-map claim, not diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health claim; tradition only.

hindi: यही भ्रष्ट यही खराबी करता है।
says: This is also where it corrupts and spoils: Uranus misbehaves in the same lower-body, desire-related area.

hindi: तो इसके लिए तो हमें डायमंड सेट करना पड़ेगा।
says: For that reason we must set (fix) a diamond for this person: diamond is the chosen remedy for the afflicted lower-body Uranus.

hindi: अगर यह डायमंड सेट हो जाता है तो बहुत बढ़िया।
says: If the diamond sets well (suits the person) that is very good; the gem should suit the chart.

hindi: लेकिन डायमंड महंगा बहुत आता है और डायमंड अच्छा ही पहनना है और बड़ा ही पहनना है।
says: But diamond is very expensive, and it must be a good and large one if worn; he insists on quality and size. A gem-buying remark recorded as his, not purchase advice.
ambiguity: Not purchase advice.
classical_check: Agrees that remedy gems should be good-quality and of adequate weight.

hindi: लेकिन वो इतना महंगा है कि काला पीला डायमंड लोग ले लेंगे।
says: It is so costly that people will settle for black or yellowish diamonds, an inferior grade.
classical_check: Agrees that flawed stones are discouraged.

hindi: एलसी और एलबी होता है।
says: These come as 'LC and LB' grades (the caption letters), meaning the low colour grades he warns against.
ambiguity: Letters are probably a shorthand for the next line.

hindi: लाइट कलर और लाइट ब्लैक।
says: Light colour and light black: the two low-grade diamond types he means.

hindi: और यह लेकर वह साइड इफेक्ट मारता है और उसके पश्चात लाइफ के अंदर जो बचा खुचा वैभव, सुख और आनंद है उसका भी सत्यानाश हो जाता है।
says: Wearing such a poor diamond gives side effects, and it ruins whatever luxury, comfort and joy is left in life; a wrong gem backfires.
ambiguity: Sentence continues across the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Agrees in general with the caution that a wrong gem harms.

hindi: लड़की पहने या लड़का पहने उसके पार्टनर के साथ और सत्यानाश।
says: Whether a girl or a boy wears the poor diamond, it ruins the relationship with the partner as well.

hindi: तभी स्त्रियों को ही अक्सर डायमंड का कार्यक्रम रहता है कि इसको डायमंड चढ़ाओ।
says: That is why it is usually women who are the focus of diamonds, with the cry 'put a diamond on her'; diamond is socially tied to the female and to Venus.
ambiguity: A social remark with astrological meaning.
classical_check: Agrees that diamond is Venus's gem and Venus is the female planet.

hindi: तो एक तरह से स्त्री शुक्र यूरेनस इसको हम कह रहे हैं आप लो देवता।
says: In a way woman, Venus and Uranus are being linked together, as if he were telling the god Indra 'you take it'; a woman, Venus and Uranus form one cluster around the diamond.
ambiguity: Loose sentence.

gist: Filler: you hold it.

hindi: आपको हम किसी को गिफ्ट देते हैं।
says: We give something as a gift to someone, setting up the example of gifting a diamond.

gist: Rhetorical question: how do we give it?

hindi: इसलिए कहते हैं ना स्त्री को गिफ्ट दे दो डायमंड।
says: That is why people say give a woman a diamond as a gift, because diamond is Venus's and Indra's gem.

gist: Mock reaction of the woman: wow!

hindi: शादी के लिए क्या करो शादी की अंगूठी हृदय चक्र की इसकी तीसरी उंगली है रिंग फिंगर
says: For marriage you wear the wedding ring, on the ring finger, the third finger, which he links to the heart chakra.
ambiguity: Which hand is not stated.
classical_check: Differs; classical texts place Sun on the ring finger, though the heart link is customary.

hindi: इसकी जो वेन है नर्व है वो हार्ट पे जाती है इसकी हमारे लिवर में जाती है इसलिए पितरों को टीका इससे लगाते हैं
says: The vein or nerve of this finger goes to the heart (the caption also says liver), which is why ancestors are marked with a tika using this finger. A body-lore claim, not medical fact.
ambiguity: Mention of the liver is garbled and conflicts with the heart.
classical_check: Silent; a traditional belief about the ring finger.

hindi: इसकी हमारे हार्ट में जाती है इसलिए कहते हैं शादी की अंगूठी इसमें पहनो
says: Since its nerve goes to the heart, he says wear the wedding ring on this finger; the heart link is the reason for the ring-finger custom.

hindi: तिलक करते हैं किसी को हम इससे करते हैं हृदय से आपको टीका लगाया हमने
says: We apply the tilak to someone with this finger as a mark of 'we applied it from the heart'; ring finger tilak is a heart-felt blessing.

hindi: तो इसी में डायमंड पहनाते हैं कि अपना दिल तुमको दिया लाइक दैट वो फीलिंग के साथ
says: So the diamond is put on this same finger, with the feeling of 'I gave you my heart'; the diamond ring symbolises giving one's heart.

hindi: तो इसलिए डायमंड यानी प्रेम का प्रतीक
says: Therefore a diamond means a symbol of love, tying the gem to Venus's love and Indra's richness.
classical_check: Agrees that the diamond belongs to Venus, love and luxury.

hindi: तो आप प्रेम ले रहे हो वैभव ले रहे हो वाह स्वर्ग है यार भाई क्या चमक है कितनी सुनहरी आभा है डायमंड की
says: By wearing it you take love and glory: 'wow, this is heaven, what a shine, what a golden aura a diamond has'; the diamond is sold as the wearable form of Indra's heaven.
ambiguity: Enthusiastic speech.

hindi: उस पॉइंट से अगर अच्छा पहनोगे तो काम करेगा
says: From that point of view, if you wear a good one it will work; a good-quality diamond is the condition for it to work.
ambiguity: The sentence starts in the previous chunk with 'from that point'.

hindi: अन्यथा अब इसका उपाय इंद्र से होगा ही नहीं किसी दूसरे ग्रह के द्वारा इसका उपाय करना पड़ेगा हमें
says: Otherwise the remedy will not come from Indra at all, and we will have to remedy it through some other planet; if the diamond route fails, another planet is used to fix it.
classical_check: Agrees with the idea of remedying through an easier planet.

gist: Rhetorical question: here to whom do we have to give power?

hindi: हमें 12व घर के जो शराब पी के पड़े हुए हैं एक तरह से मान के चलो उनको शराब पिए पिए को भी जागृत करना है
says: We must strengthen the planets of the 12th house, the ones lying 'drunk': they are asleep or dull and must be awakened.
ambiguity: Refers to the example chart's 12th-house cluster.
classical_check: Agrees with strengthening weak house planets.

hindi: तो हमें इसको बुध के लिए करेक्शन चाहिए बुध की राशि यहां तीन नंबर पन्ना पहनाना पड़ेगा इसको
says: For Mercury we need a correction, and since Mercury's sign here is number 3 (Gemini) the person will have to wear an emerald.
ambiguity: A gem prescription for the example chart; not general advice.
classical_check: Agrees; emerald is Mercury's classical gem.

hindi: एक सफेद पुखराज पहनाना पड़ेगा।
says: A white topaz also has to be worn, as another correction gem for the chart (white topaz is used as a milder Jupiter-type stone).
ambiguity: The planet for white topaz is not named.
classical_check: Differs; classical Jupiter stone is yellow sapphire, and white topaz is a substitute.

hindi: शनि नीलम पहनाना पड़ेगा।
says: For Saturn a blue sapphire has to be worn; blue sapphire is the Saturn gem.
ambiguity: A gem prescription for the example chart.
classical_check: Agrees; blue sapphire (neelam) is Saturn's classical gem.

hindi: गोमेद और लहसुनिय की जरूरत बिल्कुल नहीं है।
says: Hessonite (Rahu's gem) and cat's eye (Ketu's gem) are absolutely not needed in this chart.
classical_check: Agrees that gomed is Rahu's and lehsunia is Ketu's gem.

gist: Comment: the chart is superb.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति को जिंदगी में पैसे की दिक्कत नहीं आएगी कभी भी।
says: This person will never face a shortage of money in life, he says of the example chart. Recorded as his claim, not as financial advice.
ambiguity: Strong absolute claim for one chart.

hindi: मंगल इतना पावरफुल बैठा हुआ है।
says: Mars is sitting very powerful in this chart, which is his reason for the money flow.
ambiguity: Its house and sign are not stated.

hindi: इसके पास धन आता ही रहेगा।
says: Wealth will keep coming to him, a continuing inflow of money.

hindi: चार नंबर होके भी आएगा।
says: Money will come even with the 4th house in its position, apparently despite an afflicted 4th (home) house.
ambiguity: 'Four number' may be the house or the sign; unclear.

hindi: रिश्ते नहीं रहेंगे लेकिन आएगा।
says: Relationships will not last but the money will still come; wealth survives the broken ties.

hindi: एक्सीडेंट मारेगा।
says: An accident may strike, he adds as a hazard from the same Mars placement. Recorded as his claim, not a prediction of any event.
ambiguity: Vague, no timing.
classical_check: Agrees in general that Mars signifies accidents.

hindi: 12 नंबर है।
says: The 12th house is the place involved here, the house of losses and spending, as the reason for what follows.

gist: Filler: this is the game.

hindi: जुआ में लुटाता रहेगा।
says: He will keep squandering money in gambling. Recorded as his claim about the 12th-house loss pattern, not advice.
classical_check: Agrees in outline that the 12th and 5th link to speculation losses.

hindi: पैसा आएगा।
says: Money will come to him; income itself is not in doubt in this chart.

hindi: लुटाता रहेगा।
says: He will keep dissipating it, so the wealth does not accumulate.

hindi: अय्याशी और जुआ में खूब लुटाएगा ये।
says: He will heavily waste money on debauchery and gambling, the two leaks of his chart.

hindi: यह इसकी समस्या है।
says: This is his problem, the key weakness of the chart: income is strong but outflow is stronger.

hindi: इसलिए कैश से धनवान नहीं होगा।
says: For that reason he will not become rich in cash terms; wealth will not stay as liquid savings. Recorded as his claim, not financial advice.

hindi: दूसरे घर का स्वामी यहां बैठा है और दूसरे घर में बैठा है इंद्र।
says: The lord of the 2nd house sits in the 12th (the wasteful house) and Indra sits in the 2nd house: the wealth house is occupied by a spendthrift planet while its lord is in the loss house.
cells_derived_method: The 2nd lord in the 12th and Uranus in the 2nd give income that leaks; the sign shapes how.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Uranus in the 2nd in Taurus, with the 2nd lord Venus in the 12th, income comes but luxury spends it.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; the 12th house in Pisces holds the 2nd lord and gets spent on pleasures.

ambiguity: Sign for Uranus is Taurus from the earlier example; here only the houses are stated.
classical_check: Agrees that the 2nd lord in the 12th causes wealth loss.

hindi: पैसा आया और उड़ाओ।
says: Money comes and gets blown away; the 2nd-house Uranus makes income pass straight into spending.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति के घर में ईस्ट नॉर्थ ईस्ट बहुत बढ़ा हुआ होता है
says: A vastu link: the house of such a person tends to have its east and north-east parts very extended or enlarged; Uranus in the 2nd shows in the home's north-east.
ambiguity: Sentence continues in the next chunk ('is'); the claim is a vastu correlation of his.
classical_check: Silent; this vastu-astrology link is his own.

gist: Says money came and was spent, restating the earn-and-spend pattern.

hindi: पार्टी करेंगे, पार्टी करेंगे।
says: They will party and party again; the spendthrift pattern is shown through constant celebration.

hindi: कर्जा लेके भी पार्टी कर लेंगे।
says: They will even borrow money to throw parties; the extravagance continues on debt.

gist: A listener asks if there could be an ED (Enforcement Directorate) entry, and he answers yes.

hindi: ईट की एंट्री हो सकती है यार।
says: An entry of the ED (enforcement agency) is possible, he says, for the shady-money pattern; he accepts the audience's suggestion of a government investigation risk. Recorded as a possibility only, with no prediction of a case.
ambiguity: 'Eet' is read as ED (Enforcement Directorate); a guess from the audience question.

gist: Repeats that it could be so.
English aside: I don't believe it, but maybe it is possible, yes.
Says many reasons can arise, with no specific rule.
Closing remark: these are the stories of Lord Indra.
Procedure: whether to take question and answer first or continue with remedies.

hindi: उपाय के लिए देखो उपाय देख तो किसी भी कुंडली को देख के होते हैं।
says: Remedies are chosen only by looking at the particular chart; there is no fixed remedy for a planet without reading the chart first.
ambiguity: Start of the sentence is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees that remedies should follow chart analysis.

hindi: बहुत सारा हिसाब किताब है।
says: There is a great deal of calculation involved in choosing a remedy; many factors have to be weighed together.

hindi: इंद्र के पॉइंट्स हैं।
says: There are specific points for Indra, a defined set of factors to check for Uranus remedies.
ambiguity: The points are listed in the following lines.

hindi: अब यहां पर हमारे को वैभव सुख शांति जो समस्या आ रही है मान लो।
says: Suppose the problem arising here is in luxury, comfort and peace, which he sets as the case for the remedy demonstration.

hindi: अब इसको ठीक करना है।
says: This now has to be fixed; the remedy question for the given problem begins.

hindi: अब हम यहां देखेंगे आठ नंबर राशि आठ नंबर राशि है और न 9° का है इसलिए सात नंबर राशि भी काम कर रही है।
says: We look at sign 8 here; since the planet is at about 9 degrees, sign 7 (the previous sign) is also working. He applies the low-degree rule: a planet at a low degree is also under the previous sign.
cells_derived_method: A planet in the first 10 degrees of its sign gets influence from the previous sign as well; apply to every planet in this way.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; a planet at 9 degrees Scorpio in the 8th also carries Libra's influence.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; a planet at 9 degrees Capricorn in the 10th also carries Sagittarius.

ambiguity: The caption 'n 9 degree' is garbled but consistent with the previous passage.
classical_check: Agrees with the chalit or sandhi idea; the 10-degree window is his rule of thumb.

hindi: अब सात आठ नंबर सात आठ नंबर और 10 नंबर ये हमें सेट करना है।
says: We need to set (correct) signs 7 and 8 and also 10, i.e. the houses carrying Libra, Scorpio and Capricorn in this chart are the remedy targets.
ambiguity: '10 number' may be the house or the sign Capricorn.

gist: Rhetorical question: for what are we setting it?

hindi: ताकि इसका दूसरा घर ठीक हो जाए।
says: So that the 2nd house of this person gets fixed, the goal of the remedy being the wealth and family house.

hindi: यहां इन यूरेनस का कोई लेनदेन नहीं है।
says: Uranus has no dealings with this point; it does not touch the house being corrected here.
ambiguity: Which house he points at is not stated.

hindi: यूरेनस यूरेनस यहां 10 नंबर बहुत बढ़िया है।
says: Uranus here is placed very well in number 10, the 10th house or Capricorn; the 10th placement is excellent for career and rise.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in the 10th gives career fame; the sign tunes how: Capricorn adds discipline, Aries adds boldness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; Uranus in Capricorn in the 10th gives steady, disciplined public career.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer; Uranus in Aries in the 10th gives bold, pioneering career.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses the chunk boundary; 10 may be house or sign.

hindi: शादी के बाद इसकी लाइफ में और बेटर है।
says: After marriage his life gets even better with this Uranus placement.

hindi: लेकिन यहां में करेक्शन मांगता है।
says: But in one place it asks for a correction; some part of the chart needs fixing.
ambiguity: The place is shown on screen.

hindi: यहां का यूरेनस करेक्शन मांगता है।
says: The Uranus at this spot, the one in the 2nd house of the chart, needs correcting.
ambiguity: House inferred from the previous remedy goal.

hindi: एक यहां की करेक्शन मांगता है ताकि इसके गृहस्थ जीवन ठीक रहे।
says: One correction is needed here so that the family and married life stays in order; the remedy protects the household.

hindi: चरित्रवान रहे।
says: So that he remains of good character; one of the remedy's stated aims.

hindi: कहीं भटकाव ना आ जाए जीवन में और बर्बाद ना हो।
says: So that no straying comes into his life and he does not get ruined; the remedy aims to prevent moral drift.

hindi: पेट की खराबी नहीं आनी चाहिए।
says: Stomach trouble should not come, a health aim he adds for the remedy. Recorded as his claim only, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Health claim; tradition only.

hindi: तो हम यहां पर लाल रंग लेंगे।
says: So at this point we will use the colour red as the remedy colour, bringing Mars's energy into the spot.
classical_check: Agrees that red is Mars's colour.

hindi: लाल रंग लेने से यहां पर मंगल की दृष्टि इस पर पड़ेगी।
says: By taking the red colour, Mars's aspect will fall on this point, so the red remedy works by bringing Mars's gaze onto the Uranus spot.
ambiguity: The mechanism is his own; colours do not carry aspects in classical texts.
classical_check: Silent; colour remedies are traditional but the aspect logic is his.

hindi: पूर्ण रूप से वेरी वेरी पावरफुल एंड वेरी इफेक्टिव।
says: Fully, very very powerful and very effective: he rates the red-Mars remedy as strong.
ambiguity: A claim of efficacy, not measured.

hindi: अब यहां पर भी काम करेगा तो लाल नंग रंग यहां आने से दूसरे घर को खराब कर देगा।
says: It will also work at another place, and bringing the red colour there would spoil the 2nd house; a side effect of the red remedy.
ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'lal nang rang'.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars in the 2nd harms family and speech.

hindi: शुक्र है यहां पर फिर अय्याशी के दूसरे अड्डे खोल देगा।
says: Venus is here, so Mars would open up more dens of debauchery; the red remedy inflames Venus's pleasure side.

hindi: शादी के बाद भटका देगा।
says: After marriage it will lead him astray; the red remedy's side effect appears in married life.

hindi: तो इसमें थोड़ा सा ब्लू कलर मिक्स करेंगे।
says: So we will mix a little blue colour into the red, to tone down the red's side effect.
classical_check: Silent; blue is classically Saturn's colour.

hindi: यहां राहु को डालेंगे थोड़ा सा ताकि वो मंगल को डिक्लाइन कर दे।
says: We will bring in a little Rahu here so that it declines or dampens Mars; the blue mix is meant to represent Rahu.
ambiguity: Blue as Rahu is his own association.
classical_check: Differs; Rahu's classical colour is dark smoky blue or black, so a loose agreement.

hindi: तो हम लेंगे पर्पल।
says: So we will take purple (red plus blue) as the remedy colour.

hindi: इसको पर्पल कलर का धागा यहां पैर में आएगा लेफ्ट पैर में।
says: A purple-coloured thread has to be tied on the foot, specifically the left foot, for this person.
classical_check: Silent; thread remedies are folk tradition.

hindi: पर्पल कलर का धागा बांधने से इंद्र महाराज सेट।
says: By tying the purple thread, Lord Indra gets set, that is brought under control.
ambiguity: Efficacy is not measured.

hindi: उल्टा वो कहेंगे कि भाई बर्बादी खराबी नहीं करनी।
says: On the contrary he will say 'brother, I should not cause ruin or damage'; the settled Indra stops its destructive habits.

hindi: संभाल के रखना है और स्वर्ग की स्थिति अपने आप बननी बढ़नी शुरू हो जाएगी।
says: It will keep things in hand, and the state of heaven will start forming and growing by itself; the remedy's promised outcome is a steady rise of comfort. A tradition claim, not a measured result.

hindi: इसी के साथ अगर सातवें घर के अंदर अब मान लो सिम्टम आ गए व्यक्ति कहता है मेरे पेट की खराबी है।
says: Along with this, suppose symptoms show in the 7th-house matters and the person complains of a stomach problem; he ties a stomach complaint to the 7th-house case. A health remark of his, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health claim; tradition only.

hindi: पति पत्नी में बहुत जबरदस्त झगड़ा है।
says: The other symptom is a terrible quarrel between husband and wife, the 7th-house marital conflict.
classical_check: Agrees that an afflicted 7th gives marital conflict.

hindi: तो उसकी कमर पर अब उसकी कमर पर हमारे को कसना पड़ेगा इसको।
says: For that we have to bind something tight around his waist: the remedy is a thread on the waist, the area the 7th house governs in his body map.
classical_check: Differs; classical body maps put the waist under Libra, the 7th sign, which agrees in outline.

hindi: यहां छह और सात नंबर राशि है।
says: In this example the signs working on the waist house are 6 (Virgo) and 7 (Libra), two signs sharing the house.
cells_derived_method: The house with two signs needs a remedy that suits both.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; the 7th is mainly Libra, with Virgo as the minor sign touching the cusp.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces; the 7th is mainly Virgo with Libra touching its edge.

ambiguity: House is inferred as the 7th; he points at a chart.

hindi: यहां नौ नंबर है।
says: Sign 9 (Sagittarius) is also present here, adding a third sign to the considerations.
ambiguity: House unspecified.

hindi: छह नंबर के लिए हम अगर नीला धागा बांधते तो यहां नौ नंबर में और सत्यानाश कर देगा।
says: If we tied a blue thread for sign 6 it would do even more damage to sign 9 here; the blue colour helps Virgo but hurts Sagittarius, so it cannot be used.
classical_check: Silent; blue (Saturn) is classically an enemy-type colour for Jupiter.

hindi: अब नीला धागा आ नहीं सकता।
says: So the blue thread cannot be used; it is ruled out for this chart.

hindi: सात नंबर है।
says: Sign 7 (Libra) is the one to be handled for the waist, the next consideration after ruling out blue.

gist: Rhetorical question: what can we do for this?

hindi: यहां भी लाल ही धागा आ सकता है।
says: Here too only a red thread can be used; red is the only colour left that suits this arrangement.

gist: Rhetorical question: if this too becomes a problem, which is the best thread for the waist?

hindi: येलो ग्रे सर येलो ग्रेतु केतु हम इसकी यहां पर केतु को प्लेस करेंगे।
says: A listener offers yellow or grey; he settles on grey, the colour of Ketu, and says we will place Ketu at the waist spot.
ambiguity: Garbled start with an audience suggestion.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu's colour is usually smoky or multi-coloured.

hindi: ये ग्रह का स्वभाव समझना है।
says: We have to understand the nature of the planet; remedies must follow each planet's character.

hindi: इंद्र जो है अय्याशी पे डाल देगा।
says: Indra will push the native into debauchery; this is the problem the Ketu placement is to address.

gist: Rhetorical question: what is to be done to the debauchery?

hindi: ब्लॉक करना है।
says: It has to be blocked: the aim of the Ketu remedy is to block the debauchery tendency.

hindi: दिखेगा ही नहीं।
says: It will not be visible at all, since Ketu hides the opportunity; the temptation will not even appear.

hindi: तो इसके ओपोरर्चुनिटी बहुत बनेंगे।
says: Many opportunities will keep arising for him (before the block takes effect), a statement of how Uranus produces openings for affairs.

hindi: अयाश बन नहीं पाएगा।
says: He will not be able to become a debauchee, which is the result with Ketu in place.

hindi: तो जैसे तैसे भटका रहेगा तो यह वो लोगों में से रहेंगे जो चार 400 440 जगह फ्लर्ट करते हैं।
says: He will somehow keep wandering, among those people who flirt in four, four hundred or four hundred forty places; many attempts but no real success.
ambiguity: Numbers are exaggeration.

hindi: सेटिंग एक भी नहीं हो पाती।
says: Not a single arrangement (liaison) settles; with the block in place none of the flirtations succeeds.

hindi: तो केतु सेट कर दो तो भटकाव नहीं हो पाएगा।
says: So if Ketu is set, straying will not be possible; Ketu's placement is the cure for wandering.

hindi: थोड़े टाइम बाद थक जाएगा।
says: After a short time he will get tired of it, so the flirting burns out by itself.
ambiguity: Sentence starts in the previous chunk's final line.

hindi: तो ये कमर पर इसको धागा बांध दे ग्रे कलर का।
says: So tie a grey-coloured thread on his waist.
classical_check: Silent; thread remedies are folk tradition.

hindi: ग्रे धागा बांधने से केतु की स्थापना से ये प्लनेट इसका डाउन हो जाएगा।
says: By tying the grey thread, through the establishment of Ketu, this planet (Uranus) will go down and be subdued.

gist: One word: decline, repeating that the planet goes down.

hindi: तो कहीं प्लनेट उठाया जाता है, कहीं बिठाया जाता है, कहीं उसका शत्रु काम करता है, कहीं मित्र काम करता है।
says: Remedy principle: sometimes a planet is raised, sometimes it is made to sit down (suppressed); sometimes the planet's enemy is used and sometimes its friend; the remedy depends on the aim.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of strengthening or pacifying a planet.

hindi: वास्तु में भी यही होता है।
says: The same method applies in Vastu: elements and directions can be raised, lowered, helped or opposed.
classical_check: Silent; a vastu-astrology link of his.

hindi: ईस्ट अगर बहुत बढ़ जाता है तो उसका कोई उपाय नहीं है।
says: If the east part of a house grows very large, there is no direct remedy for it in the usual way; extension of the east cannot simply be cut away.

hindi: वहां पीला बल्ब लगा लगाना पड़ता है।
says: One has to fit a yellow bulb there (in the extended east) as the remedy.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिकली वो उसको तोड़ के खराब करता है।
says: Automatically the yellow bulb breaks down and spoils the extension's effect; the bulb works as an opposing element.

hindi: तो एंटी एलिमेंट के द्वारा भी ट्रीटमेंट होती है।
says: So treatment is also done through the opposing element; an anti-element suppresses an excess.

hindi: तो ये चीज के लिए आपको यहां कमर पर इनको ग्रे धागा बांधना पड़ेगा।
says: So for this case you must tie a grey thread around the waist, a conclusion of the Ketu reasoning above.

gist: Claim of efficacy: very effective.

hindi: बहुत ज्यादा फायदा बैठेगा।
says: It will bring a great deal of benefit; his promise about the grey-thread remedy. Not a measured claim.

gist: Repeats that it will give very great benefit.
Rhetorical question: where else can we set Indra?

hindi: यह राशि बहुत बढ़िया है।
says: This sign is very good, he says of the sign in the 11-number position in the example, a favourable sign for the next remedy.
ambiguity: Which sign he points at is not stated.

hindi: नौ नौ आठ और नौ काम कर रही है और यहां पर 11 नंबर है।
says: Signs 8 and 9 are working and sign 11 is here as well, listing the signs that matter for the next remedy (halwa at the gurudwara).
ambiguity: Caption repeats '9' by stutter.

gist: Rhetorical question: so what can we do at the gurudwara?

hindi: इंद्र के लिए राजा की तरह दे सकते हैं।
says: For Indra one can give as a king would, a royal-style donation, as the remedy for Uranus.

gist: Rhetorical question: what can we give?

hindi: चीनी दे दो।
says: Give sugar as a donation; sugar (sweet, white) is offered for Indra.
classical_check: Silent; sugar is classically a Venus donation.

gist: Repeats: give sweet sugar.
Rhetorical question: what is the best thing to give?

hindi: हलवा।
says: The best offering is halwa, the sweet pudding; the sentence continues into the next chunk with the kind of halwa.

hindi: पीला हलवा नहीं दे सकते।
says: Yellow halwa cannot be given in this case, because yellow brings Jupiter in.

hindi: पीला रंग आ गया।
says: The yellow colour has come in, meaning the Jupiter colour has entered the offering, which is unwanted here.

hindi: बृहस्पति वो नहीं दे सकते।
says: We cannot give that Jupiter-type item here, because Jupiter conflicts with the sign set in this chart.
ambiguity: Reason is only implied.

hindi: तो आटे सूजी का हलवा दे दो।
says: So give a halwa of wheat flour and semolina, a plain, non-yellow halwa.

hindi: ऐसा व्यक्ति गुरुद्वारे में जाकर अगर हलवा घी का बनवा के देता है मीठा तो मीठा हो गया मंगल का आठ नंबर राशि के लिए लाजवाब 11 नंबर के लिए लाजवाब हलवा हो गया
says: If such a person goes to a gurudwara and gets a ghee halwa made and offers it, the sweet belongs to Mars and is superb for sign 8 and also superb for sign 11; the halwa is a good fit for both signs.
ambiguity: Whether sweet counts as Mars is his own assignment.
classical_check: Silent; sweets are classically Venus, not Mars.

hindi: आटा आटा टोटली न्यूट्रल है
says: Flour is totally neutral, so it adds no conflicting planetary effect to the offering.

hindi: आठ नंबर में आठ नंबर और नौ नंबर में सूर्य लाजवाब 11 में भी सूर्य लाजवाब
says: For signs 8 and 9 the Sun (ghee, a Sun item) is excellent, and for sign 11 also; the ghee in the halwa supports these signs through the Sun.
ambiguity: Garbled; ghee is not named in the caption.

hindi: अगर ये हलवा देता है गुरुद्वारे में जा के मीठा
says: If he offers the halwa by going to the gurudwara, sweet in hand, the donation is made there.

hindi: कुछ समझ नहीं आ रहा क्या करना है स्वर्ग टूट रहा है जा के गुरुद्वारे में हलवा दो मंदिर में दे दो
says: When you cannot see what to do and your heaven is breaking down, go and give halwa at a gurudwara or a temple; a general fallback remedy for a collapsing comfort-life.
classical_check: Silent; donation of food at a temple is a common tradition remedy.

hindi: वो हलवा प्रसाद में बटना चाहिए घर नहीं जाएगा
says: That halwa must be distributed as prasad and must not come home; none of it is brought back to the house.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual donation rule that a donated item is not taken back.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर ऑटोमेटिकली आपका स्वर्ग सेट होगा।
says: In your life your heaven will automatically get set; the promised result of the halwa donation. A tradition claim, not measured.

hindi: क्योंकि आप सबसे पहले तो भाग्य को उठा रहे हैं।
says: The reason is that first of all you are lifting your fortune (the 9th-house luck) by the donation.
classical_check: Agrees that charity strengthens the 9th house and Jupiter in tradition.

hindi: भाग्य को उठा रहे हैं तो इससे सुंदर बात नहीं हो सकती।
says: If you are lifting your fortune, nothing could be more beautiful than that; he praises the donation as the best step.

hindi: अब जब इंद्र को आपने सेट रखना है तो आपके वैभव की एक भी चीज डिफेक्टिव नहीं होनी चाहिए।
says: To keep Indra set, not a single item of your luxury should be defective; everything of comfort and show in the home should be in good condition.

hindi: आपके घर में टूटा कांच नहीं होगा।
says: There must be no broken glass in your home; a do-and-don't rule for Uranus.
classical_check: Silent; commonly a vastu and Venus rule.

hindi: आपके घर में फटे हुए कपड़े आप इस्तेमाल नहीं करेंगे।
says: You will not use torn clothes at home; another do-and-don't for keeping Uranus well.

hindi: शुक्र वाले सारे उपाय चलेंगे।
says: All the Venus-type remedies will work for Indra as well, so Venus's cleanliness and luxury-care remedies apply.

hindi: कोई खाना बेकार सड़ा पड़ा हुआ है।
says: If some food is lying around wasted and rotting, it must not be kept; spoiled food in the house hurts Indra.
ambiguity: Said as a statement of a condition, the rule follows in the next line.

hindi: बासी खाना नहीं खाएंगे।
says: You will not eat stale food; a do-and-don't for pleasing Indra.

hindi: राजा कभी बासी खाना खाता है।
says: Does a king ever eat stale food? No; the Indra-king image is used to support the rule of never eating stale food.
ambiguity: Rhetorical.

hindi: राजा नया बनाता है।
says: A king has fresh food made each time; the Indra person should cook and eat fresh.

hindi: राजा टेंशन करता है। हाय पैसे कहां से आएंगे? नहीं।
says: Does a king worry 'alas, where will the money come from'? No; fretting about money is not the king's attitude and weakens Indra.
ambiguity: Rhetorical question followed by 'no'.

hindi: राजा ऑन होता है।
says: A king stays switched on, confident and in command; the Indra remedy is to keep a confident royal frame of mind.

hindi: आपको इंद्र स्थापित करने हैं।
says: Your task is to establish Indra firmly in your life, the aim of this whole remedy list.

hindi: आपको क्लेश नहीं मचाना।
says: You must not create quarrels, a do-not rule: domestic strife weakens Indra's heaven.

gist: Mock worry in question form: where will it come from?
Rhetorical question: but what happens?

hindi: हमारे मन पे छाया पड़ जाती है।
says: A shadow falls over our mind, the source of money-fear and doubt; the shadow planets are blamed next.
classical_check: Agrees with Rahu and Ketu as shadow planets that cloud the mind.

hindi: किसकी? राहु और केतु।
says: Whose shadow? Rahu and Ketu: the shadow planets are the cause of anxious thoughts about money.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu and Ketu cloud the mind.

hindi: वो कहते हैं कहां से लाएंगे? कहां से आएंगे? कहां से आएंगे? कहां से आएंगे?
says: They keep saying 'from where will we bring it, from where will it come', the repeated anxious voice of Rahu and Ketu.
ambiguity: Mimicry of an anxious voice.

hindi: तो जब आप सूर्य पर भरोसा करते हैं यानी उस एक ओंकार पे तो इंद्र मदद करता है आपकी।
says: When you trust the Sun, that is the One Omkar, Indra helps you; faith in the Sun (the supreme) activates Uranus's support.
classical_check: Silent; Sun as the soul planet is classical.

hindi: इसीलिए घर में ईस्ट डायरेक्शन में E5 उस एरिया के अंदर आपको सूर्य की आकृति लगाई जाती है।
says: That is why a Sun figure or symbol is placed in the east direction of the home, in the area called E5; a vastu remedy for strengthening Indra.
ambiguity: E5 is a vastu zone name in his grid system.
classical_check: Silent; a vastu-astrology link of his.

hindi: तो वह एक्चुअली महेंद्र इंद्र को पावर मिलती है ऑटोमेटिकली और घर में स्वर्ग स्थापित होता है।
says: So Mahendra (Indra) actually gets power automatically and heaven is established in the home; the Sun symbol in the east powers Indra.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिकली बेहतरी होती है।
says: Improvement happens automatically after this is done.

hindi: आपको लगता है सामान की कोई कमी ही नहीं है यार कोई चीज का दिक्कत ही नहीं आती कभी।
says: You feel there is no shortage of goods at all and never any difficulty about anything: a well-set Indra gives a sense of plenty.

hindi: कभी ऐसा होता ही नहीं कि गाड़ी में पेट्रोल नहीं है।
says: It never happens that the car is out of petrol; a small everyday sign of a smoothly supplied life.
ambiguity: Illustration.

hindi: और इंद्र के पास क्या है? सारे सेवक हैं।
says: What does Indra have? All the servants: Uranus brings a full set of helpers and staff.

hindi: याद रखें यूरेनस इसलिए इंपॉर्टेंट है क्योंकि यह वो देवता है जो स्वर्ग का देवता है।
says: Remember, Uranus is important because it is the god of heaven; its role is the comfort and abundance of the whole life.

hindi: और हम सब भिखारी बनके मंदिर, मस्जिद, गुरुद्वारे में स्वर्ग के लिए ही रोना पिटना कर रहे हैं दिन रात।
says: All of us go as beggars to temples, mosques and gurudwaras, crying day and night for heaven alone; worship is mostly a plea for comfort.
ambiguity: A social observation used to justify Uranus's importance.

hindi: स्वर्ग की कल्पना के लिए ही शादी करते हैं।
says: We marry only for the imagination of heaven; marriage is also a pursuit of Indra's comfort.

hindi: स्वर्ग की कल्पना ही बच्चों से मिलेगी।
says: The imagination of heaven is expected to come from children; the 5th house too is part of the heaven search.

hindi: ये लिखते हैं घर बनाते हैं।
says: People do these things and build houses (the verb in the caption is garbled); building a home is another heaven-seeking act.
ambiguity: The first word of the caption is garbled.

hindi: मकान, गाड़ी, पैसा, बंगला भविष्य के लिए एफडी करते हैं।
says: House, car, money, bungalow and fixed deposits for the future: all the acquisitions of comfort are part of Indra's domain. A description, not financial advice.

hindi: यह सारा वही खेल है।
says: All of this is the same game: every worldly pursuit is the play of Indra's heaven-seeking.

hindi: अब यह डरा हुआ इंद्र नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: Indra should not be a frightened Indra; a fearful Uranus gives no heaven, so fear must be removed.

hindi: तो आपके अंदर डर तो नहीं है।
says: So check whether there is fear inside you; self-checking for fear is the first step of this remedy.

gist: Instruction: check it.

hindi: अगर डरे हुए हैं तो आपको बृहस्पति चाहिए।
says: If you are frightened you need Jupiter; Jupiter is the cure for a fearful Indra.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the planet of confidence and guidance.

hindi: गुरु फिर चाहिए।
says: A guru is needed again; he equates Jupiter with a teacher in the person's life.

hindi: बृहस्पति का अजीब पंगा है।
says: Jupiter has a strange quirk in this matter; he teases that Jupiter's role is odd.

hindi: वह बीच में आ ही जाता है।
says: Jupiter always comes in the middle, in every story where Indra is stuck; the guru mediates.

hindi: तब सूर्य की कृपा मिलेगी।
says: Then the Sun's grace will be received; Jupiter's guidance leads to the Sun's blessing.

gist: Rhetorical question: and what is the Sun's grace?

hindi: एक ओकार यानी परमात्मा विष्णु आएंगे और इंद्र को सारी कथाएं ऐसी है कि ब्रह्मा जी ने इसको वरदान दे दिया, उसको वरदान दे दिया।
says: The Sun's grace means the One Omkar, the Supreme, Vishnu comes; and in all the stories Brahma gave boons to one party and then to the other, so Indra's trouble keeps being created.
ambiguity: Mixes a remedy statement with a story; caption run-on.
classical_check: Puranic story, not an astrological rule.

hindi: फिर इंद्र ने अपना राज्य हार लिया।
says: Then Indra lost his kingdom, as in the myths; Uranus's heaven can be lost.

gist: Rhetorical question: now what do we do?

hindi: अब दैत्यों से या दानवों से या असुरों से फिर लड़ाई करनी है।
says: Now he must fight again with the demons, from the myth; the lost heaven has to be won back through battle.

hindi: तो फिर वो शिव जी के पास चला गया।
says: So Indra went to Lord Shiva for help; in the myth he seeks shelter with higher powers.

hindi: या तो चंद्रमा या फिर वो विष्णु के पास चला गया।
says: Either to the Moon (Shiva's crescent, a garble) or he went to Vishnu; Indra took refuge in the higher gods, as in each tale.
ambiguity: 'Chandrama' here may be a slip for Shiva's moon-crest.

hindi: बृहस्पति तब जाके फिर उसको उन्होंने यह व दिया वो दिया वो दान किया फिर उसने उस अससुर को मार दिया फिर जीत गया
says: Then Jupiter (the guru) went and arranged boons and gifts for him, after which he killed that demon and won; Jupiter's guidance is what restores Indra's victory.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled in the middle.
classical_check: Puranic story; Jupiter as the gods' priest is Puranic.

hindi: तो हमारे शरीर में जितने पंगे चलते हैं अगड़म बगड़म घर में जितने पंगेशंगे चलते हैं झगड़े के हमारे घर की शांति जो स्वर्ग वाली है दैवत्व नहीं कह रहा अय्याशी ऐश मस्ती वाली वो शांति भंग हो गई
says: By analogy, all the troubles in our body and home, the quarrels that break the heaven-like peace of the household (not divine peace but the peace of pleasure and fun), are the demon fights; the sentence runs into the next chunk where the party was going on.
ambiguity: Run-on sentence crossing a chunk boundary.

hindi: थे मजा अब उसको ठीक कौन करेगा आप लोग नहीं कर सकते इसलिए आपको गुरु चाहिए तीसरा बिचोलिया चाहिए
says: They were enjoying a big party; who will fix it now? You cannot do it yourselves, so you need a guru, a third-party mediator.
ambiguity: Starts in the middle of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter as the counsellor or mediator.

hindi: इसलिए अपने घर के जितने भी प्रेम रोमांस मस्ती ऐश इसके लफड़े सुलझाने हैं।
says: Therefore all the entanglements of love, romance, fun and pleasure in your home that have to be sorted out need an outside helper.

hindi: उसके लिए आपको एक तीसरा व्यक्ति चाहिए जो गुरु है।
says: For that you need a third person who is a guru; Jupiter-type elder or counsellor is the mediator in love and household disputes.
classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter as the counsellor.

hindi: शनि नहीं चाहिए।
says: Not Saturn: Saturn is not the right mediator for this task.

hindi: शनि बिचोलिया वो तीसरा व्यक्ति है जो दलाली करता है बीच में तेरा और 13 दोनों के बीच फैसला करा दूं।
says: A Saturn-type mediator is the third person who brokers for a commission and says 'let me settle between you and me (the caption says 13)'; Saturn takes a cut and has his own interest.
ambiguity: '13' is a garble of 'mera' or similar.

hindi: नहीं फैसला नहीं कराए गुरु जो उसको संभालेगा क्योंकि बृहस्पति की कृपा से ही आपका खोया हुआ साम्राज्य लौट के आ सकता है।
says: No, it is not about settling a deal; the guru who will handle it, because only by Jupiter's grace can your lost empire return.

hindi: तो ये वो देवता है जिनके दूसरे ग्रहों के कारण से सपोर्ट से आपको लाइफ में बेटरमेंट होती है।
says: So Indra is the deity whose improvement in your life comes through the support of other planets; Uranus gives its best only with help from its supporters.

hindi: अब इंद्र यहां पर बैठा हुआ है।
says: Now Indra sits here in the example chart, he points at the position of Uranus.

hindi: इंद्र यहां बैठा हुआ है दो नंबर का।
says: Indra sits here in sign number 2 (Taurus), the same example Uranus as before.

gist: Rhetorical question: what will we do for this?

hindi: जब चंद्रमा घूमता हुआ 27 दिन में या 29 दिन 30 दिन लगा लो।
says: The Moon goes around the zodiac in 27 days, or take 29 or 30 days; he cites the Moon's cycle length before using it as a transit trigger.
ambiguity: 27 days is the sidereal period, 29 to 30 days the synodic month.

hindi: घूमता हुआ यहां आएगा।
says: Moving along, the Moon will come to this place (the position of Uranus in the chart).

hindi: फिर यहां आएगा तो चंद्रमा इन दोनों के साथ मिल जाएगा।
says: When the Moon arrives here it will join these two planets, meaning the transit Moon conjoins the natal pair for about two days.
ambiguity: 'These two' are the planets in this house of the example chart.
classical_check: Agrees with the practice of reading the transiting Moon over natal planets.

gist: Says the Moon will read or see how it is placed; no clear rule.

hindi: दो नंबर राशि लाजवाब है।
says: Sign 2 (Taurus) is excellent here for the transit; the Moon is exalted in Taurus, so its pass through this sign is the best of days.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; the Moon is exalted in Taurus in the 2nd and strengthens the wealth house during its stay.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn; the exalted Moon in Taurus in the 5th lifts romance and children matters during the transit.

ambiguity: He gives no reason; exaltation is added by the note.
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon is exalted in Taurus.

hindi: चंद्रमा यहां आएगा इंद्र।
says: The Moon will come here, to Indra; the transit Moon on natal Uranus is the trigger he is naming.

hindi: उन दिनों में आप बड़ा बढ़िया-बढ़िया गिफ्टें शिफ्टें मिलेंगे आपको।
says: In those days you will receive very nice gifts: the Moon's passage over Indra gives presents and pleasant surprises.
ambiguity: Duration is only the couple of days of the Moon's stay.

gist: Aside: who knows what the matter will be.
Cut off mid-word: 'maja aa...' at the chunk end.
Tail of the previous sentence: 'it was fun, man'.

hindi: लाजवाब काम हो रहा है भाई।
says: Superb work is going on, brother; he sums up the good days of the transit Moon over natal Uranus as excellent.

gist: Repeats that things are going very well.

hindi: अब यहां पर घूमता हुआ चंद्रमा कहीं और निकल गया।
says: Now the moving Moon has gone away to another place; the good Moon-on-Uranus days are over after about two days.
classical_check: Agrees that a transit Moon stays about two and a quarter days in a sign.

hindi: यहां सूर्य आ गया।
says: Now the Sun has arrived here: the transit Sun comes into the sign of natal Uranus (Taurus).

gist: Rhetorical question: how is the Sun in sign 2?

hindi: खतरनाक।
says: The transit Sun in sign 2 (Taurus) over a natal Uranus there is dangerous; one-word verdict.
cells_derived_method: The danger lands on the house department Taurus occupies in the chart: 2nd gives money and family, 5th gives romance and children, 10th gives career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries; the Sun transit over Uranus in the 2nd shakes money, family and speech for a month.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo; the transit shakes the career and authority matters.

classical_check: Silent; classical gochara does not use Uranus.

hindi: कातिल फाड़ देता है।
says: It is like a killer and tears things apart: the Sun on Uranus rips and breaks things.
ambiguity: Figurative.

hindi: उन दिनों में आपके चीजे फाड़ दोगे।
says: In those days you yourself will tear your things; clothes and belongings get torn during this transit.

hindi: आप खुद ही अपने सेंट की शीशी जो महंगी वाली लाए होंगे फूट जाएगी गिर के।
says: Even the expensive perfume bottle you brought will fall and break; an example of luxury items shattering in the Sun-over-Uranus days.

hindi: आपके घर में कांच गिरेगा।
says: Glass will fall in your house in those days, a breakage claim for the transit.

hindi: आपके हाथ से टूट के गिरेगा।
says: Something will slip from your hand and break; the breakage happens through your own hands.

hindi: कोई कपड़ा फट जाएगा।
says: Some cloth or garment will tear in these days.

gist: Garbled two words, perhaps 'a scratch/tear will appear'; unclear.
Mock complaint: oh no, my good, expensive slipper is spoilt.
Mock complaint: a crack has appeared in my purse.

hindi: ये उन दिनों में ऐसा होगा एक महीने का ऐसा समय बीतेगा।
says: This will happen in those days; a period of about one month will pass like this, the time the transit Sun takes to cross the sign.
ambiguity: The 'month' is the Sun's stay in the sign; the worst part is when it is near the natal degree.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun spends about a month per sign.

hindi: जब वो इसके आसपास की डिग्री के साथ जाएगा।
says: It is worst when the Sun passes through degrees close to the natal planet; the danger peaks with a close degree match.
classical_check: Agrees with the practice of watching transits close to natal degrees.

gist: Rhetorical question: what is Indra's degree here?
A listener says 'yes'.

hindi: इंद्र की डिग्री है एक नंबर।
says: Indra's degree is number 1, about 1 degree of Taurus in the example chart; the Sun's transit matters when it reaches near 1 degree.
ambiguity: 'Number 1' is a degree here, not a sign.

hindi: अब सूर्य जैसे ही इस राशि में एक नंबर के पास एंटर करेगा फट से दोनों के अंदर अटैक होगा।
says: As soon as the Sun enters this sign near the degree 1, an attack happens in both at once; the transit Sun triggers the natal Uranus immediately on entry.
ambiguity: 'Both' likely means the natal planet and the sign or house.

hindi: और 10 डिग्री तक का सूरज होगा।
says: And it lasts while the Sun is up to 10 degrees, which is about 10 days; the rough window of the effect.
ambiguity: The 10-degree orb is his own rule of thumb.

hindi: इसकी बैंड बजा के रखेगा।
says: It will wreck him thoroughly; the Sun makes a mess of the Uranus house during those days.

gist: Rhetorical question: why will it wreck him?

hindi: क्योंकि दो नंबर का है।
says: Because it is sign 2, Taurus, where the Sun is not at ease with Venus's sign and Uranus is already inflamed.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is an enemy of the Sun.
