ambiguity: Crosses a chunk boundary.

hindi: यह शब्द कहा जाता है के ये इतनी ज्यादा दूर है कि इनका क्या असर होता है।
says: The objection people raise is that these outer planets are so far away, what effect could they have; he states the sceptic's point before answering it.

hindi: यह तो जो कॉस्मोस की स्टडी करते हैं उनसे पूछो कि यूरेनस ने कितने जबरदस्त मैग्नेटिक फील्ड से संभाल के रखा हुआ है शनि को।
says: Ask those who study the cosmos how strong a magnetic field Uranus uses to hold Saturn in check; he rebuts the distance objection by appeal to cosmic influence.
ambiguity: A scientific claim of his; not astrological.
classical_check: Silent; the physical claim is doubtful.

hindi: नेप्च्यून ने कैसे इसको संभाल के रखा हुआ है।
says: And how Neptune holds Uranus in its own place; the outer planets hold each other in a chain of influence.
ambiguity: Scientific claim of his.

hindi: प्लूटो कैसे केप्लर बेल्ट में एक अलग से घूम रहा है।
says: How Pluto moves separately in the Kuiper belt (the caption says Kepler belt); Pluto is described as a distant outlier body.
ambiguity: 'Kepler belt' is a slip for the Kuiper belt.

hindi: हजारों लाखों पड़े होंगे कॉमेट्स वहां छोटे-छोटे टुकड़े डेबरी में मतलब कूड़ा है एक तरह कूड़े की बेल्ट है बहुत बड़ी सर।
says: Thousands and lakhs of comets and small fragments of debris lie there; it is a huge belt of rubbish, he says, describing the Kuiper belt.

gist: Rhetorical question: why does only Pluto roam apart like a chief?
Rhetorical question: who is pulling them?

hindi: ये सूर्य खींच रहा है।
says: The Sun is pulling them: all the outer planets are held by the Sun, so the Sun's pull ties them to our chart.

gist: A listener asks in which metal the stones should be set, whether white gold.

hindi: वाइट गोल्ड में डालो इसको।
says: Set this stone in white gold: the metal for the Uranus gem is white gold.
classical_check: Silent; classically gems are set in gold, silver or other planet-specific metals.

hindi: ओपल को चाहे वाइट मूंगा को वाइट मूंगा है बेसिकली इसके लिए वाइट वाइट गोल्ड
says: Whether it is opal or white coral, basically for it white gold is the setting; the caption is garbled but the meaning is white gold for these stones.
ambiguity: Garbled stutter.

hindi: हां चांदी में डालो चांदी में डालो कोई दिक्कत नहीं है
says: Yes, set it in silver; there is no problem with silver either, silver is an accepted alternative metal.
classical_check: Agrees that silver is an accepted gem metal.

hindi: वाइट गोल्ड में डालो ओके
says: White gold is fine too, confirming to the listener that it is okay.

hindi: येलो गोल्ड नहीं येलो गोल्ड अवॉयड करो
says: Not yellow gold; avoid yellow gold for the Uranus stones, as yellow brings in the Sun and Jupiter's colour.
classical_check: Differs; classical practice favours gold for many stones.

hindi: हां डाल सकते हैं अवॉयड करो तो ज्यादा अच्छा है।
says: Yes, one can use it but avoiding yellow gold is better; a soft instruction.

hindi: क्योंकि हमें इंद्र से पार्टी चाहिए ना हमारा मकसद
says: Because we want a party from Indra, that is our aim; the reason for the metal choice is to keep Indra's enjoyment, with the sentence cut off at the end.
ambiguity: Cut at the end of the chunk.

hindi: समझो इंद्र को हम क्या कर रहे हैं इंद्र हमारा वैभव पर पार्टी का ग्रह है
says: Indra (Uranus in his 12-planet scheme) is the planet of vaibhav (grandeur, riches) and party/enjoyment in a person's life.
cells_derived_method: Uranus is a planet-wide significator; the house it sits in shows where the enjoyment/grandeur theme plays out (11th gains and friends, 5th romance and fun, 4th home comforts) and the sign colours the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Libra would point to enjoyment and grandeur coming through networks, social circles and gains, with a refined, aesthetic style.
Derived: Uranus in the 4th in Taurus would point to luxury and parties centred on home, vehicles and comforts, in a sensual, material style.

ambiguity: Uranus is not a classical Parashari planet; this is his own karaka assignment.
classical_check: Silent: Parashari texts have no Uranus; luxury is classically Venus.

hindi: बृहस्पति क्या है बृहस्पति वैभव पार्टी का ग्रह नहीं है वैभव पावर पावर का खेल है वो बृहस्पति के पास पावर है
says: Jupiter is not the party planet; its domain is power and authority, the weight of position, which is separate from the fun side Indra covers.
ambiguity: Caption is muddled: he says vaibhav is not Jupiter's, then calls vaibhav a game of power that Jupiter holds. Read as: party is Indra, power is Jupiter.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically Jupiter is wealth, wisdom and authority, so power fits, but party is not Jupiter's.

hindi: जो पहले ही पार्टी कर रहा है वो क्या बदनाम होगा बृहस्पति पावर का है नईनई तरीके से रहना है वो बदनाम हो सकता है
says: Someone already openly partying has little reputation to lose, while a Jupiter, power-type person who suddenly starts living in new indulgent ways can get defamed.
ambiguity: Garbled caption; the contrast between an established party person and a Jupiter-image person adopting new ways is inferred.

hindi: ये तो केतु को भी फाड़ देता है और केतु बृहस्पति की ऐसी तैसी फेर देता है और ये ये बृहस्पति से भीख मांगता है
says: Indra overpowers even Ketu, Ketu in turn wrecks Jupiter, and (Indra or Ketu) is left begging from Jupiter, a pecking-order of strength among these planets.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the last 'ये' is Indra or Ketu; also the chain is figurative, not a defined rule.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu harming Jupiter (guru-chandal style) has some classical echo with Rahu, not Ketu.

gist: Garbled line about a cycle or circle and Indra's different behaviours; cannot tell what is claimed.

hindi: इंद्र का अच्छा करने का मतलब है आपके लाइफ में मजा पार्टी है कितना मजा
says: Setting Indra right means real fun and celebration in your life; a well-placed Indra equals a life with a lot of enjoyment.

hindi: राजा जनक एक बड़ा कमाल का एग्जांपल है यार। पार्टी भी पूरी है और त्याग भी पूरा है।
says: King Janak is held up as the model of full enjoyment together with full renunciation, showing indulgence and detachment can coexist.
ambiguity: Janak is a scriptural exemplar, not a chart he analyses.
classical_check: Consistent with the Upanishadic image of Janak as a royal sage (rajarshi).

gist: Describes Janak's palaces, children, wives, luxury and complete knowledge, saying such a character is hard to find.

hindi: बृहस्पति भी सेट किया हुआ है। शुक्र भी सेट किया हुआ है। सूर्य भी किया हुआ है।
says: Janak is described as having Jupiter, Venus and the Sun all set (strengthened); this trio of knowledge, comforts and authority is the combination behind his rich-yet-wise life.
ambiguity: No actual placements given; 'set' means worked on or strong, not a stated house or sign.
classical_check: Silent; there is no horoscope of Janak in classical texts.

hindi: गुरु भी रखा हुआ है। टेढ़ामेढ़ा शरीर का अष्टा वक्र उसको गुरु भी रखा हुआ है।
says: Janak also kept a guru, Ashtavakra, the man with the twisted body, so the guru (Jupiter) factor is held in his life even though he is a king.
classical_check: Matches the Ashtavakra Gita tradition, where Ashtavakra instructs Janak.

hindi: क्यों रखा हुआ है? तू खुद गुरु से कम नहीं है। क्योंकि वो खुद गुरु का सपोर्ट लेके चलता है।
says: Janak is no less than a guru himself, yet he still walks with a guru's support; even a strong person should keep a Jupiter-type mentor beside them.

hindi: कितना बुद्धिमान रहा होगा राजा जनक। उस पट्ठे को पता है बृहस्पति से साथ रखूंगा अपने टेढ़ा हो मे हो भाई ज्ञान है
says: Janak's wisdom lay in knowing to keep Jupiter (knowledge) with him regardless of the teacher's outward form; Jupiter is chosen for knowledge, not looks.
ambiguity: Caption is rough around the middle words.

hindi: देखो कहां है वो जीते जी मोक्ष पाने वालों में से लिस्ट है उनकी स्वर्ग लोक के अंदर बैठने वाले लोगों में से इंद्र भी कहता है आइए हुजूर सेवा में सब उपलब्ध है
says: Janak is counted among those liberated while alive and also among those seated in heaven, where Indra himself welcomes him and offers every comfort; liberation and luxury are both available to him.
ambiguity: Mixes the mythological Indra (king of heaven) with Indra as the planet Uranus.
classical_check: Consistent with Janak as jivanmukta in the Puranic and Upanishadic accounts.

hindi: ये कैरेक्टरिस्टिक्स इसलिए आपके जीवन की ऐश मस्ती अय्याशी सारी इसी से चलेगी कि आपने इंद्र कितना अच्छा किया
says: All the luxury, fun and indulgence in your life will run on how well you have done Indra; the quality of that planet fixes your pleasure level.
ambiguity: 'Done well' is not defined as a placement; it means strengthened or well-handled.
classical_check: Silent; classically Venus and the 5th/7th/12th houses govern pleasure.

hindi: शुक्र होता है तो परफ्यूम ला के इस्तेमाल करता है इंद्र होता है तो परफ्यूम ला के बांटता है
says: A Venus-dominant person buys perfume to use for himself, while an Indra-dominant person buys it to distribute; Venus is self-enjoyment, Indra is enjoyment through sharing.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as luxury significator is classical, the Indra contrast is his own.

gist: Filler remark asking the audience to see how big this story is.

hindi: शुक्र कहता आ परफ्यूम आ गया। महंगे-महंगे बैग मजा आ गया।
says: Venus behaviour is portrayed as delight at personally owning expensive goods such as perfume and bags; its joy is in acquiring for oneself.
classical_check: Agrees with Venus as significator of luxury goods.

hindi: इंद्र कहता बांटो राजा है। मैं भी मेरे लिए भी खोल लो एक मैं भी लगाऊंगा परफ्यूम। तुम भी खाओ।
says: Indra behaviour is the king's generosity: share it round, open one for me too, you eat as well; it is open-handed enjoyment of the whole group.

hindi: आपके कैरेक्टरिस्टिक में होना चाहिए कि खाओ खाओ उड़ाओ मेरे लिए बचा दे दो नहीं बचा ना सही।
says: Your own temperament should be to eat, spend and let others enjoy, with no worry if nothing is left for you; he treats this free-spending attitude as the behavioural way to build Indra.
ambiguity: This is generosity advice, not financial advice; do not read it as an instruction to overspend.
classical_check: Silent; conduct-based remedies exist classically (dana), but not this one.

hindi: वो बृहस्पति कंट्रोलोल्ड इंद्र है।
says: Janak's type is a Jupiter-controlled Indra: abundant enjoyment held in check by wisdom, which is why he stays a sage.
ambiguity: No chart configuration given for 'controlled'; could mean Jupiter aspecting or conjoining Uranus.

hindi: इसलिए आपके एक-एक ग्रह की बहुत मजबूती जरूरी है। और यह तो
says: Therefore each individual planet in the chart needs real strength, since each one runs its own part of life.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off and continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical emphasis on graha bala.

hindi: बहुत लॉन्ग टर्म इफेक्ट देने वाले प्लनेट्स हैं।
says: These planets (Indra and the other outer ones he is discussing) give very long-term effects, working over a lifetime, not over short periods.
ambiguity: 'These' is not named; read as Indra and the other outer planets since the sentence began in the prior chunk.

hindi: इनके लिए आप मंगल की तरह ही इंद्र के लिए ट्रीटमेंट और उपाय आप कर सकते हैं।
says: Remedies and treatment for a weak Indra can be done the same way as for Mars, so he maps Uranus remedies onto the Mars set.
ambiguity: The specific Mars remedies are not given here.
classical_check: Silent; no classical Uranus remedies exist.

hindi: बृहस्पति और सूर्य इसके साथ लाजवाब काम करते हैं।
says: Jupiter and the Sun work very well alongside Indra, so strengthening them supports Uranus.
ambiguity: Unclear whether this is a remedy (strengthen Jupiter and Sun) or a friendship claim among the planets.
classical_check: Silent; Sun and Jupiter are classical friends.

hindi: याद रखें सबसे बड़ा बेनिफिट अगर कोई व्यक्ति ये कहता है ऐश मत करो मस्ती मत करो तो वो बकवास है।
says: Advice that tells you to stop enjoying and partying is rubbish in his view; the real benefit of fixing planets is that you can enjoy without fighting yourself.
ambiguity: Opinion against abstinence-style advice; the first words say 'the biggest benefit', which is cut off from its antecedent.
classical_check: Differs: many classical traditions advise restraint as a remedy.

gist: Apologises in advance to anyone who gives such advice, says no disrespect is meant.

hindi: लेकिन अगर वो कहता है ऐसा मत करो तो हमारे हाथ में नहीं है। कौन बच्चा चाहता है करे?
says: Telling people not to do something does not work, because these habits are not in our control; no child wants to misbehave and be caught.
ambiguity: The subject of 'वो' is unclear; read as the advisor.
classical_check: Silent; agrees with the idea that urges come from the chart (karma) not will.

gist: Example of parents catching a child and the child being beaten, used to show nobody wants to be caught.
Example of a husband and wife hiding drinking and smoking from each other, being caught and fighting.

hindi: कौन चाहता है लड़ना कोई नहीं चाहता इसलिए हम मजबूर है पता नहीं कैसे हो जाता अब उसमें हम उल्टा कोसने और लड़ने बैठ जाते
says: Nobody wants the fights and vices; people feel helpless as it just happens to them, and then they compound it by cursing and quarrelling over it.

hindi: खबरदार खबरदार ये किया तो तुम पापी हो फलाने हो ढिमकाने हो अरे भाई नसीम में लिखा है उसकी ट्रीटमेंट करो
says: Instead of branding someone a sinner for a vice, accept it is written in their destiny (nasib) and treat it with the planetary remedy, so scolding is replaced by treatment.
ambiguity: 'नसीम' is a caption error for नसीब (destiny); the sentence runs over into the next chunk with 'करो'.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that tendencies come from karma shown in the chart, remedied by shanti.

gist: Claims only 23 to 24 percent of liver failures come from drinking and the rest did not drink; a medical statistic, not recorded as astrology.
Says only a small share of road accidents involve drunk drivers (figure garbled as 202 percent) and that the rest had not been drinking.
Quips that the bad name is all hype (munni badnaam), nothing more.

hindi: इसलिए ये हमारी साइकोलॉजी को हिप्नोसिस में डाला गया। हिप्नोसिस सारा राहु के पास है।
says: Society has hypnotised our psychology into believing vices are the cause of ruin, and all hypnosis and conditioning belongs to Rahu.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: Rahu is illusion, delusion and mass-mind influence.

gist: Repeats that this has been put into hypnosis and says it is nothing real.

hindi: क्यों ना ऐसे प्लनेट्स मजबूत किए जाए कि हम ऐब करना चाहते हैं नहीं करना चाहते। हम तो बचे रह।
says: Better to strengthen the relevant planets so that whether or not we want to indulge in vices we stay protected from their damage.
ambiguity: Which planets is not stated; context suggests Indra with Jupiter and the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with strengthening planets (graha shanti) over moral prohibition.

hindi: चाहे आप ऐब करो, चाहे आप ना करो। हो सकता है ऐब की वजह से ही सब बढ़िया हो।
says: Whether you indulge in vices or not, it is possible that the vices themselves are what make everything go well; vice is not automatically the cause of failure.
ambiguity: A provocative claim, not a rule; he is arguing against vice-equals-ruin. Not an endorsement for the user to act on.
classical_check: Differs from classical dharmic ethics, which links vices to decline.

hindi: कौन से ऐसे बड़े-बड़े पद हैं? कौन से ऐसे बड़े-बड़े कुर्सियों का काम, बड़े-बड़े टेंडरर्स, बड़ी बिल्डिंगों के पास जिसमें ऐ्याशी नहीं चलती।
says: He asks which big posts, big chairs, large tenders and big buildings do not involve indulgence; his claim is that high positions of power usually come with luxury living.
ambiguity: Social observation used as argument, not a planetary rule.

hindi: रेयर कोई होगा तो बहुत अच्छी बात। करप्शन जबरदस्त चलती है और वो फलते फूलते हैं कितने तगड़े।
says: Any exception is welcome, but corruption runs strong in such posts and those people flourish; he uses this to argue that prosperity does not track virtue.
ambiguity: Social commentary supporting the argument; not an astrological rule and not endorsing corruption.

hindi: फिर लोग कहते हैं ये पाप कर्म करने वालों की बहुत बड़ी कमाल की बात है। ये तो बहुत अच्छा करते हैं। जी। ये कैसे बनता है? जब आपके एटीट्यूड में ये चीज हो।
says: People wonder how so-called sinners do so well; his answer is that such success is built when this royal, open-handed trait is in your attitude, which is how Indra is activated.
ambiguity: 'ये चीज' (this thing) is the generous, king-like attitude from the earlier chunk.

gist: Mock scene of haggling over tinde (apple gourd) and demanding free coriander from the vendor.
Examples of bargaining the rickshaw fare down and taking free chillies and mint from the vegetable seller.

hindi: कैसे राजा बनेंगे हम? राजा राजा होता है यार। तभी तो इंद्र आएगा आपकी लाइफ में काम करने के लिए और हम कंजूसी करते हैं।
says: Petty haggling and stinginess stop you from becoming a king; Indra comes to work in your life only when you act like a king, so miserliness keeps Indra away.
ambiguity: Behavioural guideline about conduct, not a financial recommendation.

gist: Skit about someone asking why the fan is running, answered that the electricity bill will be paid by the father or the Lord.

hindi: वो कसता है के पंखे बंद करो कारण से करता है वो कस रहा है उसे पंखे से सैपा नहीं है ये राजा के संकेत है तो आप राजा
says: Policing small things like switching off fans is not the sign of a king; kingly signs are a relaxed attitude to small expenses, and without them you cannot become a king.
ambiguity: Caption is badly garbled in the middle ('सैपा'); only the general point is recoverable. The sentence ends in the next chunk with 'कैसे बनेंगे'.

hindi: कैसे बनेंगे आपका यूरेनस कैसे पावर पकड़ेगा ये तब पावर पकड़ेगा जब आप में वो गुण होंगे
says: Your Uranus gains real power only when you carry the qualities of a king; the planet's strength follows your character, not just its placement.
cells_derived_method: Placement gives potential only; the 10th (status) or 11th (gains) house position is where kingly qualities would show results, with sign style differing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 10th in Capricorn would need disciplined, protective leadership qualities to turn into public power and status.
Derived: Uranus in the 5th in Leo would need a generous, royal-hearted attitude to show up as creative, followers-and-fun type prosperity.

classical_check: Silent; classical texts treat planet strength as placement-based (shadbala), not conduct-based.

hindi: और वो गुण अगर नहीं है तो समझो कुंडली में ये डिस्टर्बड है
says: If those kingly qualities are missing, take it that Uranus is disturbed in the chart; he uses behaviour as the diagnostic for the planet's condition.
ambiguity: No chart test (afflicting planets, house) is given; the test is behavioural only.

hindi: राजा छोटी-छोटी बात पे ची ची नहीं करता राजा आश्रय देता अभय देता है, प्रेम करता है, रक्षा करता है।
says: The king does not fuss over small matters; he gives shelter, fearlessness, love and protection. These are the traits of a healthy Uranus.
classical_check: Silent; the king image is classically Sun, which he is blending with Indra.

hindi: इसलिए अपने जीवन के सारे स्वर्ग, सारे आनंद के लिए इंद्र को सेट रखो।
says: For all the heaven and joy in life, keep Indra set right; he names Uranus as the planet to prioritise for happiness.

gist: Audience question: if calling someone bad harms Indra, is it wrong to tell a wrongdoer or for parents to scold a child.

hindi: बिल्कुल डांटो। बहुत सुंदर बात है। पर वो सत्य है। आप यह कह रहे हो कि भैया भाई साहब आप बहुत अच्छे हो और बाद में बुराई कर रहे हो। यह इंद्र है। वहां इंद्र डिस्ट्रॉय होता है।
says: Scolding is fine when it is true; Indra is destroyed when you praise someone to his face and then run him down behind his back, so hypocrisy damages Indra.
ambiguity: Mix of answer and rule; the destroyed-Indra trigger is two-faced behaviour, not criticism itself.

hindi: सपाट बोल दो मुंह पर तू है ही बेवकूफ। कोई इंद्र डिस्ट्रॉय नहीं है।
says: Telling someone bluntly to his face that he is a fool does not harm Indra; honest, direct speech is safe.

gist: Says if he is a fool then he is, and if you only think so, it is true for you; a personal view on judgement.
Sentence breaks off at 'the king, does he fear' with no ending in this slice.
Tail of the previous point: says people have turned the king into a coward, that stories do not show this, and that it is divine leela.
Audience question: how to balance gratitude in everything with the 'son-in-law never pleased' attitude.
Repeats the same audience question about balancing gratitude and never being pleased.

hindi: जमाईसा खुश ना हो रहे का मतलब आप एक ऐसे एटीट्यूड पर है कि आपको फर्क ही नहीं पड़ता किसी चीज से।
says: The 'jamai-sa not pleased' stance is read as an attitude where no outcome moves you, a detached indifference rather than real dissatisfaction.
ambiguity: Garbled; later in the chunk he reframes the same phrase as being about material things, so he gives two readings.
classical_check: Silent; this is psychology, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: तो बेसिकली ये ग्रेट की एक किस्म है कि यार परमात्मा इतना दे तो रहा है। जो वो नहीं दे रहा है वो भी वो दे रहा है। कि तुम्हें यह दे रहा हूं कि ये नहीं दूंगा। शिक्षा दे रहा हूं।
says: Gratitude means seeing that God is already giving a lot, and that even what he withholds is a lesson, so a refusal is itself a form of giving.

hindi: तो वह सरेंडर है वह ग्रेटट्यूड है और जमाई सा खुश ना होने का मतलब चिज्जी से है।
says: That acceptance is surrender and it is what gratitude means, whereas not being pleased belongs to wanting things (chizzi, material objects).
ambiguity: 'चिज्जी' is a colloquial word for objects or material goods.

hindi: एक ग्रेटट्यूड एनर्जी बॉडी का खेल है और जो चिजजी की चीज है उसमें जमाईसा खुश ना हो रहे हैं।
says: Gratitude is a matter of the energy body, while dissatisfaction lives in the world of objects; the two operate on different levels so they do not actually conflict.

hindi: आप जब तक ये रियलाइज नहीं करेंगे हम एनर्जी बॉडी की बात कर रहे हैं या चिजी की तब तक समझ नहीं आएगा।
says: Until you realise whether a matter is of the energy body or of material things, the answer will not make sense; you must first identify the level.

gist: Everyday example of parents scolding a child for doing it this way and not that way.

hindi: क्यों नहीं एनर्जी बॉडी से बात करते हैं। हे परमात्मा मेरे बच्चे को ये बुद्धि दे। क्या बुद्धि चीज होती है?
says: Rather than scolding the child, address the energy body and pray that God grants the child intelligence; he then asks what buddhi (intellect) really is, setting up his answer.
classical_check: Silent; prayer for a child's intellect (Gayatri style) exists but this is his framing.

hindi: बुद्धि एनर्जी बॉडी है। आपको एनर्जी बॉडी को ठीक शुद्ध करना है।
says: Buddhi (intellect) is an energy-body quality, so improving a child's mind means cleaning and purifying the energy body.
classical_check: Silent; classically buddhi links to Mercury and Jupiter and the 5th house.

hindi: बच्चे को शरीर को कूटने से कोई फायदा नहीं। प्रेम एनर्जी बॉडी का खेल है। गिफ्टें देकर नहीं होता प्रेम।
says: Beating the child's body gains nothing, and love is also an energy-body matter that gifts cannot create.

gist: Audience asks: when he tells a client the work will not happen, is it written that way or does his saying it cause it.

hindi: वैसे ये तो बात पक्की है। बोल दिया तो तो नहीं होगा। पता नहीं लिखा है कि नहीं लिखा।
says: He says it is certain that if the astrologer says it will not happen, it will not, and he cannot tell whether it was actually written in the chart; the spoken word carries force.
ambiguity: It is unclear if he means the prediction becomes true by his saying it or just that clients take it so.
classical_check: Silent; classical ethics advise astrologers to speak gently and not give harsh predictions.

hindi: जो आपने लिख के दे दी लिख के दे दी तो पाप किए आपने अगर बुरा लिखा अच्छा लिखा तो पार्टी करो मौज करो मुझे कुछ नहीं चाहिए
says: If an astrologer hands over a written bad prediction, he has committed a sin, whereas a good written prediction is fine to celebrate; written negative forecasts are discouraged.
ambiguity: Fragmentary; read as a warning for astrologers about written bad news.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical caution against frightening predictions.

hindi: असल में सच्चाई की बात है जो हमने कहा वो हमने नहीं कहा पता नहीं कोई और कह रहा है वो एक रॉ चलती है जो लिखा है वो हमने नहीं लिखा
says: In truth what he says he does not say himself; someone else speaks through him, so a raw stream flows and what is written is not his own authorship.
ambiguity: Personal claim of being a channel; not testable.

hindi: खुद को हटा दो बीच रास्ते में से बहुत बड़ी शक्ति है जो कराती है ये हम थोड़ी करते हैं
says: Get yourself out of the way, because a very large power does everything and we are not the doer; he advises dropping the ego-doer.
classical_check: Silent; echoes the Gita doctrine of non-doership.

gist: Garbled line about teaching, going down and sitting down, with a word cut off.

hindi: बाल्टी लेने जाओ। मूलाधार से बाल्टी उठा के ऊपर ले आओ। इसको छोड़ना थोड़ी है।
says: Go down and fetch the bucket: lift the energy up from the muladhara (root centre) and bring it up, and do not abandon the root centre.
ambiguity: Metaphor of drawing a bucket from a well; the lead-in is garbled so the exact practice is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; it is yogic, not Jyotish.

hindi: डरो ना डरना मना थोड़ी है। डरो डर के फिर ऊपर आ जाओ या फिर परमात्मा की गोद में बैठो और डरते डरते काम करो कि तुम हमारे साथ है।
says: Fear is not forbidden: feel it and then rise above it, or sit in God's lap and act while afraid, trusting that he is with you.

hindi: अर्जुन तू डरता रहे। मैं बैठा हूं। प्रभु आ गया। जब वो आ गया आपका रथ चलाएगा तो आपका कोई लेना देना ही नहीं है।
says: Like Arjuna, you may keep fearing; once the Lord drives your chariot you carry no burden, so surrender removes your responsibility for the result.
classical_check: Consistent with the Bhagavad Gita image of Krishna as charioteer.

gist: Moves on to the next audience question.
Questioner says after all the classes his conclusion is that Jupiter is the most important planet, since the guru's grace starts the whole cycle and the rest of the planets then align.
Questioner confirms he will note it down, with an acknowledgement.

hindi: क्या ऐसा है? क्या ऐसा है? सारे प्लनेट इंपॉर्टेंट है। इन्होंने एक आस्पेक्ट से बात कर दी।
says: He rejects the idea that Jupiter alone is the key: all planets are important and the questioner has spoken from only one angle.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that every graha matters according to lordship and placement.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति से भी तगड़ा प्लनेट बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट प्लनेट है केतु
says: Ketu is a planet even stronger than Jupiter and extremely important, the counter-example to Jupiter being supreme.
ambiguity: Strength comparison is rhetorical, not measured.
classical_check: Differs: classically Jupiter is the greatest benefic; Ketu is a malefic shadow planet, though it is the moksha karaka.

gist: Playfully asks where Ketu suddenly came from and promises a Ketu class when God arranges it.

hindi: केतु धो के रख देता है
says: Ketu washes everything clean and leaves nothing standing, stripping away what the person holds.
cells_derived_method: Where Ketu sits shows which area of life gets washed out: in the 2nd, family wealth and speech; in the 10th, career identity; in the 7th, partnership attachments.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 2nd in Taurus would wash away attachment to family money and food, a stripped-down relationship with savings.
Derived: Ketu in the 10th in Capricorn would wash away career ego, with work done without attachment to status.

classical_check: Agrees broadly: Ketu gives detachment and loss in its house.

hindi: मोक्ष का द्वार ही केतु है
says: Ketu itself is the door to moksha, liberation.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical moksha karaka.

hindi: अब आप बृहस्पति ज्ञानी महाराज बन गए केतु भ्रष्ट करता है उस फालतू के ज्ञानी को क्योंकि वो अहंकारी हो जाता है
says: When a Jupiter-type person becomes a self-styled learned master, Ketu corrupts that pointless 'gyani', because such a person turns arrogant.
ambiguity: No chart configuration (conjunction, aspect, dasha) is stated; it is a behavioural tendency.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu with Jupiter is classically a spiritual or detached combination.

hindi: केतु ही कृपा करता है उसके ज्ञान को भी तोड़ के डाउन करता है ज्ञान का भी अहंकार हो जाता है
says: It is Ketu's grace that breaks down even a person's knowledge and ego about knowledge, so the humbling is a favour.

hindi: केतु पार्टी है केतु है। केतु ही तो स्त्री और पुरुष है। केतु ही तो सेक्स है।
says: Ketu is also the party, the male-female principle and sexual union itself, an attribute he gives Ketu beyond detachment.
ambiguity: The 'केतु पार्टी है' fragment is garbled; the sex and male-female claims are clear.
classical_check: Differs: classically sex is Venus and Mars; Ketu is detachment, though Ketu in tantra is linked to kundalini.

hindi: उससे बड़ा पावरफुल देवता कौन होगा?
says: He asks which deity could be more powerful than Ketu, ranking Ketu as the most powerful of the planets.
ambiguity: Rhetorical; no measure of power.

gist: Audience remark that Ketu takes away the matters of the house it sits in.

hindi: नहीं नहीं वो केतु बहुत शैडो शैडो प्लनेट है। बहुत शैडो उसकी मल्टीपल इफेक्ट्स हैं केतु की। आएगा करेंगे क्लास।
says: Rejects the simple rule that Ketu removes whatever house it sits in: Ketu is a deep shadow planet with multiple effects, to be covered in a later class.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's effect in a house depends on the house topic and the sign lord's nature; it can remove, detach or spiritualise, not only take away.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 7th in Libra could mean detachment or an unusual spiritual angle in partnership rather than just loss of partner.
Derived: Ketu in the 4th in Cancer could show restlessness or detachment from home and mother, with an inward, spiritual pull.
Derived: Ketu in the 11th in Aquarius could give odd, non-attached gains and few close friends.

classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts do give Ketu a mixed, not purely destructive, result per house.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा की बात है। चंद्रमा इतना पावरफुल है। सीधा सदा शिव है वो।
says: The Moon is extremely powerful and is none other than Sadashiva, the eternal Shiva.
classical_check: Moon's deity is classically Parvati or Varuna; the Moon on Shiva's head is a Puranic image, so this is his own equating.

hindi: कौन सा पाप है जो खत्म करना है? कौन सी मृत्यु है जिसको जीतना है? शिव करेंगे।
says: Whatever sin needs wiping out or whatever death needs conquering, Shiva (hence the Moon) does it.
ambiguity: Figurative; no prediction of death is made.
classical_check: Agrees with Shiva's traditional role as destroyer of sin and conqueror of death.

hindi: महामृत्युंजय के जाप से मरते हुए को खड़ा करने की ताकत होती है। नहीं है तो बढ़िया मृत्यु हो जाती है। कष्ट खत्म हो जाते
says: Chanting the Mahamrityunjaya mantra has the power to raise a dying person, and where that is not meant to be it gives a good death and ends suffering. This is a traditional claim, not a medical or lifespan statement.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk ('हैं').
classical_check: Agrees with the traditional claim for Mahamrityunjaya japa; no evidence given.

gist: Garbled lines about a paradox of one person asking one thing and Jupiter asking another, with 'Jupiter feels good to them' and a 'noted, very good' reply.
Audience question: if there is a hernia or a hernia operation on the belly, does that mean Indra is afflicted.

hindi: हमारे इंद्र में दोष 101% है। लेकिन मंगल का पंगा है कहीं ना कहीं क्योंकि इंद्र मंगल के साथ कंजक्शन पकड़ के चलता है।
says: He says Indra's fault is certain, but the trouble is also somewhere with Mars, because Indra travels in conjunction with Mars; cut-type problems link Uranus and Mars. Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: '101%' may be a caption slip or an exaggeration, and it is unclear whether he affirms or denies fault in Indra. The Uranus-Mars conjunction claim is not a literal fact, since Uranus moves slowly.

hindi: मंगल का पंगा है। कट लगेगा नहीं लगेगा ये मंगल महाराज बताएंगे। वज्र यूज़ होगा कि नहीं।
says: Mars decides whether a cut (surgery) happens; Mars shows if Indra's weapon, the vajra, will be used.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Mars is the classical significator of surgery and cuts.

hindi: पर हर्निया का रीज़ यही होता है।
says: He gives the Mars and Indra link as the reason behind hernia; this is an astrology-to-body claim he made and is not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Very short and unclear which reason 'this' refers to.

gist: Remarks that hernia can be in the abdomen, intestines or other places and he does not know which kind; a medical aside.

hindi: पर तो इनका कौन सा हर्निया और पेट पे कौन सा ग्रह बैठा है। सातवें घर की क्या पोजीशन है? पता नहीं ना काफी कुछ है
says: To judge a belly complaint he would check which planet sits on the belly area and the condition of the 7th house, and says there is a lot more to look at. Not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house is the lower abdomen and groin zone in the body-parts scheme, so a planet there and its sign colour the picture; the planet's nature (cutting Mars, drying Saturn) changes the reading.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 7th in Aries (its own sign) would put a cutting, hot planet on the lower abdomen, flagged for attention per his method.
Derived: Saturn in the 6th in Libra (exalted) would sit on the intestine and waist zone, a slow, constricting influence, not the 7th itself.

ambiguity: He does not say why the 7th house; the lower-abdomen link comes from the classical kalapurusha body map, which he does not cite.
classical_check: Agrees with the kalapurusha scheme where the 7th and 8th govern lower abdomen and genitals.

gist: Audience question on Saturn: if choice cannot be exercised in Saturn's case, how can one manifest.

hindi: क्यों करना है मैनिफेस्ट अपने आप करेगा वो बहुत से लोगों को बिन बैठे मिलता है पान चपाते हुए ढेला नहीं किया होता उन्होंने
says: There is no need to manifest because Saturn does it by itself; many people receive results sitting idle, chewing paan, without lifting a finger.
classical_check: Silent; classically Saturn rewards effort and delay, so this partly differs.

hindi: आप सबके जीवन में कुछ ना कुछ हो रहा है तो हो रहा है मींस मैनिफेस्ट हुआ होगा ना किया तो नहीं तो कौन कर रहा है वो शनि तो कर रहा है बिन मांगे दे रहा है
says: Everything happening in everyone's life was manifested without your doing it, so Saturn is doing it and giving without being asked.
ambiguity: The first words of this sentence sit at the end of the previous chunk ('अच्छा आपके जीवन').

gist: Audience question: how to cancel something negative that someone said to you five or ten years ago.

hindi: बस उसको याद करो हंसो के उस समय मैंने क्या बेवकूफी की थी और उसका कागज फाड़ दो जैसी ट्रिक सिखाई है पहले
says: To cancel an old negative statement, recall it, laugh at the foolishness of that time, and tear up a paper that stands for it, a trick he taught before.

hindi: या तो वो कर लो और नहीं तो सोचो कॉस्मोस को दे दिया खत्म सूर्य में जला दो दफा करो यार अपने आप को माफ करो
says: Alternatively imagine handing the statement to the cosmos, burn it in the Sun and be done, and forgive yourself.

gist: Short garbled phrase about a Munna having said this is the easiest.

hindi: और नहीं तो क्लास देखो हाउ टू गो क्लास देखो पास्ट एंड फ्यूचर कमांड्स बस पास्ट में जाके उसको धो दो धुन गई
says: Otherwise watch his class on how to go into the past and future commands: go into the past and wash the event clean, and it is washed.
ambiguity: Refers to an earlier class by name; details not given here.

gist: Start of the next audience question about a single planet in the lagna; sentence cut off.
Opening of an audience question: a planet retrograde or in an enemy sign in D1 but exalted in navamsa, what result will it give.

hindi: 100% इलाज चाहिए फिर भी क्योंकि लग्न के बाद ही नववांश बना है। लग्न तो मुख्य है ही।
says: Even if the planet is exalted in the navamsa, a retrograde or enemy-sign planet in the lagna chart still needs a full remedy, because the navamsa is derived after the lagna and the lagna chart is the main one.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis: classical texts give the navamsa real weight (vargottama, exaltation in D9 can rescue a weak D1 planet); he treats D1 as overriding.

hindi: जो राशियां घूमती है उसके बावजूद लग्न मुख्य है। ग्रह घूमते हैं उसके बावजूद लग्न मुख्य है।
says: Whatever the signs and planets are doing as they move, the lagna stays the main anchor of the reading.
ambiguity: 'Signs rotate' is loosely stated; it is likely about transits and varga positions shifting.
classical_check: Agrees: the lagna is the base from which all houses are counted.

hindi: वो तो इंटरप्रिटेशन के लिए है। लगन तो मुख्य है ही।
says: The navamsa and other secondary charts are interpretive aids only, to refine the reading of the lagna chart, which remains the main one.
classical_check: Differs in degree: classical texts treat D9 as essential for a planet's true strength, not only as an aid.

hindi: लग्न में खराब है तो करना ही पड़ेगा उपाय।
says: If a planet is bad in the lagna chart, a remedy must be done regardless of how it looks elsewhere.

hindi: और उच्च का होकर भी नववांश में अगर वक्री है तो भी और सत्यानाशी है। काहे का फायदेमंद हुआ?
says: A planet that is exalted but retrograde is even more destructive, so exaltation does not make it helpful; he asks what benefit it could be.
cells_derived_method: Exalted signs are planet-specific (Mars Capricorn, Saturn Libra, and so on); the house the planet sits in decides which life area suffers from the retrograde damage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th would, on his view, make career drive erratic and harmful rather than strong.
Derived: retrograde Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th would, on his view, bring delay and trouble in partnership rather than the stability exaltation promises.

ambiguity: The caption says retrograde in navamsa, but the navamsa has no retrograde of its own, so he likely means retrograde in the birth chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: some commentators treat a retrograde exalted planet as behaving like a debilitated one.

hindi: जबजब वक्रीय होगा अंतरिक्ष में तबत फायदा देगा। बाकी टाइम तो नुकसान ही करेगा।
says: A natally retrograde planet gives benefit only while it is retrograde in the sky; the rest of the time it does harm.

gist: Audience asks him to repeat how he judges gemstone suitability in relation to the 6th, 8th and 12th houses.

hindi: नहीं नहीं 6 8 12 से रिलेटेड नहीं बताते कि अगर राशि यहां पर हो या प्लनेट यहां पर छे आठवें 12वें में होता है तो उसके स्टोन की अंगूठी मत पहनो
says: He denies giving the rule that a planet or sign in the 6th, 8th or 12th means you must not wear its stone; dusthana placement alone is not a ban on the gemstone.
cells_derived_method: For planet X in a dusthana the stone is not barred by this rule alone; the choice depends on whether the planet is troubled and how, so the same planet may get a stone in one house and not in another.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in the 6th in Cancer would not be barred from a pearl by the dusthana alone.
Derived: Saturn in the 12th in Capricorn would not be barred from its stone merely for being in the 12th.

ambiguity: This is a denial of a rule attributed to him, not a rule he adds.
classical_check: Differs: many classical and modern gem texts advise caution with stones of dusthana lords.

hindi: अगर बहुत डायरे सरकमस्टेंस है तो उंगली बदल के पहनाया जाता है वो बहुत सारे कॉम्बिनेशन प्लनेट होता है
says: In very dire circumstances the ring is worn on a changed finger, and there are many planet combinations that call for this.
ambiguity: Which combinations is not listed here; he explains one case later in the chunk.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts fix a finger for each planet's stone.

gist: Fragment 'in the sixth, eighth, twelfth, sign or' cut off at the end of the chunk.

hindi: ये घर है जो ग्रह है उसके घर की बात हो रही है ये जो ग्रह है ना ये बैठे हुए हैं ये घर है यहां
says: He distinguishes two things: the house a planet owns (its own sign) and the house where the planet is seated; the problem being discussed is about the planet's own house.
ambiguity: Caption jumbled; 'house' here means sign ownership as opposed to seat.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard lordship versus placement distinction.

hindi: इस घर में जो भी बैठ गया या इस घर में जो भी अपना घर बना के बैठ गया वो पंगा हो गया।
says: Trouble arises whenever a planet is seated in the troublesome dusthana house, or whenever a planet's own sign lands in it.
cells_derived_method: Both the seat and the lordship count: a planet in the 8th has trouble, and so does the lord of a sign that falls in the 8th, the nature of which depends on the planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 8th in Scorpio would be both seated in and lord of the bad house, so doubly flagged.
Derived: Mercury in the 12th in Gemini would be flagged because its own sign falls in the 12th.

ambiguity: 'This house' is a dusthana (6, 8 or 12) from the context, but the caption does not name it.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical caution on dusthana occupation and lordship.

hindi: मान लो चार नंबर चंद्रमा ने अपना घर यहां बना लिया। अब चंद्रमा जहां भी बैठ गया ना तो दारू के स्थान में उसने अपने घर में दारू की पेटियां रखवा ली और वो खुद कहीं और बैठ गया।
says: Take sign 4 (Cancer), the Moon's own sign, landing in the bad house: it is like the Moon filling his own home with crates of liquor while he sits elsewhere, so the home is ruined by his absence.
cells_derived_method: Cancer falling in 6, 8 or 12 puts the Moon's sign in a dusthana; the lagna then is Aquarius (6th), Sagittarius (8th) or Leo (12th), and the Moon's seat elsewhere decides how much the home is neglected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Aquarius lagna Aquarius is the 6th, so Moon's sign sits in the house of disease and debt while the Moon is placed elsewhere.
Derived: for Sagittarius lagna Sagittarius is the 8th, so the Moon's sign falls in the house of sudden events with the Moon away.

ambiguity: He says 'the place of liquor' without naming which dusthana; the house is left unspecified.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own metaphor for a lord displaced from its sign.

hindi: तो इसका उपाय तो कर नहीं सकते कि इसको फिर जगाओ। तो यहां तो और नाश पिट जाएगा और सत्यानाश हो जाएगा।
says: You cannot fix this by trying to wake that planet up, and attempting it only makes the damage worse.
ambiguity: Garbled; unclear which remedy is being ruled out.

hindi: तो राशि अगर घर उसका यह घर आ गया यहां तो गड़बड़ है।
says: If a planet's own sign (its home) falls in the bad house, then there is a problem with the matters of that sign.
ambiguity: Close to the earlier general rule; here the focus is on the sign falling there, not the planet seated.
classical_check: Agrees with lords of dusthana-placed signs being weakened in their significations.

hindi: अगर चंद्रमा यहां आ गया चार नंबर राशि यहां है और चंद्रमा यहां बैठा हुआ है। तो ये घर का मालिक ही दारू पी के यहां पड़ा हुआ है। मान के चलो। ये नशे में है।
says: If Cancer is in the bad house and the Moon is also seated there, the owner himself lies drunk in his own house, meaning the Moon is stuck in a dusthana in its own sign and is incapacitated.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Cancer in the 6th, 8th or 12th: the lagna is Aquarius, Sagittarius or Leo respectively; the specific house tells which area (health and debt, sudden change, losses) the Moon's incapacity damages.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 12th (Leo lagna) would be an incapacitated mind and sleep or isolation theme in the house of loss.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 6th (Aquarius lagna) would be a dulled emotional mind in the house of struggle and service.

ambiguity: As above, which dusthana is left open.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Moon in its own sign is strong, even in a dusthana (some texts see Harsha-type yogas for dusthana lords).

hindi: ये काम ही नहीं कर रहा। जकड़ा हुआ है। इसलिए मोती पहनना पड़ेगा।
says: The Moon here is not functioning and is gripped, so a pearl must be worn; this is his gemstone remedy for that placement.
classical_check: Agrees that a pearl is the Moon's gem; his reason for prescribing it in a dusthana differs from the classical caution.

gist: Single word 'achha' as a transition.
Says 'this is its story' before going to the next example.

hindi: यहां पर हमारे पास एक नंबर राशि आ गई। एक नंबर राशि पड़ी है यहां। और मंगल पता लगा यहां वक्री है। यहां मंगल वक्री हो गया। सात आठ दो।
says: Second example: sign 1 (Aries, Mars's own sign) falls in the bad house and Mars is seated there retrograde; he then reads out 'seven, eight, two', probably houses touched.
cells_derived_method: Aries in the 6th gives a Scorpio lagna, in the 8th a Virgo lagna, in the 12th a Taurus lagna; retrograde Mars in its own sign in each case damages different life areas and aspects different houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Scorpio lagna, retrograde Mars in Aries in the 6th would be a strong but erratic force in the house of enemies, aspecting the 9th, 12th and 1st.
Derived: for Taurus lagna, retrograde Mars in Aries in the 12th would act on losses and expenses and aspect the 3rd, 6th and 7th.

ambiguity: 'सात आठ दो' (7, 8, 2) is not explained; may be Mars's aspects or the houses it hurts. Which dusthana is not named.
classical_check: Silent; classically Mars in its own sign is strong even in a dusthana.

hindi: अब ये लगन का नाश करेगा। यहां करेगा। यहां करेगा। यहां करेगा। यहां करेगा।
says: This retrograde Mars will ruin the lagna and then damage several other houses one after another, pointing at each.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th houses from where it sits, so lagna and these houses are hit; which houses depends on its seat.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mars in the 8th aspects the 11th, 2nd and 3rd, so gains, wealth and effort would be hit.
Derived: retrograde Mars in the 12th aspects the 3rd, 6th and 7th, so effort, rivals and partnership would be hit.

ambiguity: He points at houses on a diagram that the audio cannot show, so the exact houses are inferred from Mars's aspects.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars's aspects can damage the houses it casts them on.

hindi: क्योंकि मंगल, बृहस्पति और शनि की मल्टीपल दृष्टियां हैं। ये डेंजरस प्लनेट्स हैं।
says: Mars, Jupiter and Saturn have multiple aspects (beyond the 7th), so he calls them dangerous planets because they reach several houses.
cells_derived_method: Mars adds the 4th and 8th, Jupiter the 5th and 9th, Saturn the 3rd and 10th aspects from its seat.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 1st in Capricorn casts aspects on the 3rd, 7th and 10th houses.
Derived: Jupiter in the 5th in Sagittarius aspects the 9th, 11th and 1st houses.

ambiguity: Calling Jupiter dangerous is unusual; he means reach, not malice.
classical_check: Agrees with the special aspects of Mars, Jupiter and Saturn; differs in calling Jupiter dangerous.

gist: Audience asks whether Mars destroys because it is retrograde, or the 8th house, and whether retro Mars also ruins the 8th.

hindi: वक्री को समझ लो। वक्री का पॉइंट बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट है।
says: Retrograde motion must be understood properly because it is a very important point in judging a planet.
classical_check: Agrees: retrograde planets are given special weight (chesta bala).

hindi: सूर्य है। मंगल इसके इधर उधर ऐसे घूम रहा है। फिर धरती यहां चल रही है। धरती घूम के घूम रही है। जब धरती यहां आ जाएगी तो इसकी ऑर्बिट का फर्क है। आगे है इससे तो ऐसा लगेगा वक्री हो गया।
says: Explains retrograde astronomically: Mars and Earth both orbit the Sun, and when Earth overtakes Mars because of the orbit difference, Mars appears to turn back.
ambiguity: Spoken with a diagram; the positions are not recoverable from the captions.
classical_check: Agrees with modern astronomy; classical texts treat vakri as a real motion that gives strength.

hindi: पीछे को जा रहा है। पीछे जा नहीं रहा है।
says: The planet only seems to go backward and is not truly reversing, so retrogression is an appearance caused by the relative motion of Earth.

hindi: लेकिन इतने दिनों के लिए मंगल अगर जन्म में वक्री है। वक्री रेट्रोग्रेड तो इतने दिनों के लिए तो अच्छा हो गया। बाकी के
says: If Mars is retrograde at birth, it is good only for the days when it is retrograde in the sky, and the sentence goes on to say the remaining days are bad.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk ('दिनों के लिए बुरा हो गया').
classical_check: Silent; matches his earlier statement that a retrograde natal planet helps only while retrograde in the sky.

hindi: दिनों के लिए बुरा हो गया। तो थोड़े-थोड़े दिन अच्छे आएंगे। ये पंगा है इसका। सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम है।
says: For the rest of the days the retrograde natal Mars is bad, so only brief stretches of good time come, which he calls its biggest problem.

hindi: इसलिए जब ऐसी स्थिति बन जाए प्लनेट छोड़ते नहीं। अगर मार्गी होता तो जब जब बकरी होगा उन दिनों में तंग करेगा लेकिन थोड़े दिन तंग करेगा क्योंकि बकरी थोड़े दिन के लिए होता है।
says: If the natal planet were direct (margi), it would trouble you only during the short spells when it turns retrograde (caption 'bakri' is vakri), whereas the natal retrograde one does not let go.
ambiguity: 'बकरी' is a caption error for वक्री.

hindi: जब ऐसी स्थिति में आ गया तो यह सारे घरों को तंग करेगा।
says: A planet in this retrograde, dusthana-linked state troubles all the houses it influences, not just one.
ambiguity: 'All the houses' probably means the houses it aspects and rules.

hindi: अब इसको मूंगा पहनाना है।
says: For this retrograde Mars the prescription is to wear red coral (moonga).
classical_check: Agrees that coral is Mars's gem; classical texts caution against it when Mars is malefic or in a dusthana.

gist: 'Four number will come here, five will come, then six will come', numbers with no clear referent.

hindi: अब यहां इसको अंगूठी नहीं पहना सकते। मूंगे की यहां पर मंगल गले में नहीं पहना सकते मूंगा।
says: In this case coral cannot be given as a ring in the usual way, and it also cannot be worn as a neck pendant for Mars.
ambiguity: Caption is rough; the reason the usual ring cannot be used is not clear.
classical_check: Differs: coral rings (ring finger) are the classical standard.

hindi: और अगर हमें लग रहा है कि किसी और पुखराज, नीलम पहना के ठीक नहीं कर सकते तो मूंगा पहनाने को मजबूर है तो हम सबसे लंबी उंगली में पहनाएंगे। वैसे कौन सी उंगली में? शनि की राशि। वैसे रिंग फिंगर में आता है।
says: If yellow sapphire and blue sapphire cannot set it right and coral is unavoidable, the coral goes on the longest finger, the middle one, Saturn's finger, instead of the usual ring finger.
ambiguity: Mentions the ring finger as the normal finger for coral; the middle finger is Saturn's by palmistry.
classical_check: Differs: the middle finger is the classical finger of Saturn's stone, and coral normally goes on the ring finger.

hindi: अब शनि की राशि में उंगली में आएगा सिल्वर में। यह सपोर्ट सिस्टम लाना पड़ेगा इसका।
says: On Saturn's finger the coral is set in silver, and this support system has to be added for it to work.
ambiguity: Metal choice stated as silver; classical Mars stones are normally set in gold or copper.
classical_check: Differs: silver is the Moon's metal.

hindi: तब कहीं जाके मंगल महाराज कृपा करेंगे और साइड इफेक्ट के साथ थोड़ा शांत होगा। कम से कम साइड इफेक्ट पे काम करेगा।
says: Only then will Mars grant relief and calm somewhat, though with side effects; the arrangement aims to keep the side effects minimal.

gist: Says these fingers get changed depending on the case.
Closes the questions, thanks the audience and prays that Indra's grace stays with everyone.

hindi: स्वर्ग में रहो भीख मत मांगो भगवान से खुद का जैसा जीवन है उसको स्वर्ग बना के रखो इंद्र यहीं से मैनिफेस्टेशन देना शुरू करेगा
says: Live in heaven and do not beg from God; treat your present life as heaven, and Indra starts giving manifestation from there.

hindi: हमने अभी के जीवन को कह रखा है यह नर्क है आगे स्वर्ग मिलेगा नहीं अभी स्वर्ग है आपका इंद्र पावरफुली काम करेगा
says: Do not call the present life hell while waiting for heaven later; call it heaven now and your Indra (Uranus) will work powerfully.

hindi: आप अपनी पत्नी को कभी नहीं कह सकते तुम इससे सुंदर लग सकती हो आप बोलो तू ऑलरेडी सुंदर है अब वो और सुंदर बनने में लगी रहेगी।
says: Tell your wife she is already beautiful rather than that she could look better; appreciating what exists makes a person improve further, a model of how affirming the present works.
ambiguity: Marriage-advice illustration, linked to Indra only by context.

hindi: अगर आपने ये कह दिया तुम आज सुंदर नहीं हो तो वो आपकी ऐसी की तैसी फेर देगी। इसीलिए इंद्र को लिए आप जगाने को आपको यही कहना पड़ेगा। अरे स्वर्ग यार अपना मजा आ रहा पार्टी अब बढ़िया है।
says: Telling her she is not beautiful today will backfire, so to awaken Indra you must say 'this is heaven, I am enjoying it, the party is great'; affirm instead of criticise.

hindi: इसे संतुष्टि नहीं कहते। इसे कहते हैं जो मिल रहा है उसको एंजॉय किया।
says: This is not contentment (santushti); it is enjoying whatever is coming to you, an active relishing rather than passive acceptance.

hindi: छोटे बच्चे से सीखो उसके इंद्र कितना अच्छा होता है। रेडीमेड सब होता है। उसका जीवन स्वर्ग में होता है। मम्मा की गोद मिल जाती है। पापा से साइकिल मिल जाती है। टॉफी आ जाती है।
says: Learn from a small child, whose Indra is excellent: everything arrives readymade, a lap from mama, a cycle from papa, toffees, so the child lives in heaven.

gist: Describes the child sleeping anywhere, bathing and dancing naked, being lifted, doted on and showered with gifts.

hindi: स्वर्ग है। क्योंकि बच्चा प्रसन्न है, आनंद में है। ऐसा चीज बड़े होकर भी सीख लीजिए।
says: The child's heaven comes from being cheerful and in bliss, and adults should learn that same quality, since the state, not the circumstances, makes heaven.

hindi: आपका यूरेनस आपको अंधाधुंध चीजें देगा।
says: If you learn that childlike enjoyment, your Uranus will give you things in abundance.
ambiguity: A promise of results; not measured.

hindi: बच्चा कभी नहीं सड़ता कुर्ता जो गया रोया पीटा नॉर्मल।
says: A child does not hold a grudge: after being scolded or hit he cries and is normal again, the quick-reset trait to copy.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled in the middle ('कुर्ता जो गया'); meaning inferred.

hindi: ऐसी बुद्धि वाले बन जाओ, राजा बनोगे। बहुत बड़ा जिगरा आएगा और बहुत मौज करोगे।
says: Develop that childlike mind and you will become a king, with great courage and a lot of enjoyment.

gist: Closes the class, thanks everyone for joining, with a salutation and music.
Chanting of Om with background music.
Music and Om chanting at the end of the video.
